entries.context: Lt. J. W. C. Kirk, Notes on the Somali Language (Oxford University Press, 1903, Vocabulary pp. 42–79) • Cross-verified with The Thiomi Dataset Somali (CC-BY-4.0)

entries.translation: Fardaha radi
entries.context: Lt. J. W. C. Kirk, Notes on the Somali Language (Oxford University Press, 1903, Vocabulary pp. 42–79) • Cross-verified with The Thiomi Dataset Somali (CC-BY-4.0)

entries.english: 2. look to your front

entries.english: Somali +ATR (Series A) vs. -ATR (Series B) Vowel Harmony Minimal Pairs
entries.translation: dhis ('build!' [+ATR] vs. 'he built' [-ATR]); hel ('find!' vs. 'he found'); kab ('sandal' vs. 'he set a bone'); qod ('dig!' vs. 'he dug'); diiday ('I fainted' vs. 'I refused'); hees ('song' vs. 'he sang'); laab ('chest' vs. 'he folded'); duushay ('she flew' vs. 'she attacked')
entries.context: Christopher R. Green, Michelle E. Morrison, Nikki B. Adams & Erin Smith (2019) Marka/Somali/Maay Morphology & Somali ATR Harmony, Language Science Press #190 Chs. 7 & 11 (https://langsci-press.org/catalog/book/190, CC-BY-4.0)

entries.english: Somali Gender Polarity Paradigm (Feminine Sg -t-a -> Masculine Pl -h-a; Masculine Sg -k-a -> Feminine Pl -d-a)

entries.translation: Waxay u muuqatay mid cirowaday oo gariirayso "Hooyo?" ayan weydiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She doesn’t turn around.
entries.translation: Ma soo jeesan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “Mum, what’s wrong?” She takes a deep breath and turns to face me.
entries.translation: "Hooyo, maxa qaldan?" Waxay jiiday neefta oona soo jeesatay si ay ii aragto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Her eyes are wide and filled with fear.
entries.translation: Indhaheeda way balarteen waxaana ka buuxsamay cabsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “There’s something outside,” she says. “Something big.”
entries.translation: "Wax ayaa ka jiro bananka," ayay tiri. "Wax weyn."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I follow her gaze out the window.
entries.translation: Waxaan idhaheeda la raacay banaanka daaqada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At first, I don’t see anything.
entries.translation: Marka hore waxbo ma arko
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then, I notice a movement in the shadows.
entries.translation: Laakiin ka dib, waxaan ka ogaaday socodka hooska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a large, dark shape, and it’s moving towards the house.
entries.translation: Waa qaab weyn oo madow ah, kaasoo kusoo socdo guriga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “What is it?” I ask. “I don’t know,” Mum says. “But I don’t think it’s friendly.”
entries.translation: "Wa maxay?" Ayaan weydiyay. "Ma garanaayo," ayay Hooyo tiri. "Laakin uma malaynayo wax lala saxibi karo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature gets closer.
entries.translation: Abuurka wuu soo dhawaanayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s tall and slender, with long, spindly legs.
entries.translation: Waa caato dheer, oo leh lugo xito oo dhadheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Its body is covered in black fur, and its head is a smooth, round ball.
entries.translation: Jirkeeda waxaa ku daboolna duf madow, madaxeedana waa mid jilicsan oo sida kubadda u wareegsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It has no eyes, but I can see two large, pointed ears.
entries.translation: Indho malahan, laakin waxaan arkaa labo dhago, waa weyn oo fiiqan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “What are we going to do?” I ask.
entries.translation: "Maxaan samayn doonaa?" Ayaan weydiiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “We need to get out of here,” Mum says. “Now.”
entries.translation: "Waxaan u baahannahay inaan meshan ka baxno," Hooyo ayaa tiri. "Hadda."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We run out of the kitchen and into the living room.
entries.translation: Waxaan kasoo cararnay jikada kuna cararnay qolka fadhiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “Mum! Dad!” I cry. “There’s something outside!”
entries.translation: "Hooyo! Aabo!" Waan ooyay. "Wax ayaa bananka joogo!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad looks up from the TV. “What is it?” he asks.
entries.translation: Aabo wuxu firiyay talefishinka. "Maxaa waayay?" ayuu weydiiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “I don’t know,” Mum says. “But it’s big and it’s coming this way.”
entries.translation: "Ma garanaayo" Ayeey Hooyo tiri. "Laakiin way weyn tahay dhankaan ayayna usoo socotaa".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad gets up from the couch.
entries.translation: Aabe fadhiga ayuu kasoo kacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “We need to get out of here,” he says.
entries.translation: "Waxaan u baahannahay inaan meshaan ka tagno," ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We all run for the front door.
entries.translation: Kuligeen waxaan u cararnay albaabka hore
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mum unlocks it and we rush outside.
entries.translation: Hooyo ayaa furtay waxaana u cararnay banankan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature is right behind us.
entries.translation: Abuurka ayaa naga dambeeya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s so close I can feel its hot breath on the back of my neck.
entries.translation: Aad ayuu noogu dhawaa waan daremayay neeftisa kulul ee luqunta gadasheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We run to the car and get in.
entries.translation: Waxaan u cararnay gaariga oona galnay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dad starts the engine and we peel out of the driveway.
entries.translation: Aabe ayaa kiciyay gaariga waxaana ku cararnay dhinacaas iyo wadad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The creature chases after us, but we’re too fast.
entries.translation: Abuurka ayaa nasoo daba bursaday, laakin aad ayaan u dheeraynaynay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Movies have long been a powerful force in shaping our culture and our values.
entries.translation: Filimaanta waxay muddo dheer ahaayeen kuwa awood xoogan taasoo qaabaysa dhaqankeena, iyo qiyamkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can influence our beliefs about everything from love and romance to war and violence.
entries.translation: Waxay nagu dhiiri galin karaan waxaan aaminsanahay laga bilabo jacayl, muxubo ilaa dagal iyo gacan ka hadal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And they have a particularly strong influence on our ideas about gender roles.
entries.translation: Waxayna si gaar ah saamayn xoogan ugu leeyihin fikradaheena ku saabsan doorka jinsiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For decades, Hollywood has perpetuated the stereotype of the ideal wife as a beautiful, submissive, and domestic woman who puts her husband and children first.
entries.translation: Muddo qarniyo ah, Hollywood waxay sii waday fikradda xaaska ku habboon inay tahay haweeney qurux badan, hogaansan, iyo naag guri taasoo hormarisa ninkeeda iyo caruurteeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This image is often reinforced by the way that female characters are portrayed in movies.
entries.translation: Sawirkaan waxaa inta badan lagu xoojiyaa sida jilayaasha dumarka ah loogu muujiyo filimaanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The majority of female characters were portrayed as either romantic interests or mothers.
entries.translation: Inta badan jilayaasha dumarka waxaa lagu muujiyay kuwa yinxiisaynaya muxibo ama hooyoo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This narrow representation of women in film sends a powerful message to viewers about what it means to be a woman.
entries.translation: Matalaadaan ciriiriga ah ee dumarka ku jira filimka waxa ay fariin xoogan u diraysaa daawadayaasha oo ku saabsan waxa ay ka macno tahay inaad dumar tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It suggests that women's primary role is to be attractive and nurturing, and that their success is measured by their relationships with men and children.
entries.translation: Waxay soo jeedinaysaa in doorka koowaad ee haweenku yahay soo jiidashada iyo barbaarinta, iyo in gushoda lagu cabbiro xirirka ay la leeyihiin ragga iyo carruurta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This idealized image of the wife can be harmful to women in several ways.
entries.translation: Sawirkaan ku habboon ee xaaska wuxuu waxyeelo ugu gaysan karaa haweenka dhowr siyaabood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Doctor, I've been having this terrible stomach pain for the past few days.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Dhakhtar, waxaan dareemayay calool xanuunkaan daran dhowrkii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's so bad that I can't eat or sleep.
entries.translation: Aad ayay u xun tahay inaan waxba cuni karin ama seexan karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a sharp, stabbing pain that comes and goes.
entries.translation: Waa xanuun oodin ah, oo imudaayo oo marna i qabanaayo marna idaynaayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Can you tell me more about the pain? Where is it located?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Ma isheegi kartaa wax badan oo sabsan xanuunka? xagee ka dareemee?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's mostly in my lower abdomen, right around my belly button, but it sometimes radiates to my back.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxay u badan tahay qaybta hoose ee caloosha, wareegga xundhurtayda, laakin mar mar wuxu u wareegaa dhabarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does anything make the pain worse?
entries.translation: ?Dhakhtar: Wax xanuunka kasi darsinaayo miyaa jiro
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Eating seems to make it worse, especially fatty or greasy foods.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Cunista ayaa kaga sii darayso, gaar ahaan cuntada dufanka leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: And does anything make it better.?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Wax aad kaga roonaanayso miyaa jirta.?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Lying down seems to help a little.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Markaan seexdo ayaa xoogaa iyara cawiso
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Does the pain come and go, or is it constant?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Xanunka ma mid marna ku qabto marna ku daayaa ah, ama waa mid joogto ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: It's constant. It's just a dull ache, but it's really uncomfortable.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waa joogto. Wa xanuun dansan, laakiin runtii aan raaxa hayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Have you had any other symptoms? Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Wax kaloo calamada ah ma leedahay? Lalabo, matag, shuba?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: No, just the pain.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Maya, kaliya xanuun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I see. Well, it sounds like you're having a case of gastritis.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan arkaa. Hagaag, waxay u muuqataa inaad qabto gaas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gastritis is inflammation of the stomach lining.
entries.translation: Gaaska waa hur caloosha dhabarkeeda ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It can be caused by a number of things, including eating spicy or fatty foods, drinking alcohol, or taking certain medications.
entries.translation: Waxaa sababi kara dhowr waxyaabood, ay ku jiraan cunista cuntooyinka basbaaska ama saliida leh, cabida khamriga, ama qaadashada dawooyinka qaarkood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: Is it serious?
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Ma dhab baa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It can be, but in most cases it's not.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Way noqon kartaa, laakiin inta badan ma aha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to prescribe you some medication to help relieve the pain and inflammation.
entries.translation: Waxaan kuu qorayaa daawoyin kaa caawinaya inay kaa yareeyaan xanuunka iyo hurka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also avoid eating spicy or fatty foods, and drink plenty of fluids.
entries.translation: Waa inaad sidoo kale iska ilaalisaa cunista cuntooyinka basbaaska iyo dufanka leh, oodna cabtaa sharaab badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ingredients:
entries.translation: Waxa ay ka kooban tahay:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 cup all-purpose flour
entries.translation: *1 koob oo burka siyabaha kala duwan loo isticmaalo ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 cup almond flour
entries.translation: *1 koob oo burka almoonka ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 cup granulated sugar
entries.translation: koob oo sokor budo ah 1/2 *
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar
entries.translation: *1/4 koob sokorta bunniga qafiifka ah ee sijilaysan
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
entries.translation: * 1/2 qaando fixiso ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/4 teaspoon baking soda
entries.translation: qamiir 1/4 qaado ah *
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/4 teaspoon salt
entries.translation: cusbo 1/4 qaado ah*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, at room temperature
entries.translation: 1/2 koob (1 ul) subag aan cusbayn, heerkulka qolka*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 large egg
entries.translation: 1 ukun oo weyn*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 large egg yolk
entries.translation: 1 xabo ukunta jalaha ah*
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1 teaspoon almond extract
entries.translation: * 1 qaado salida almoonka lag soo saaray
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: * 1/2 cup milk
entries.translation: * koob 1/2 oo caano ah
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instructions:
entries.translation: Tilmaamo:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour an 8-inch round cake pan.
entries.translation: 1. Ku kululee foornada ilaa 350 darajo F (175 darajo C). Dufan iyo bur mari digsiga keega wareeg ah oo 8-inch ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. In a medium bowl, whisk together the flours, granulated sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
entries.translation: 2. Baaquli dhexe, iskula qas bur, sokor shiidan, sokorta bunniga ah, qamiir iyo fixiso, iyo cusbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and egg until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg yolk and almond extract.
entries.translation: 3. Baaquli weyn, iskula qas dhammaan subagga iyo ukunta ilaa kululato oo dhalasho. Garaac ukunta jaalaha iyo almoonka lasoo habeeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, alternating with the milk. Mix until just combined.
entries.translation: 4. Si tartiib ah ugu dar maadooyinka qalallan maadooyinka qoyan, ku gadi caano. Isku qas ilaa ay isku darsamaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Fold in the almond flour until evenly distributed.
entries.translation: 5. Isku lab burka almoonka ilaa ay isku dhex milmaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a hot summer day in July when I finally turned 16 years old.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maalin kulul oo xagaag ah ee Luulyo markii ugu damabeyntii aan noqday 16 sano jir.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I had been eagerly anticipating this day for as long as I could remember, and now that it was finally here, I couldn't wait to get started on my road to freedom.
entries.translation: Waxaan si aad ah u sugayay maalintaan ilaa inta aan xasuusan karo, haddana hadda oo ay ugu dambeyntii timid,waan sugi kari waayey inaan bilowdo wadadayda xorriyadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first step was to take the written test.
entries.translation: Tallaabada ugu horeysay waxay ahayd inaan sameeyo imtixaanka qoraalka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I studied hard for weeks, and I was confident that I would pass.
entries.translation: Aad ayaan u akhriyay todobaadyo, waxaana ku kalsoonaa in aa baasi doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the day of the test, I arrived at the DMV early and took my seat in the waiting room.
entries.translation: Maalintii imtixaanka, waxaan imid DMV goor hore oo aan kursigayga ku fadhiistay qolka sugitaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After a few hours, my name was called, and I was ushered into a small room with a computer.
entries.translation: Saacado yar ka dib, magacayga ayaa la wacay, waxaana la i geeyay qol yar oo kombuyuutar leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The test was surprisingly easy, and I finished it in no time.
entries.translation: Imtixaanka si la yaab leh ayuu u fududaa, waxaana ku dhammeeyey wakhti yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, I received a letter in the mail informing me that I had passed the written test.
entries.translation: Dhowr maalmood ka dib, waxaa la iigu soo diray warqad boostada oo igu wargelinaysay in aan imtixaanka qoraalka ahaa ka soo gudbay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The next step was to schedule a driving test.
entries.translation: Tallaabada xigtay waxay ahayd in la qorsheeyo imtixaanka wadista.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I called the DMV and made an appointment for the following week.
entries.translation: Waxaan wacay DMV waxaana ballan ka qabsadey usbuuca soo socda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The day of my driving test arrived, and I was more nervous than I had ever been in my life.
entries.translation: Maalintii imtixaan wadista ayaa timid, waxaana ka walwalsanaa in ka badan sidii aan waligay nolashayda ahaan jiray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I drove to the DMV with my mom, who would be accompanying me on the test.
entries.translation: Waxaan aadnay DMV aniga iyo hooyaday taas oo ii raaci kartay imtixaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Heartbreak," sighed the poet, "is the cruelest of afflictions.
entries.translation: "Qalbi jab," ayuu taahay gabaygii, "waa kan ugu naxariis daran ee dhibaatooyinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a pain that pierces the soul and leaves us feeling empty and alone.
entries.translation: Waa xanuun waxa nafta dalooliya oo nooga taga inaan dareenno marnaan iyo kali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a fire that burns from within, consuming us with its flames.
entries.translation: Waa dab ka gubanaya gudaha, oo nagu baabi'inayo ololkiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a storm that tears us apart, leaving us broken and scarred.
entries.translation: Waa duufaan na kala jeexjeexaysa, oo nooga tagaysa jajab iyo nabarro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even in the midst of our heartbreak, there is hope.
entries.translation: Laakiin xitaa qalbi jabka dhexdiisa, rajo ayaa jirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For even as our hearts are broken, they are also made new.
entries.translation: Waayo, xataa iyada oo qalbiyadeena ay jaban yihiin, hadana waa la cusboonaysiiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are given the opportunity to learn from our mistakes and to grow stronger.
entries.translation: Waxaa nala siiyay fursad aan wax kaga baranno khaladaadkeena oo aan ku sii xoogeysanno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We are given the chance to find love again, even if it is different than the love we have lost.
entries.translation: Waxaa nala siiyay fursad aan mar kale ku helno jacayl, xitaa haddii ay ka duwan tahay jacaylkii aan luminay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So let us not despair in our heartbreak.
entries.translation: Markaa yaanan ku quusan qalbi jabkeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us instead embrace it as a part of life.
entries.translation: Aan taa beddelkeeda u qaadano qayb ka mid ah nolosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let us learn from it and grow from it.
entries.translation: Aan wax ka baranno oo aan ka korno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And let us never give up on the hope of finding love again"
entries.translation: Oo yaanan waligeen ka quusan rajada ah inaan mar kale helno jacayl"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Judaism and Kosher Kosher is a set of dietary laws in Judaism.
entries.translation: Yuhuudda iyo Kosher Kosher waa sharciyada cuntada ee diinta Yuhuudda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These laws define which foods are permissible to eat and which are not.
entries.translation: Sharciyadaan waxay qeexayaan cuntooyinka la oggol yahay in la cuno iyo kuwa aan ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kosher foods are those that are considered to be fit for consumption according to Jewish law.
entries.translation: Cunnooyinka Kosher waa kuwa loo arko inay ku habboon yihiin isticmaalka sida waafaqsan sharciga Yuhuudda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The laws of kosher are based on the Torah, the first five books of the Hebrew Bible.
entries.translation: Sharciyada kosher waxay ku saleysan yihiin Tawreed, shanta buug ee ugu horeeysa ee Kitaabka Cibraaniga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These laws prohibit the consumption of certain animals, such as pigs and shellfish, as well as the consumption of blood and meat from animals that have not been slaughtered in a specific way.
entries.translation: Sharciyadaan waxay mamnuucayaan cunista xoolaha qaarkood, sida doofaarka iyo kalluunka qolofta leh, iyo sidoo kale cunista dhiigga iyo hilibka xoolaha oo aan si gaar ah loo gawracin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kosher foods are also subject to a number of other regulations, such as the separation of dairy and meat products.
entries.translation: Cunnooyinka Kosher sidoo kale waxay ku xiran yihiin xeerar kale oo dhowr ah, sida kala soocida caanaha iyo hilibka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kosher food is prepared in a way that ensures that it is fit for consumption according to Jewish law.
entries.translation: Cuntada Kosher waxaa loo diyaariyaa qaab hubiya inay ku habboon tahay cunista sida waafaqsan sharciga Yuhuudda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The observance of kosher laws is an important part of Jewish religious practice.
entries.translation: Ilaalinta sharciyada kosher waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dhaqanka diinta Yuhuudda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For many Jews, eating kosher food is a way to show their devotion to God and to connect with their heritage.
entries.translation: Yuhuud badan, cunista cuntada kosher waa hab lagu muujiyo sida ay ugu kalsoon yihiin Illaah iyo inay ku xirmaan dhaxalkooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of reasons why Jews observe kosher laws.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira dhowr sababood oo ay Yuhuuddu u ilaaliyaan sharciyada kosher.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm telling you, this is going to be the funniest thing ever," said Tom.
entries.translation: “Waxaan kuu sheegayaa, tani waxay noqon doontaa waxa ugu qosolka badan abid,” ayuu yiri Tom.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Just wait until you see the look on people's faces when they see my new tattoo!"
entries.translation: “Kaliya sug ilaa aad ka aragto muuqaalka wejiyada dadka markay arkaan tattoo-gayga cusub!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I don't know, Tom," said his friend, Ben.
entries.translation: “Ma aqaan, Tom,” ayuu yiri saaxiibkiis, Ben.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "A green question mark on your forehead seems like it could be a bit of a risky move."
entries.translation: “Calaamadda su'aasha cagaaran ee wejigaaga waxay umuuqataa inay noqon karto xoogaa dhaqdhaqaaq halis ah.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's what makes it so funny," said Tom "People are going to be so confused.
entries.translation: "Taasi waa waxa ka dhigaya mid aad u qosol badan," ayuu yiri Tom "Dadku aad ayay u jahwareersanaan doonaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They'll be asking themselves all sorts of questions, like 'What does it mean?' or 'Why did he do that?'"
entries.translation: Waxay isweydiin doonaan dhammaan noocyada su'aalaha, sida 'Maxay ka dhigan tahay? ' Ama 'Muxuu taas u sameeyey? '"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Or they'll just think you're an idiot," said Ben.
entries.translation: “Ama waxay u maleynayaan inaad tahay nacas,” ayuu yiri Ben.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Nah, they'll get it," said Tom. "Trust me."
entries.translation: “Maya, way fahmi doonaan,” ayuu yiri Tom. “I aamin.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So Tom got the tattoo, and sure enough, people were confused.
entries.translation: Marka Tom wuxuu helay tattoo-gii, waana hubaal in ku filan, dadku way jahwareereen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They asked him all sorts of questions, and he loved every minute of it.
entries.translation: Waxay weydiiyeen dhammaan noocyada su'aalaha, wuuna jeclaa daqiiqad kasta oo ka mid ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He even started a blog about his tattoo, where he would post pictures and answer questions from his readers.
entries.translation: Xitaa wuxuu bilaabay mareeg ku saabsan tattoo-giisa, halkaas oo uu soo dhigi doono sawirro kana jawaabi doono su'aalaha akhristayaashiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Indira Gandhi was the first and only woman to serve as Prime Minister of India.
entries.translation: Indira Gandhi waxay ahayd haweeneydii ugu horeysay oo kaliyana noqota Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Hindiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was born in 1917 into a prominent political family, and her father, Jawaharlal Nehru, was the first Prime Minister of India.
entries.translation: Waxay ka dhalatay 1917-kii qoys siyaasadeed oo caan ah, aabaheedna, Jawaharlal Nehru, wuxuu ahaa Ra'iisul Wasaarihii ugu horeeyay ee Hindiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Indira Gandhi was educated in India and England, and she married Feroze Gandhi in 1942.
entries.translation: Indira Gandhi waxay wax ku baratay Hindiya iyo Ingiriiska, -kiiwaxayna guursatay Feroze Gandhi sanadkii 1942.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They had two sons, Rajiv and Sanjay.
entries.translation: Waxay dhaleen laba wiil, Rajiv iyo Sanjay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gandhi began her political career in 1955, when she was elected to the Indian Parliament.
entries.translation: Gandhi waxay bilawday xirfadeeda siyaasadeed sanadkii 1955-kii, markii loo doortay Baarlamaanka Hindiya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She served in various ministerial positions in the government of her father, and in 1966 she became Prime Minister after his death.
entries.translation: Waxay ka soo shaqeysay xilal wasaaradeed oo kala duwan xukuumaddii aabaheed, waxayna sanadkii 1966-dii noqotay ra'iisul wasaare dhimashadiisa kadib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gandhi was a controversial figure, and her policies were often criticized.
entries.translation: Gandhi waxay ahayd shakhsi muran badan dhaliyay, siyaasadeedana inta badan waa la dhaliili jiray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was accused of being authoritarian and of suppressing dissent.
entries.translation: Waxaa lagu eedeeyay inay tahay kali-talis iyo inay cabburiso mucaaradka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, she was also a popular leader, and she is credited with modernizing India and improving the lives of its people.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, iyadana sidoo kale waxay ahayd hoggaamiye caan ah, waxaana lagu tiriyaa inay casriyeeysay Hindiya iyo hagaajinta nolosha dadkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gandhi was assassinated by her Sikh bodyguards in 1984.
entries.translation: Gandhi waxaa dilay ilaaladeeda Sikh 1984-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was succeeded by her son, Rajiv Gandhi.
entries.translation: Waxaa xilka kala wareegay wiilkeeda, Rajiv Gandhi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gandhi's life and career were marked by many challenges, but she never gave up on her dream of a better India.
entries.translation: Gandhi nolosheeda iyo xirfadeeda waxaa lagu calaamadeeyay caqabado badan, laakiin waligeed kama quusan riyadeeda ah Hindiya ka wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The term is frequently used interchangeably with the term climate change, though the latter refers to both human- and naturally produced warming and the effects it has on our planet.
entries.translation: Eraygan waxaa marar badan loo adeegsadaa bedelka erayga isbedelka cimilada, inkastoo kan dambe ay tilmaamayso labadaba kulaylka uu soo saaro bini'aadamka iyo dabiiciga iyo saamaynta ay ku leedahaya meeraheena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The largest human influence on climate change has been the emission of greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide.
entries.translation: Saamaynta ugu badan ee bini'aadamka ku yeesheen isbedelka cimilada waxay ahayd sii daynta gaaska aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo sida kaarboon laba ogsaydh, methane iyo nitrous oxide.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The primary source of these emissions is from burning fossil fuels for electricity, heat and transportation.
entries.translation: Ilaha ugu muhiimsan ee qiiq sii daynta waa u gubida shidaalka dabiiciga ah korontada, kulaylka iyo gaadiidka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The portfolio was heavy, and the line was long.
entries.translation: Faylka shaqada wuxuu ahaa mid culus, safkana wuu dheeraa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I stood there, aching with pain, and wondered if I would ever get to the front.
entries.translation: Halkaas ayaan istaagay, anigoo la il daran xanuun, lana yaaban haddi an heli karo inaan gaaro safka hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, my turn came, and I presented my portfolio to the woman at the counter.
entries.translation: Ugu danbeyntii, wakhtigaygii ayaa la gaaray, waxaana u dhiibay faylkii shaqada haweenaydii miski joogtay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She looked at it for a moment, then shook her head.
entries.translation: Xoogaa ayeey fiirisay, ka dibna madaxa ayeey jiljishay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm sorry," she said. "We can't accept this portfolio. It's not up to our standards."
entries.translation: Waan ka xumahay," ayay tiri. "Ma aqbali karno faylkaan shaqada. Ma ahan mid "heerkena garsiisan".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I felt a wave of despair wash over me.
entries.translation: Waxaan dareemay mowjad rajo-beel ah oo igu soo qubanaysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: All my hard work, for nothing.
entries.translation: Dadaalkaygii oo dhan, wuxuu noqday waxba kama jiraan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took the portfolio back and started to walk away.
entries.translation: Waxaan dib u qaatay faylalkii shaqada oo bilaabay inaan ka soo dhaqaajiyo.

entries.translation: Waxaa lagu siiyay digniin cad oo kooban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have been told that if you continue to engage in this behavior, you will be banned.
entries.translation: Waxaa laguu sheegay in haddii aad ku sii socoto dhaqankaan, lagu ganaaxi doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You have now had two chances to correct your behavior, and you have failed to do so.
entries.translation: Hadda waxaad haysatay laba fursadood oo aad ku sixi kartay dhaqankaaga, waadna ku guuldareysatay inaad sidaas sameyso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, you will now be banned from this forum.
entries.translation: Sidaas darteed, hadda waa lagaa mamnuuci doonaa golahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ban is permanent, and you will not be allowed to create a new account or participate in this forum in any way.
entries.translation: Mamnuucidaan waa abid, lagumana oggolaan doono inaad sameysato koonto cusub ama aad golahaan sinaba uga qaybgasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We hope that this ban will serve as a warning to others who may be tempted to engage in similar behavior.
entries.translation: Waxaan rajeyneynaa in mamnuucidaan ay digniin u noqon doonto dadka kale ee laga yaabo inay isku dayaan inay ku lug yeeshaan dabeecad la mid ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We will not tolerate this type of behavior on our forum, and we will take action to protect our community from it.
entries.translation: Uma dulqaadan doonno habdhaqanka noocan ah golaheena, waxaanan qaadi doonnaa tallaabo aan uga ilaalineyno bulshadeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions about this ban, please do not hesitate to contact us.
entries.translation: Haddii aad qabtid wax su'aalo ah oo ku saabsan mamnuucidaan, fadlan ha ka waaban inaad nala soo xiriirto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thank you for your cooperation.
entries.translation: Waad ku mahadsan tahay wada shaqayntaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What the hell are you doing, you idiot?!"
entries.translation: “War maxaad samaynaysaa, doqonyohow?!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Excuse me?"
entries.translation: “Iga raali noqo?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "You cut me off! You almost made me crash!"
entries.translation: "Waad ikala gooysay! Waxaan ku sigatay in la i burburiyo!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm sorry, I didn't mean to. I was just trying to get around that slow-moving truck."
entries.translation: “Waan ka xumahay, ulama jeedin inaan sameeyo. Waxaan kaliya isku dayay inaan ka wareego gaarigaas qunyar socodka ah.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, you could have at least used your turn signal!"
entries.translation: “Hagaag, waxaad ugu yaraan isticmaali laheyd calaamadaada leexashada!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I did use my turn signal!"
entries.translation: “Waan isticmaalay calaamadayda leexashada!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you didn't! You just pulled right out in front of me!"
entries.translation: "Maya, ma aadan sameyn! Adiga hortayda ayaad toos uga soo baxday!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm telling you, I used my turn signal!"
entries.translation: “Waxaan kuu sheegayaa, waan adeegsaday calaamadeyda leexashada!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Whatever. You're still a terrible driver."
entries.translation: "Waxay ahaataba. Weli waxaad tahay darawal aad u xun."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "And you're a jerk!"
entries.translation: “Oo waxaad tahay qof qalafsan!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "At least I know how to drive!"
entries.translation: “Ugu yaraan waan garanayaa sida loo wado!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Oh, yeah? Well, I'm a better writer than you are!"
entries.translation: "Oh, haa? Hagaag, waxaan ahay qoraa kaa wanaagsan!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's debatable."
entries.translation: “Taasi waa laga doodi karaa.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's not debatable! I'm Ernest Hemingway!"
entries.translation: "Maaha mid laga doodi karo! Waxaan ahay Ernest Hemingway!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who?"
entries.translation: “Yaa wayay?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Ernest Hemingway! The greatest writer of all time!"
entries.translation: "Ernest Hemingway! Qoraaga ugu fiicnaa abid!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Never heard of him."
entries.translation: “Weligay ma maqal isaga.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Well, you've heard of me now!"
entries.translation: “Hagaag, hadda waad i maqashay aniga!”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yeah, I heard of you."
entries.translation: “Haa, waan kaa maqlay.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: Can you tell me a little bit about its history?
entries.translation: Grace: Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa taariikhdeeda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Of course. Tea originated in China, where it has been cultivated for over 5,000 years.
entries.translation: Macallinka: Dabcan. Shaaha wuxuu ka yimid Shiinaha, halkaas oo lagu beeray in ka badan 5,000 oo sano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first written record of tea dates back to the 3rd century BC, when it was mentioned in a Chinese medical text.
entries.translation: Diiwaankii ugu horreeyay ee qoraal ah ee shaaha wuxuu soo bilowday qarnigii 3aad ee BC, markii lagu xusay qoraal caafimaad oo Shiine ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tea was originally used as a medicinal herb, but it quickly became a popular drink among Chinese people of all social classes.
entries.translation: Shaaha waxaa markii hore loo isticmaali jiray daawo dhireed ahaan, laakiin waxay si dhakhso ah u noqotay cabitaan caan ka dhex ah dadka Shiinaha ee dhammaan qaybaha bulshada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: What about outside of China? When did tea start to spread to other parts of the world?
entries.translation: Grace: Kawaran banaanka Shiinaha? Goormaa ayuu shaaha bilaabay inuu ku faafo qaybaha kale ee adduunka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: Tea was first introduced to Europe in the 16th century by Portuguese traders.
entries.translation: Macallinka: Shaaha waxaa markii ugu horreysay Yurub geeyay qarnigii 16aad ganacsato reer Bortuqiis ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It quickly became popular among European elites, and by the 18th century, tea had become a staple of British culture.
entries.translation: Waxay si degdeg ah caan uga dhex noqotay dadka caanka ah ee reer Yurub, qarnigii 18aad na, shaaha wuxuu noqday mid caan ka ah dhaqanka Ingiriiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the 19th century, tea was also introduced to North America, where it became a popular drink among both colonists and Native Americans.
entries.translation: Qarnigii 19aad, shaah ayaa sidoo kale la geeyay Waqooyiga Maraykanka, halkaas oo uu ka dhex noqoday cabitaan caan ah labada gumeystihii iyo Dhaladka Maraykanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Grace: That's really interesting.I never knew that tea had such a long history.
entries.translation: Grace: Taasi runtii waa mid xiiso leh.Weligay ma ogeyn in shaaha uu lahaa taariikh sidaa u dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Teacher: It's a fascinating story, and it's one that's still being written today.
entries.translation: Macallinka: Waa sheeko xiiso leh, waana mid wali la qorayo maanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: During World War II, the Allies and Axis powers used a variety of aircraft to achieve air superiority.
entries.translation: Intii lagu jiray Dagaalkii Labaad ee Adduunka, Awoodaha Allies iyo Axis waxay adeegsadeen diyaarado kala duwan si ay u gaaraan sarreynta hawada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most important factors in determining the outcome of a battle was the accuracy of the aircraft's bombing.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah arimaha ugu muhiimsan ee go'aaminta natiijada dagaalka ayaa ahayd saxnaanta duqeynta diyaaradda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The height at which an aircraft could fly was also a critical factor, as it determined how far it could travel and how much weight it could carry.
entries.translation: Dhererka ay diyaaradda ku duuli karto sidoo kale waxay ahayd arrin muhiim ah, maadaama ay go'aamisay inta ay ku socon karto iyo inta culeys ay qaadi karto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The United States developed a number of high-altitude bombers during the war, including the B-17 Flying Fortress and the B-29 Superfortress.
entries.translation: Maraykanka wuxuu soo saaray tiro duqaymo joog sare ah intii lagu jiray dagaalka, oo ay ku jiraan B-17 Flying Fortress iyo B-29 Superfortress.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were able to fly at altitudes of over 30,000 feet, which made them difficult for enemy fighters to intercept.
entries.translation: Diyaaradahaan waxay awoodeen inay ku duulaan joog ka sareeya 30,000 fiit, taas oo ku adkeysay dagaalyahannada cadowga inay dhexda u galaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also carried a large payload of bombs, which could be used to attack targets deep behind enemy lines.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale qaadeen bambooyin badan, kuwaas oo loo isticmaali karay in lagu weeraro bartilmaameedyada qoto dheer ee ka dambeeya khadadka cadowga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The German Luftwaffe also developed a number of high-altitude bombers, including the Heinkel He 177 Greif and the Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.translation: Jarmalka Luftwaffe wuxuu sidoo kale soo saaray tiro duqaymo joog sare ah, oo ay ku jiraan Heinkel He 177 Greif iyo Messerschmitt Me 264 Amerika Bomber.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These aircraft were not as successful as their American counterparts, however, due to a number of technical problems.
entries.translation: Diyaaradahan ayaan u guuleysan sida dhiggooda Mareykanka, hase yeeshe, dhibaatooyin farsamo oo dhowr ah awgood.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know what you did yesterday.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay waxaad sameysay shalay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You posted a picture of yourself wearing that green rag on social media.
entries.translation: Waxaad soo dhigtay baraha bulshada sawirkaaga adigoo xiran calalkaas cagaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you thought it was funny, but it wasn’t.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay inaad u maleysay inay tahay wax lagu qoslo, laakiin ma ahayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was disrespectful to your mother, and it hurt her feelings.
entries.translation: Waxay ixtiraam darro ku ahayd hooyadaa, waxayna dhaawacday dareenkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m not asking you to apologize because I’m mad at you.
entries.translation: Ma ku weydiisanayo inaad raali galin ka bixiso sababtoo ah waan kugu xanaaqay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I’m asking you to apologize because it’s the right thing to do.
entries.translation: Waxaan kuu weydiinayaa inaad raalin ka bixiso sababtoo ah waa wax sax ah in la sameeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Your mother loves you, and she deserves your respect.
entries.translation: Hooyadaa way ku jeceshahay, waxayna mudan tahay ixtiraamkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please call her today and tell her you’re sorry.
entries.translation: Fadlan wac maanta oo u sheeg inaad ka xuntahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her that you didn’t mean to hurt her feelings, and that you promise to never wear that green rag again.
entries.translation: U sheeg inaadan ula jeedin inaad dhaawacdo dareenkeeda, iyo inaad ballanqaadeyso inaadan mar dambe xirin calalkaas cagaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know you’re a good person, and I know you love your mother.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay inaad tahay qof wanaagsan, waana ogahay inaad hooyadaa jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, do the right thing and apologize.
entries.translation: Marka fadlan, samee waxa saxda ah oo raali gali.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After you apologize to your mother, I want you to burn that green rag.
entries.translation: Ka dib markaad raali geliso hooyadaa, waxaan rabaa inaad gubto calalkaas cagaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your disrespect, and it needs to be gone.
entries.translation: Waxay calaamad u tahay ixtiraam-darradaada, waxayna u baahan tahay inay meesha ka baxdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know it might be hard to let go of that rag, but it’s important.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay inay adkaan karto inaad meesha ka saarto calalkaas, laakiin waa muhiim.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It’s a symbol of your past, and it’s time to move on.
entries.translation: Waa astaanta ​​tagtadaadii, waana wakhtigii aad horay uga sii socon lahayd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You’re a new person now.
entries.translation: Waxaad tahay qof cusub hadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You’re a better person.
entries.translation: Waxaad tahay qof ka wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And you don’t need that rag to define you anymore.
entries.translation: Mana u baahnid calalkaas inuu mar dambe ku qeexo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So please, burn it.
entries.translation: Marka fadlan, gub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Burn it and let it go.
entries.translation: Guba oo ha tagto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And then go hug your mother and tell her you love her.
entries.translation: Kadibna orod oo hab sii hooyadaa oo u sheeg inaad jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loves you too.
entries.translation: Iyadana sidoo kale way ku jeceshahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A car was driving too fast and lost control, swerving into the other lane and hitting a car head-on.
entries.translation: Baabuur ayaa si xowli ah u socday oo xakamayntii lumiyay, waxa uu u leexday haadka kale kuna dhuftay gaari madaxa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The driver of the first car was killed instantly, and the driver of the second car was seriously injured.
entries.translation: Darawalkii gaariga koowaad ayaa isla markiiba la dilay, waxaana dhaawac halis ah soo gaaray darawalkii gaariga labaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend Joseph called me to talk about it.
entries.translation: Saaxiibkay Joseph ayaa isoo wacay si aan uga hadalno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's so sad," he said. "I can't imagine how the families of the victims are coping."
entries.translation: "Waa arrin murugo leh," ayuu yiri. "Ma qiyaasi karo sida qoysaska dhibbanayaasha ay ula tacaalayaan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Me neither," I responded. "It's a reminder that we need to be careful when we're driving.
entries.translation: "Aniga ma garanayo," Ayaan ku jawaabay. "Waxay na xusuusinaysa in aan u baahanahay inaan taxaddarno markaan baabuur wadnayno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Even a small mistake can have devastating consequences."

entries.english: "I agree," replied Jo. "We all need to follow the rules of the road and drive defensively."
entries.translation: “Waan ku raacsanahay,” ayuu ku jawaabay Jo. “Dhammaanteen waxaan u baahanahay inaan raacno xeerarka wadada oo aan si difaac leh u wadno.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," said Jo sheepishly. "I'm guilty of it myself sometimes."
entries.translation: “Waan ogahay,” ayuu yiri Jo si xishood leh. “Aniga naftayda ayaa dambi ku leh mararka qaarkood.”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the small town of Malgudi, there was a corrupt police inspector named Ramasamy.
entries.translation: Magaalada yar ee Malgudi, waxaa joogay kormeere booliis musuqmaasuq ah oo lagu magacaabo Ramasamy.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He would often take bribes from the people he arrested, and he would also use his power to harass and intimidate people.
entries.translation: Wuxuu inta badan laaluush ka qaadan jiray dadka uu xiro, wuxuuna sidoo kale awoodiisa u adeegsan jiray dhibaateynta iyo cabsi gelinta dadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, Ramasamy arrested a young man named Krishnan for a crime he did not commit.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, Ramasamy ayaa u xiray nin dhallinyaro ah oo la oran jiray Krishnan dambi uusan gelin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan was innocent, but Ramasamy refused to listen to him.
entries.translation: Krishnan wuxuu ahaa mid aan waxba galabsan, laakiin Ramasamy wuu diiday inuu dhagaysto isaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He demanded a bribe from Krishnan, and when Krishnan refused to pay, Ramasamy threw him in jail.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ka dalbaday laaluush Krishnan, markii Krishnan uu diidayna inuu bixiyo, Ramasamy wuxuu ku tuuray xabsi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Krishnan's father, a poor farmer, was desperate to get his son out of jail.
entries.translation: Krishnan aabihiis, oo ah beeraley sabool ah, wuxuu aad u doonayay inuu wiilkiisa kasoo saaro xabsiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He went to see Ramasamy and begged him to release Krishnan, but Ramasamy refused.
entries.translation: Wuxuu u aaday si uu u arko Ramasamy oo ka baryay inuu sii daayo Krishnan, laakiin Ramasamy wuu diiday.

entries.english: The farmer then went to the local temple and prayed to God for help.

entries.english: The next day, the farmer was walking home from the temple when he saw a large snake crossing the road.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The farmer was afraid of snakes, but he knew that he had to do something to help his son.

entries.english: It's typically aged in wooden barrels, which gives it its characteristic flavor.

entries.english: Rum can be enjoyed neat, on the rocks, or mixed in cocktails.

entries.english: There are many different types of rum, each with its own unique flavor profile.

entries.english: Light rum is typically made from molasses and has a light, sweet flavor.

entries.english: Rum is a versatile spirit that can be used in a variety of cocktails.

entries.english: Some classic rum cocktails include the daiquiri, the mojito, and the pina colada.

entries.english: We must reject the forces of division and hate.

entries.english: It growled at me and I could smell its breath, hot and reeking of death.
entries.translation: Wuu igu soo guuxay waxaana shiirin karay neeftisa, ee kulaylka iyo dhimashadaba ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that I must run, but my legs were leaden and I could not move.
entries.translation: Waan ogaa inay waajib igu tahay inaan cararo, laakiin lugahayga way cuslaadeen mana dhaqaaqi karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The dog came closer and closer, its teeth bared.
entries.translation: Aygii ayaa soo dhawaaday oo soo dhawaaday ilkihisa oo furan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I closed my eyes and waited for the end.
entries.translation: Indhaha ayaan isku qabtay waxaana sugay dhamaadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I heard a voice.
entries.translation: Laakin markaas waxaan maqlay cod.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a woman's voice, soft and gentle.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ahaa cod dumar, jilicsan oo dagan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Do not be afraid," she said. "I will help you."
entries.translation: "Ha baqin," ayeey tiri. "Waan ku caawin doonaa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I opened my eyes and saw the woman standing in front of me.
entries.translation: Indhaha ayaan kala furay waxaana arkay haweenaydii oo hortayda taagan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was tall and slender, with long black hair and dark eyes.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd mid dheer oo dhuuban, oo leh timo madow oo dhaadheer, iyo indho madow.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She wore a white dress that flowed around her like a mist.
entries.translation: Waxay xirnayd dhar cad oo ugu wareegsan sidii ceeryaamada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Who are you?" I asked. "I am the Angel of Death," she said.
entries.translation: "Kumaad tahay?" Ayaan waydiiyay. "waxan ahay Malaga Dhimashada," ayay tiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I have come to take you to the other side." I was not afraid anymore.
entries.translation: "Waxaan u imid inaan ku geeyo dhinaca kale." Mar dambe ma cabsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I knew that the woman would take me to a place where there was no pain or suffering.
entries.translation: Waan ogaa inay haweenayda ii wadi doonto meel aysan xanuun ama dhib ka jirin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took her hand and she led me away.
entries.translation: Gacanteeda ayaan qabsaday wayna i hogamisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As we walked, the black dog followed us.
entries.translation: Intaan sii soconay, aygi madowaa wuu na soo raacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm Dr. Boakye, a pediatrician at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.translation: Waxaan ahay Dhakhtar Boakye, dhakhtarka carruurta ee Korle Bu Teaching Hospital.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm here today to talk to you about the new malaria vaccine that's been approved for use in Ghana.
entries.translation: Waxaan halkaan ujogaa maanta inaan kaala hadlo wax ku sabsan talaalka cusub ee kaneecada taas oo la xaqijiyay sticmaalkiisa ee wadanka Ghana.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: I'm not interested in having my children vaccinated.
entries.translation: Aabo: Ma xiisaynayo in caruurtayda la talaalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand that you're concerned, but I'd like to take a few minutes to explain why I think it's a good idea to vaccinate your children against malaria.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Waan fahmayaa inay ku khusayso, laakiin waxaan jeclahay inaan dhowr daqiqado qaato si aan kuugu sharraxo sababta aan ugu maleynayo inay tahay fikir wanaagsan inaad caruurtaada ka talasho kaneecada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
