entries.english: Father: I don't need to be convinced. Malaria is a serious disease, but it's not that common in our village.
entries.translation: Aabaha: Marabo in laiga qanciyo. Kaneecada waa xanuun halis ah, laakiin maahan mid ku badan tuuladeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Father: But my children are healthy. They've never had malaria
entries.translation: Aabaha: Laakiin caruurtayda way caafimaad qabaan. Waligoodna kaneeco kuma dhicin
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's good, but it doesn't mean they're immune. Anyone can get malaria, even if they've never had it before.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taas way fican tahay, laakin micnaheeda ma ahan inay tallaalan yihiin. Qof walba ayay ku dhici kartaa kaneecada, hadaysan xitaa waligoood ku dhicin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "So, I was just on the internet, minding my own business, when I saw this pop-up ad that said I had a virus on my computer.
entries.translation: waxaan ku jiray kaliya interneetka, anigoo danahayga iska raacanaya, markaan arkay xayaysiiskaan soo booday ee sheegayay inuu cabuuq ku jiro kumbuyuutarkayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was like, "What? No way!"
entries.translation: Waxaan dhahay, "Wa maxay? Ma dhici karto!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But then I clicked on it, and it took me to this website that looked really official, and it said that I needed to download this software to fix the virus.
entries.translation: Laakiin markaas ayaan gujiyay, waxayna i gaysay mareegtaan taas oo runtii u muuqatay mid rasmi ah, waxaana ku qornaa inaan u baahanahay inaan soo dajiyo softiweerkaan si aan u hagaajiyo cabuqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So I did, and I installed it, and then it started filling my computer with all this malware.
entries.translation: Marka waan sameeyay, waana soo rakibay, kadibne waxay bilowday inay ka buuxiso kumbuyuutarkayga malware-kaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was so mad!
entries.translation: !Waan la yabaay
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I tried to uninstall it, but it wouldn't let me.
entries.translation: Waxaan isku dayay inaan iska tuuro, laakiin wuu iga diidaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I finally had to take my computer to a repair shop, and they had to wipe the whole thing and reinstall Windows.
entries.translation: Ugu danbeyn waxaan ku khasbanaaday kumbuyuutarkayga inaan u qaado dukaanka dayactirka lagu sameeyo, halkaso oo ay wax walbo tirtireen oona dib u soo rakibeen Windows-ka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a total nightmare.
entries.translation: Waxay gabi ahaanba ahayd qaraw.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, that's why I'm always so careful about clicking on pop-up ads.
entries.translation: Marka, taasi waa sababta aan mar walbo iskaga taxadaro inaan gujiyo xayaysiisyada soo booda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You never know what they're going to do.
entries.translation: Ma garan kartid waxa ay sameyn doonaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They could be filled with malware, or they could steal your personal information.
entries.translation: Waxaa ka buuxi kara malware, ama waxay xadi karaan macluumaadkaaga gaarka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's just not worth the risk.
entries.translation: Ma istaahisho khatarta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you ever see a pop-up ad that looks suspicious, just close it and don't click on it.
entries.translation: Haddii aad waligaa aragto xayaysiis soo booda oo u muuqda mid laga shakin karo, iska xir oo ha gijin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And if you're ever not sure whether or not it's safe, just don't do it.
entries.translation: Haddii aadan waligaa hubin inay badqabto iyo in kale, kaliya ha sameyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a delicious pork dish from the county of Lancashire.
entries.translation: Waa kan saxan doofaar oo maacan ee gobolka Lancashire.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
entries.translation: 1. Yara kululee foornada ilaa 180 digriii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2. Trim the pork belly of any excess fat and score the skin in a criss-cross pattern.
entries.translation: 2. Ka jar caloosha doofaarka dufan kasta oo dheeri ah oo maqaarka ku dheji qaab istilaab ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. In a bowl, mix together the mustard, treacle, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce and oil.
entries.translation: 3. Bsaquli, isku qas mustard, treacle, qalka, maraqa Worcestershire iyo saliida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rub this mixture all over the pork belly.
entries.translation: Mari isku darkaan dhammaan caloosha doofaarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Place the pork belly in a roasting tin and roast in the oven for 2 hours, or until the skin is golden brown and the meat is cooked through.
entries.translation: 4. Caloosha doofaarka ku rid saxanka foornada oo ku dub foornada 2 saacadood, ama ilaa maqaarka uu noqdo buni dahab ah oo hilibkana karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. While the pork is roasting, finely chop the onion, garlic, bay leaves and thyme.
entries.translation: 5. Inta uu hilbka doofaarka dubmaayo, si fiican u jarjar basasha, toonta, caleemaha baybalka iyo milixda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He is widely regarded as one of the most significant figures in world history.
entries.translation: Waxaa lagu tiriyaa inuu yahay mid ka mid ah shakhsiyaadka ugu muhiimsan taariikhda adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was born in 1918 in Mvezo, South Africa.
entries.translation: Mnadela wuxuu ku dhashay 1918-kii Mvezo, koofur Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He grew up in a rural village and was educated at a Methodist mission school.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku koray tuulo miyi ah wuxuna wax ku bartay dugsiga howlgalka Methodist.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After high school, he studied law at the University of Fort Hare.
entries.translation: Dugsiga sare ka dib, wuxuu ka bartay sharciga Jaamacad Fort Hare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1944, he joined the African National Congress (ANC), a political organization that was fighting against apartheid.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1944-kii wuxuu ku biiray Africa National Congrees (ANC), urur siyaasadeed la dagaalama midab-takoorka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela was arrested for his political activities in 1962 and sentenced to life in prison.
entries.translation: Mandela waxaa loo xiray dhaqdhaqaaqiisa siyaasadeed 1962-kii, waxaana lagu xukumay xabsi daa'in.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He spent 27 years in prison, during which time he became a symbol of the anti-apartheid movement.
entries.translation: Wuxuu xabsiga ku jiray 27 sano, illigaas oo uu astaan ​​u noqday dhaqdhaqaaqii ka dhanka ahaa midab-takoorka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1990, Mandela was released from prison and elected president of South Africa in 1994.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1990-kii, Mandela ayaa laga sii daayay xabsiga, waxaana loo doortay madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika 1994-tii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As president, Mandela worked to unite South Africa and promote reconciliation between blacks and whites.
entries.translation: Madaxweyne ahaan, Mandela waxa uu ka shaqeeyay midaynta Koonfur Afrika iyo horumarinta dib u heshiisiinta madowga iyo caddaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He also oversaw the end of apartheid and the transition to a democratic government.
entries.translation: Wuxuu sidoo kale kormeeray dhamaynta midab-takoorka u gudbinta dawlada dimuqraadi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mandela is a Nobel Peace Prize laureate and has been awarded numerous other honors.
entries.translation: Mandela waxa uu ku guuleystey biladda nabadda ee Nobel Peace Prize waxaana la guddoonsiiyey abaalmarino kale oo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After school, I usually go home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Dugsiga ka dib, inta badan guriga ayaan aadaa waxaana sameeyaa shaqada guriga la iigu soo diray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might watch TV or play video games.
entries.translation: Markaa waxaa laga yaba inaan taleefishinka daawado ama ciyaar ciyaarta muuqaalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sometimes I go out with my friends.
entries.translation: Mararka qaar waxaan racaa saxiibaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go to the movies, or to a park, or just hang out at someone's house.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga yabaa inaan filimada aadno ama beerta ama aan joogno guriga qofkeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On weekends, I often sleep in late.
entries.translation: Dhamaadka isbuucyada waxaan seexda badanaa wakhti dambe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then I might go shopping, or see a movie, or go to a museum.
entries.translation: Kadib waxaa laga yabaa inaan aadno dukaamaysi ama filin soo daawano, ama aadno madxafka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also like to spend time with my family.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale jeclahay inaan wakhti la qaato qoyskayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We might go out to dinner, or play games, or just watch TV together.
entries.translation: Waxaa la yaabaa inaan aadno casho, ama ciyaaro ciyaarno, ama aan taleefishin wada daawano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm really enjoying my life after school.
entries.translation: Runtii aad ayaan ugu raaxaystaa noloshayda dugsiga ka dib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I have a lot of freedom, and I can do whatever I want.
entries.translation: Waxaan haystaa xornimo badan, waxaana sameyn karaa waxaan rabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also learning a lot about myself, and about the world around me.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale wax badan ka baranayaa naftayda, iyo aduunka igu wareegsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm excited to see what the future holds.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku farxasanahay inaan arko waxa mustaqbalka noqon doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Using data to help people with mental health issues is a relatively new field, but it is showing great promise.
entries.translation: Isticamaalka xogta si loo caawiyo dadka qaba arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka waa goob cusub, laakiin waxay muujinaysaa ballanqaad weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One example is the use of data to personalize therapy for patients.
entries.translation: Hal tusaale ayaa ah isticmaalka xogta si loo gaaryeelo daawaynta bukaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By looking at a patient's individual data, therapists can better understand their needs and create a treatment plan that is tailored to them.
entries.translation: Marka la eego xogta gaarka ah ee bukaanka, daaweeyayaasha waxay si fiican u fahmi karaan baahidooda oo ay u abuuri karaan qorshe daaweyn oo iyaga ku habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to better outcomes for patients, as they are more likely to receive the help that they need.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa natiijooyin wanaagsan bukaanada, maadaama ay u badan tahay inay helaan caawinaada ay u baahan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The study also found that the patients who received personalized therapy were more likely to stay in treatment for longer periods of time.
entries.translation: Daraasada waxay sidoo kale ogaatay bukaanada helay daaweynta gaarka ah ay u badan tahay inay ku sii jiraan daawaynta wakhti dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This study is just one example of how data can be used to improve mental health care.
entries.translation: Daraasadaan waa hal tusaale oo ka mid ah sida xogta loo isticmaali karo si loo horumariyo daryeelka caafimaadka dhimirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As more research is done in this area, we can expect to see even more advances in the use of data to help people with mental health issues.
entries.translation: Maaddaama cilmi-baaris dheeraad ah lagu sameeyay aaggan, waxaan filan karnaa inaan aragno xitaa horumarro badan oo xagga isticmaalka xogta ah si loo caawiyo dadka qaba arrimaha caafimaadka dhimirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My sister is a therapist who uses data to help her patients.
entries.translation: Walashay wa dhakhtarka taasoo isticmaasho xog si ay u caawiso bukaanadeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Freshwater lakes are home to a wide variety of flora and fauna, from microscopic algae to large fish and mammals.
entries.translation: Harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah waxay hoy u yihiin noocyo kala duwan oo flora iyo fauna ah, laga bilaabo microscopic algae ilaa kalluunka waaweyn iyo naasleyda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The unique environment of freshwater lakes provides a variety of habitats for these organisms, and the interactions between them are complex and fascinating.
entries.translation: Deegaanka u gaarka ah ee harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah waxay siiyaan degaanno kala duwan noolahaan, isdhexgalka ka dhexeeyana waa mid adag oo soo jiidasho leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most striking features of freshwater lakes is the presence of a distinct zonation of plant life, which is determined by the depth of the water and the amount of sunlight that reaches the bottom.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah sifooyinka ugu yaabka badan ee harooyinka biyaha saafiga ayaa ah joogitaanka aag gaar ah ee nolosha dhirta ah, taas oo lagu go'aamiyo qoto dheeraanta biyaha iyo qadarka iftiinka qorraxda ee gaara hoosta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In shallow areas, where there is plenty of light, a dense mat of rooted plants known as a "macrophyte bed" forms.
entries.translation: Meelaha gacmeedka, halkaas oo uu jiro iftiin badan, sariir cufan oo dhir xidid leh oo loo yaqaan "sariirta macrophyte" ayaa sameysmata.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This provides a habitat for a variety of invertebrates, fish, and amphibians.
entries.translation: Tani waxay siisaa degaan loogu talagalay noocyo kala duwan oo ah xayawaanka laf dhabarta lahayn, kalluunka, iyo amphibians.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In deeper areas, where there is less light, the water column is dominated by phytoplankton, which are microscopic algae that float freely in the water.
entries.translation: Meelaha qotada dheer, halkaasoo iftiin yar uu jiro, tiirka biyaha waxaa u badan phytoplankton, kuwaas oo ah algae yar yar oo si xor ah u sabeynaya biyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These organisms are the primary producers in the lake ecosystem, and they are the basis of the food chain.
entries.translation: Noolahaan waa kuwa ugu horreeya ee soo saara nidaamka deegaanka harada, waana saldhigga silsiladda cuntada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fauna of freshwater lakes is also diverse, and includes a wide variety of fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds, and mammals.
entries.translation: Xayawaanka harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah sidoo kale waa kala duwan yihiin, waxaana ku jira noocyo kala duwan oo kalluun ah, amphibians, xamaaratada, shimbiraha, iyo naasleyda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fish are the most abundant vertebrates in freshwater lakes, and they play a vital role in the food chain.
entries.translation: Kaluunka wa xayawanka laf-dhabarka leh ee ugu badan ee harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah, waxayna door muhiim ah ka ciyaaraan silsiladda cuntada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some of the most common fish species in freshwater lakes include trout, bass, pike, and perch.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah noocyada kalluunka ee ugu caansan harooyinka biyaha saafiga ah waxaa ka mid ah kalluun, bass, pike, iyo perch.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, the storage area is also equipped with a fire alarm system, so that if there is a fire, the alarm will sound and the fire department will be notified.
entries.translation: Sidoo kale waxaa goobta kaydka ah lagu rakibay nidaamka digniinta dabka, si haddii uu dab kaco uu qaylo dhaantaasi soo baxayso, isla markaana lagu wargelinayo waaxda dab-damiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The storage area is also regularly inspected by the fire department, so that any potential fire hazards can be identified and addressed before they become a problem.
entries.translation: Sidoo kale goobta kaydka waxaa si joogto ah u kormeera waaxda dabka, si loo ogaado khataraha dabka ka dhalan kara waxna looga qabto ka hor inta aysan dhibaato noqon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Tallaabooyinkan awgood, goobta kaydka waa meel nabdoon oo ammaan ah oo lagu kaydiyo alaabo qiimaha leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the fire safety measures, the storage area is also equipped with a security system to protect against theft.
entries.translation: Tallaabooyinka badbaadada waxaa dheer, goobta kaydka ayaa sidoo kale lagu qalabeeyay nidaam ammaan oo ka ilaalinaya tuugada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The security system consists of a surveillance camera, a burglar alarm, and a security guard.
entries.translation: Nidaamka ammaanka waxa uu ka kooban yahay kaamirado wax ilaaliya, qaylo-dhaanta tuugta, iyo waardiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result of these security measures, the storage area is a safe and secure place to store valuable goods.
entries.translation: Tallaabooyinkan amniga awgood, in goobta kaydinta ay tahay meel nabdoon oo ammaan ah oo lagu kaydiyo alaabo qiima leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook Users Drunkenly Post About Their Lives
entries.translation: Isticmaalayaasha Facebook-ga Ayaa Iaygoo Sarqaansan Soo Dhigo Wax Ku Saabsan Noloshooda
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook users are getting drunk and posting about their lives, and it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Isticmaalayaasha Facebook-ga ayaa sakhraansan oo soo dhiga wax ku saabsan noloshooda, waxayna abuurtay buuq.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some users are concerned that the trend is dangerous, as it could lead to people making poor decisions or doing things they regret.
entries.translation: Isticmaalayaasha qaarkood waxay ka walaacsan yihiin in isbeddelka yahay mid khatar ah, sababtoo ah waxay u horseedi kartaa dadka inay qaataan go'aanno xun ama sameeyaan waxyaabo ay ka qoomameeyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Others are simply amused by the antics of their fellow drunk Facebook users.
entries.translation: Qaar kale ayaa si fudud loogu maaweeliya nacaybka saaxiibadood isticmaalayaasha kale ee sakhraansan ee Facebook-ga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One user posted a photo of herself passed out on the floor with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even stand up."
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah isticmaalayaasha ayaa soo galiyay sawir iyada oo dhulka jiifta iyada oo qoraal ku leh, "Aad ayaan u sakhraansanahay xitaa ma istaagi karo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another user shared a video of herself dancing on a table while shouting, "I'm the life of the party!"
entries.translation: Isticmaale kale ayaa wadaagay muuqaal iyada oo ku qoob ka ciyaareysa miiska iyadoo ku qaylinaysa, "Waxaan ahay nolosha xaflada!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trend has even caught the attention of celebrities.
entries.translation: Isbeddelka ayaa xitaa soo jiitay dareenka dadka caanka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Comedian Amy Schumer posted a photo of herself on Twitter with the caption, "I'm so drunk I can't even spell my own name."
entries.translation: Majaajiliistaha Amy Schumer ayaa barteeda Twitter-ka soo dhigtay sawirkeeda iyada oo soo raacisay “Aad ayaan u sakhraansanahay xitaa ma hingaadi karo magacayga”.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Facebook has not commented on the trend, but it's clear that it's causing a stir.
entries.translation: Facebook-ga wax faallo ah kama bixin arrintaan, laakiin way caddahay inay dhalinayso buuq.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Only time will tell whether the trend will continue or fade away.
entries.translation: Wakhtiga kaliya ayaa sheegi doona in isbeddelka sii socon doono ama uu sii dhammaan doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.
entries.translation: Zambia waa wadan aan bad lahayn oo ku yaala Koonfurta Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia has a population of over 17 million people and a land area of 752,618 square kilometers.
entries.translation: Zambia waxa ku nool in ka badan 17 milyan oo qof, dhul ahaanna waa 752,618 kilomitir oo laba jibbaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia's current president is Hakainde Hichilema, who was elected in August 2021.
entries.translation: Madaxweynaha Zambia hadda waa Hakainde Hichilema, oo la doortay Agoosto 2021.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hichilema is a member of the United Party for National Development (UPND).
entries.translation: Hichilema wa xubin ka tirsan Xisbiga Midowga Horumarinta Qaranka (UPND).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The UPND is the largest opposition party in Zambia.
entries.translation: UPND waa xisbi mucaaradka ugu weyn Zambia.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The economy of Zambia is based on copper mining.
entries.translation: Dhaqaalaha Zambia wuxu ku tiirsan yahay macdanta naxaasta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Copper is the country's largest export.
entries.translation: Naxaasta wa dhoofinta ugu weyn ee dalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important exports include cobalt, zinc, and lead.
entries.translation: Dhoofinada kale ee muhiimka ah waxaa ka mid ah, cobalt, zinc, iyo lead.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Zambian economy has been struggling in recent years due to low copper prices.
entries.translation: Dhaqaalaha Zambia wuxu ahaa mid lagu dhib qabo sanadihii ugu dambeeyay sababtoo ah qiimaha naxaasta oo hooseeya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Zambia is a member of the United Nations, the African Union, and the Southern African Development Community (SADC).
entries.translation: Zambia waxay xubin ka tahay Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika, iyo Ururka Horumarinta Koonfurta Afrika (SADC).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The signing of Lionel Messi by Paris Saint-Germain sent shockwaves through the world of soccer.
entries.translation: Saxiixa Lionel Messi ee Paris Saint-Germain ayaa argagax ku riday caalamka kubbada cagta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Argentine superstar had been one of the most coveted players in the world for years, and his arrival in Paris marked a major turning point in the club's history.
entries.translation: Xiddiga reer Argentine wuxuu ka mid ahaa xiddigaha loogu doonista badan yahay adduunka muddo sanado ah, imaashihiisa Paris waxay wax weyn ka bedeshay taariikhda naadiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi had spent his entire professional career with Barcelona, where he had won everything there was to win.
entries.translation: Messi waxa uu xirfadiisa oo dhan ku qaatay Barcelona, ​​halkaas oo uu kula guulaystay wax walba oo uu ku guulaysan lahaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But after a tumultuous few months, he decided to leave the club and sign with PSG.
entries.translation: Laakin dhowr bilood oo buuq badan ka dib, wuxuu go’aansaday inuu isaga tago kooxda oo uu la saxiixdo PSG.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The move was a major coup for PSG, who were looking to add a superstar to their squad in order to compete for the Champions League title.
entries.translation: Talaabadan ayaa afgambi wayn u ahayd kooxda PSG oo doonaysay in ay kooxdeeda ku soo kordhiso xidig wayn si ay ugu tartanto koobka Horyaalada Yurub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Messi's signing was met with excitement by PSG fans, who were eager to see the world's best player in action.
entries.translation: Saxiixa Messi ayaa waxaa farxad kala kulmay taageerayaasha PSG, oo aad u doonayay inay arkaan xidiga aduunka ugu fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But there were also some concerns about how he would fit into the team.
entries.translation: Laakiin waxaa sidoo kale jiray walaac ku saabsan sida uu ugu habboonaan doono kooxda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PSG already had a number of talented players, and it was unclear how Messi would be able to work with them.
entries.translation: PSG ayaa horay u haysatay ciyaartoy tayo leh, mana cadayn sida uu Messi ula shaqayn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of Mice and Men is a novel by John Steinbeck that tells the story of two migrant workers, George and Lennie, who travel together in search of work during the Great Depression.
entries.translation: Mice iyo Men waa buuga uu John Steinbeck oo kaga warramaya sheekada laba shaqaale oo soo galooti ah, George iyo Lennie, kuwaas oo u wada safra shaqo raadis intii lagu jiray Niyad-jabka Weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The novel is set in a time and place where the American Dream is all but dead, and the only way to survive is to stick together and look out for each other.
entries.translation: Buuga waxa loo qorsheyay wakhti iyo goob halkaas ay ku dhammaanayso Riyadii Maraykanka, sida keliya ee lagu badbaadi karaana waa in la isku dhego oo la is dhowro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George and Lennie are both dreamers.
entries.translation: George iyo Lennie labaduba waxay ahyeen kuwa riyooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George dreams of one day owning a farm, where he and Lennie can live in peace and harmony.
entries.translation: George wuxuu ku riyoodaa hal maalin inuu beer yeesho, halkaas oo ay isaga iyo Lennie ay ku wada noolaan karaan nabad iyo iswaafaqsanaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lennie dreams of petting soft rabbits and being gentle with them.
entries.translation: Lennie waxa uu ku riyoodaa inuu xanaanaysto bakeylaha jilicsan oo uu u naxariisto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But their dreams are constantly thwarted by the harsh realities of the world they live in.
entries.translation: Laakiin riyooyinkooda waxaa si joogto ah u fashiliya xaqiiqada qallafsan ee adduunka ay ku nool yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, George and Lennie find work on a ranch in California.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, George iyo Lennie waxay shaqo ka heleen beer ku taal California.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are immediately befriended by Candy, an old ranch hand who is missing an arm.
entries.translation: Waxay isla markiiba saaxiib la noqdeen Candy, oo ah gacan beer duug ah oo cudud ka maqan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Candy tells George and Lennie about his dream of one day owning a small farm, and the three men decide to pool their money together to buy a farm.
entries.translation: Candy waxa uu George iyo Lennie u sheegay riyadiisii ​​ahayd in uu maalin uun yeesho beer yar, waxaanay saddexda nin go’aansadeen in ay lacagtooda isu geeyaan si ay beer u iibsadaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But their plans are once again thwarted when Lennie accidentally kills a woman.
entries.translation: Laakiin qorshayaashooda ayaa mar kale la fashiliyay markii Lennie ay si lama filaan ah u dishay haweeney.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George is forced to shoot Lennie to prevent him from being lynched.
entries.translation: George wuxuu ku qasbanaaday inuu toogto Lennie si uu uga hortago in dal dalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: George is devastated by Lennie's death, but he knows that it was the only thing he could do.
entries.translation: George aad ayuu uga xumaaday dhimashada Lennie, laakiin wuu ogyahay inay ahayd waxa kaliya ee uu samayn karay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: I'm so itchy! I think I have lice.
entries.translation: A: Aad ayaan isu cuncunayaa! Waxaan u maleynayaa inay injir igu jirto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: Oh no! That's terrible.
entries.translation: B: Allaa maya! Midaasi waa khatar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know how to get rid of them, though.
entries.translation: Waan garanayaaa sida looga taqaluso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We can use a traditional remedy.
entries.translation: Waxaan isticmaali karnaa daawo dhaqameed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: What is it?
entries.translation: A: Maxaa waaye?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: We'll need some olive oil, some lemon juice, and a few cloves of garlic.
entries.translation: B: Waxaan u baahan doonaa xoogaa salida saytuun ah, xoogaa cabitaan liin ah, iyo dhowr jeex oo toon ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Okay, I have all of that. What do we do with it?
entries.translation: A: Haye, waan haystaa dhammaan kuwaas. Maxaan ku sameynaynaa kuwaas?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: First, we'll mix the olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic together.
entries.translation: B: Marka hore, waxaan isku qasaynaa saliida saytuunta, cabitaanka liinta, iyo toonta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, we'll apply it to your hair and scalp.
entries.translation: Ka dibna, waxaan mari doonaa tintaada iyo lafta madaxa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We'll let it sit for about an hour.
entries.translation: Waxaan u dayn doonaa ilaa hal saac.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: An hour? That sounds like a long time.
entries.translation: A: Saacad? Taasi waxay u muuqataa wakhti dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: B: It is, but it's worth it.
entries.translation: B: Way tahay, laakiin way u qalantaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The oil will help to suffocate the lice and the lemon juice will help to kill them.
entries.translation: Saliida waxay kaa caawin doontaa inay neefsato injirta iyo cabitaanka liin dhanaantana waxay kaa caawin doontaa inay disho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The garlic will help to repel them.
entries.translation: Toonta waxay kaa caawin doontaa inay iska celiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A: Okay, I'll do it.
entries.translation: A: Haye, waan sameyn doonaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Mommy, what are those?" the toddler asked, pointing at the plants in the living room.
entries.translation: "Hooyo, waa maxay waxaas?" socod baradka ayaa weydiiyey, isaga oo farta ku fiiqaya dhirta qolka fadhiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Those are plants," Mommy replied "They're living things, just like you and me."
entries.translation: "Kuwaasi waa dhir," Ayay hooyo ugu jawaabtay "Waa noole, sida adiga iyo aniga oo kale."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch them?" the toddler asked.
entries.translation: "Ma taaban karaa?" ayuu socod baradka waydiiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Yes, you can, but be gentle," Mommy said "The leaves are fragile."
entries.translation: "Haa, waad taaban kartaa, laakiin si tartiib ah," Hooyo ayaa tiri "Caleemaha waa jilicsan yihiin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler reached out and touched a leaf.
entries.translation: Socod baradkii ayaa soo gaaray oo taabtay caleen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The leaf felt soft and smooth.
entries.translation: Caleenta waxay ahayd mid jilicsan oo siman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I like it," the toddler said.
entries.translation: "Waan ka helay," socod baradka ayaa yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I'm glad," Mommy said. "Plants are good for us. They help clean the air and make us feel better."
entries.translation: "Waan ku faraxsanahay," ayay tiri hooyo. "Dhirta way noo fiican yihiin, waxay naga caawiyaan nadiifinta hawada waxayna na dareensiiyaan wanaag."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler continued to look at the plants. Then, he noticed a cable running along the floor.
entries.translation: Socod baradka ayaa sii waday inuu eego dhirta. Kadib, waxa uu arkay fiilo dhulka dhex maraysa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "What's that?" he asked.
entries.translation: "Waa maxay waxaas?" ayuu weydiiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's a cable," Mommy said.
entries.translation: "Taasi waa fiilo," Hooyadii ayaa tiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "It's used to connect the TV to the wall."
entries.translation: "Waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagula xiro TV-ga darbiga."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Can I touch it?" the toddler asked.
entries.translation: "Ma taaban karaa?" socod baradka ayaa weydiiyey.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "No, you can't," Mommy said. "Cables can be dangerous.They can give you a shock."
entries.translation: "Maya ma taaban kartid," Hooyadi ayaa tiri. "Fiilooyinka waxay noqon karaan khatar. Way kaa nixin karaan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The toddler looked disappointed, but he didn't touch the cable.
entries.translation: Socod baradka ayaa u muuqday mid niyad jabsan, laakiin ma taaban fiilada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Birthdays are a time to celebrate the day you were born.
entries.translation: Maalamah dhalashada waa wakhti loo dabaaldego maalinta aad dhalatay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a day to reflect on all the good things in your life and to thank those who have made you who you are.
entries.translation: Waa maalin aad ka fikirto wax kasta oo wanaagsan oo noloshaada ah oodna u mahadceliso kuwa kaa dhigay qofka aad tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a day to set goals for the year ahead and to make plans for the future.
entries.translation: Sidoo kale waa maalin ay tahay in la dejisto hadafyada sanadka soo socda iyo in la dejiyo qorshayaasha mustaqbalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To make the most of your birthday, start by making a list of all the things you are grateful for.
entries.translation: Si aad uga faa'iidaysato maalinta dhalashadaada, ku billow samaynta liiska dhammaan waxyaalaha aad ka mahad naqayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include your family, friends, health, home, job, or anything else that is important to you.
entries.translation: Tan waxaa ku jiri kara qoyskaaga, asxaabtaada, caafimaadkaaga, gurigaaga, shaqada, ama wax kasta oo kale oo muhiim kuu ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have made your list, take some time to reflect on each item and how it has made your life better.
entries.translation: Marka aad samaysid liiskaaga, qaado wakhti aad dib ugu milicsato shay kasta iyo sida ay noloshaada u wanaajisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Next, set some goals for the year ahead.
entries.translation: Marka xigta, daji qaar ka mid ah hadafyada sanadka soo socda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These goals can be anything you want them to be, but they should be specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound.
entries.translation: Hadafyadaan waxay noqon karaan wax kasta oo aad rabto inay noqdaan, laakiin waa inay ahaadaan kuwo gaar ah, la qiyaasi karo, la gaari karo, khuseeya, iyo wakhti xaddidan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: For example, you might set a goal to lose weight, get a promotion at work, or travel to a new place.
entries.translation: Tusaale ahaan, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad dejiso hadaf aad ku dhimi karto miisaankaaga, aad ku heli karto dallacaad shaqo, ama aad u safarto meel cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, make plans for the day of your birthday.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntii, qorsheyso maalinta dhalashadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could include spending time with your loved ones, eating your favorite foods, or doing something you have always wanted to do.
entries.translation: Tan waxaa ka mid noqon kara inaad wakhti la qaadato kuwa aad jeceshahay, cunista cuntooyinka aad jeceshahay, ama samaynta wax aad waligaa rabtay inaad samayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Romantic Comedies are so unrealistic.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Majaajilada jecaylka waa mid aan macquul aheyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: I know, right? The love interests always fall in love at first sight, and they never have any problems.
entries.translation: Qofka 2aad: Waan ogahay, sax? Xiisaha jacaylka had iyo jeer waxay ku dhacaan jacayl aragtida koowaad, weligoodna wax dhibaato ah ma qabaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: And the conflicts are always so contrived.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Isku dhacyadana had iyo jeer waa kuwo la soo maleego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Like, in one movie, the couple broke up because the guy's best friend was in love with the girl.
entries.translation: Sida hal filim, lamaanaha ayaa ku kala tagay sababtoo ah ninka saaxiibkiisa ugu fiican ayaa jeclaaday gabadha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: That's so ridiculous. It's not like that happens in real life.
entries.translation: Qofka 2aad: Taasi waa wax aad u qosol badan. Ma aha sidaas oo kale inay dhacdo nolosha dhabta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: Exactly. And even when they do get together, it's always so perfect.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Dhab ahaantii. Xataa marka ay isu yimaadaan, had iyo jeer aad bay u qumman tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They never have any fights or disagreements.
entries.translation: Weligood dagaal iyo ismaandhaaf midna ma yeelan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 2: It's like the movies are trying to tell us that love is always easy and perfect.
entries.translation: Qofka 2aad: Waxay la mid tahay filimada ay isku dayayaan inay noo sheegaan in jacaylka marwalba yahay mid sahlan oo qumman.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But that's not the case.
entries.translation: Laakiin xaaladda sidaas maaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Love is hard work.
entries.translation: Jecaylka waa shaqo adag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It takes time and effort to build a lasting relationship.
entries.translation: Waxay qaadataa wakhti iyo dadaal si loo dhiso xiriir waara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Person 1: I know. That's why I don't watch rom-coms anymore.
entries.translation: Qofka 1aad: Waan ogahay. Taasi waa sababta aanan u daawan rom-coms dambe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They give people unrealistic expectations about love.
entries.translation: Waxay dadka siyaan filashooyin aan macquul ahayn oo ku saabsan jacaylka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My first day of school was a day I will never forget.
entries.translation: Maalintii ugu horeysay ee aan dugsiga bilaabay waxay ahayd maalin aanan ilaawi doonin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was both excited and nervous, not knowing what to expect.
entries.translation: Waxaan ahaa mid farxsan oo hadana kacsan, ma garanayn waxa aan filan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I woke up that morning, I got dressed quickly and ate a quick breakfast.
entries.translation: Subaxaas markii aan soo toosay, si degdeg ah ayaan u labistay oo waxaan cunay quraac fudud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, my mom drove me to school and walked me to my classroom.
entries.translation: Kadib, hooyaday waxay ii kaxaysay dugsiga waxayna ii soo lugaysiisay fasalkayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When I walked into the classroom, I was immediately greeted by my teacher, Ms. Smith.
entries.translation: Markii aan soo galay fasalka, waxaa isla markiiba isalaamay macalinkayga, Marwo. Smith.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was a kind-looking woman with a warm smile.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd haweenay naxariis badan oo dhoola cadeyn fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She introduced herself to me and then showed me to my seat.
entries.translation: Way iskay bartay kadibna waxay itustay kursigaygii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I sat down next to a girl named Sarah.
entries.translation: Waxaan ag fadhiistay gabar la yiraahdo Sarah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled at me and said, "Hi, I'm Sarah."
entries.translation: Way ii dhoola cadeysay waxayna itiri, "Haye, waxaan ahay Sarah."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I smiled back and said, "Hi, I'm Vera."
entries.translation: Dib ayaan ugu dhoola cadeeyey oo waxaan ku iri, "Haye, waxaan ahay Vera."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a few minutes before the bell rang for class to start.
entries.translation: Dhawr daqiiqo ayaan wada hadalnay ka hor inta aan gambaleelka la garaacin si uu fasalka u bilaabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ms. Smith began by introducing herself and telling us about the rules of the classroom.
entries.translation: Marwo Smith waxay bilowday inay iskeen barto iyadoo noo sheegaysa wax ku sabsan sharciga fasalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, she started teaching us about math.
entries.translation: Ka dibna, waxay bilowday inay wax naga barto xisaab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I was a little bit confused at first, but Ms. Smith explained everything clearly.
entries.translation: Markii hore waan yara wareeray, laakiin Marwo. Smith ayaa wax walba si cad u sharaxday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: After math class, we had a break.
entries.translation: Fasalka xisabta kadib waxan lahayn fasax.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sarah and I went outside to play on the playground.
entries.translation: Aniga iyo Sarah waxaan u baxnay banaanka si aan ugu ciyaarno garoonka ciyaarta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We played on the swings and the slide for a while, then we went back inside for lunch.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku ciyaarnay wiifoowyaasha iyo silixda, ka dib waxaan dib ugu laabanay gudaha si aan qado u cunno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is injured, the body’s immune system sends white blood cells to the area.
entries.translation: Marka nuddo uu dhaawacmo, habka difaaca jirka wuxuu u diraa unugyo cadcad oo dhiigga ah goobta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause blood vessels to dilate and become more permeable.
entries.translation: Unugyadani waxay soo daayaan kiimikooyin keena in xididdada dhiigga ay balaartaan oo ay noqdaan kuwo daloola.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This allows fluid and white blood cells to leak out of the blood vessels and into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u oggolaanaysaa dareeraha iyo unugyada dhiigga cad inay ka soo baxaan xididdada dhiigga oo galaan nudaha dhaawacan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The fluid forms a clear, watery swelling called edema.
entries.translation: Dheecaanka wuxuu sameeyaa barar muuqda, oo biyo leh oo loo yaqaan barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The white blood cells help to fight infection and to remove damaged tissue.
entries.translation: Unugyada dhiiga cad waxa ay caawiyaan la dagaalanka caabuqa iyo inay saaraan nudaha waxyeelooba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They also release chemicals that stimulate the growth of new tissue.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale sii daayaan kiimikooyin kicinaya koritaanka nuddo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The classic signs of acute inflammation are redness, heat, swelling, and pain.
entries.translation: Calaamadaha caadiga ah ee bararka degdega ah waa casaan, kulayl, barar, iyo xanuun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These signs are caused by the increased blood flow and the release of chemicals in the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Calaamadahaan waxaa sababa qulqulka dhiigga oo kordha iyo sii deynta kiimikooyinka ku jira nudaha dhaawacan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Redness is caused by the dilation of blood vessels.
entries.translation: Guduudka waxaa sababa balaarinta xididdada dhiigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Heat is caused by the increased blood flow and the release of inflammatory chemicals.
entries.translation: Kulaylka waxaa sababa qulqulka dhiigga oo kordha iyo sii daynta kiimikooyinka bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Swelling is caused by the leakage of fluid from blood vessels into the injured tissue.
entries.translation: Bararka waxaa sababa dareeraha ka soo daadanaya xididdada dhiigga ee gala nudaha dhaawacan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain is caused by the release of inflammatory chemicals and the pressure of the swelling.
entries.translation: Xanuunka waxaa sabab sii deynta kiimikooyinka bararka iyo cadaadiska bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is a normal part of the healing process.
entries.translation: Bararaka ba'an waa qayb caadi ah oo ka mid ah habka bogsashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if it is severe or prolonged, it can damage healthy tissue.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haddii ay daran tahay ama ay daba dheeraato, waxay waxyeeleen kartaa nuddo caafimaad qaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, acute inflammation can lead to chronic inflammation, which is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, bararka degdega ah wuxuu horseedi karaa caabuq daba dheeraad ah, taas oo ah xaalad wakhti dheer ah oo sababi karta xanuun, naafo, iyo xitaa dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are a number of things that can cause acute inflammation, including infection, injury, and autoimmune diseases.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira dhowr waxyaalood oo sababi kara barar daba dheeraad ah, oo ay ku jiraan infegshonka, dhaawac, iyo cudurrada difaaca jirka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Infections are caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
entries.translation: Infegshonka waxaa sababi karo bakteeria, cabuuq, ama fungi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When these organisms enter the body, they can trigger an immune response that leads to inflammation.
entries.translation: Marka ay noolahaan soo galaan jirka, waxay kicin karaan jawaab celin difaac taasoo keenta barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Injuries can also cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Dhaawaca waxaa sidoo kale sababi kara barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When tissue is damaged, it releases chemicals that attract white blood cells and other immune cells to the area.
entries.translation: Marka nudaha ay dhaawacmaan, waxay sii daayaan kiimikooyin u soo jiida unugyada dhiigga cad iyo unugyada kale ee difaaca goobta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These cells release chemicals that cause inflammation.
entries.translation: Unugyada waxay soo daayaan kiimikooyin sababaaya barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Autoimmune diseases are caused by the body’s immune system attacking its own tissues.
entries.translation: Cudurada difaaca jirka waxaa keena habka difaaca jirka oo weeraro nuddayaashiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to inflammation in the affected tissues.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa barar ku dhaca nuddayaasha ay saameeyeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acute inflammation is usually treated with pain relievers, such as ibuprofen or acetaminophen.
entries.translation: Caadiyan bararka ba'an waxaa lagu daaweeyaa xanuun baabi'iyayaal, sida ibuprofen ama acetaminophen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, corticosteroids may be used to reduce inflammation.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, corticosteroids ayaa laga yaabaa in loo isticmaalo si loo yareeyo bararka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the inflammation is caused by an infection, antibiotics may be prescribed.
entries.translation: Haddii bararka uu keenay infekshon, qalajiyayaal ayaa laga yaabaa in loo qoro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation is a long-term condition that can cause pain, disability, and even death.
entries.translation: Bararka raaga waa xaalad wakhti dheer ah oo keeni karta xanuun, naafo, iyo xitaa dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is often caused by autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis and Crohn’s disease.
entries.translation: Inta badan waxaa keena cudurrada difaaca jirka, sida roomatiisinka lafaha iyo cudurka Crohn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chronic inflammation can also be caused by obesity, smoking, and air pollution.
entries.translation: Bararka raaga waxaa kale oo sababi kara cayilka, sigaarka, iyo wasakhowga hawada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no cure for chronic inflammation, but it can be managed with medication, lifestyle changes, and physical therapy.
entries.translation: Ma jirto wax daawo ah oo loogu talagalay caabuqa raaga, laakiin waxaa lagu maareyn karaa daawooyin, isbeddel qaab nololeedka, iyo daaweyn jireed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Mozambican Civil War was a conflict that lasted from 1977 to 1992.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii Sokeeye ee Mozambique wuxuu ahaa dagaal socday 1977-kii ilaa 1992-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war caused widespread devastation and displacement, and led to the deaths of an estimated 1 million people.
entries.translation: Dagaalka wuxuu sababay burbur iyo barakac baahsan, waxaana ku dhintay dad lagu qiyaasay 1 milyan oo qof.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war began after RENAMO launched an insurgency against FRELIMO in 1977.
entries.translation: Dagalka wuxu bilowday kadib markii RENAMO ay bilooween kacdoon ka dhan ah FRELIMO 1977kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: RENAMO was opposed to FRELIMO's socialist policies and its close ties to the Soviet Union.
entries.translation: RENAMO waxay ka soo horjeedeen siyaasadii hantiwadaaga ee FRELIMO iyo xiriirkii dhowaa ee ay la lahaayeen Midowgii Soofiyeedka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The war quickly escalated, and by the early 1980s, RENAMO had control of much of the countryside.
entries.translation: Dagaalka si degdeg ah ayuu u kordhay, horraantii 1980naadkii, RENAMO waxay inta badan gacanta ku hayyeen baadiyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: FRELIMO was forced to rely on Soviet and Cuban military aid to keep RENAMO at bay.
entries.translation: FRELIMO waxaa lagu qasbay inay ku tiirsanaadaan kaalmada milatari ee Soofiyeedka iyo Kuuba si ay RENAMO u ilaaliso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1984, FRELIMO and RENAMO signed a peace agreement, but the fighting continued.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 1984kii, FRELIMO iyo RENAMO waxay saxiixeen heshiis nabadeed, laakiin dagaalka wuu sii socday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1992, the two sides signed a new peace agreement, which called for a ceasefire and the holding of multiparty elections.
entries.translation: Sanadki 1992-kii, labada dhinac waxay saxiixeen heshiis nabadeed oo cusub, kaas oo dhigaya in xabadda la joojiyo, lana qabto doorashooyinka xisbiyada badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a bright and sunny day in the small village of Locksmiths, and the festival of locks was in full swing.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd maalin iftiimaysa oo qorrax ah tuulada yar ee Locksmiths, waxaana si xawli ah u socday xaflada qufulka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The streets were crowded with people, all eager to see the latest and greatest in lockmaking technology.
entries.translation: Waddooyinka waxaa buux dhaafiyay dad badan, kuwaas oo dhamaantood u hamuun qabay in ay arkaan tiknoolajiyada ugu dambeysay uguna weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were vendors selling everything from simple padlocks to complex combination locks, and artisans demonstrating their skills in lockpicking and locksmithing.
entries.translation: Waxaa jiray waratada wax walba iibinaya laga soo bilaabo qufulo fudud ilaa quful adag oo isku dhafan, iyo farsamoyaqaanno muujinaya xirfadahooda xirida iyo qufulida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the center of the village square, a large stage had been set up for the day's festivities.
entries.translation: Bartamaha fagaaraha tuulada, ayaa waxaa la dhigay madal aad u ballaaran oo loogu talagalay dabaaldegyada maalintaas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A group of musicians were playing lively tunes, and a crowd of people were gathered around, clapping and dancing.
entries.translation: Koox fanaaniin ah ayaa tumayay heeso xamaasad leh, waxaana la isugu soo baxay dad badan oo sacab iyo qoob ka cayaarayay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the stage, a skilled locksmith was demonstrating how to pick a lock, and the crowd was mesmerized by his skill.
entries.translation: Masraxa dhexdiisa, xirfadle locksmith ayaa ku soo bandhigayay sida loo doorto qufulka, dadweynihiina aad ayay ula dhaceen xirfadiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As the sun began to set, the festival came to a close.
entries.translation: Markay qorraxda sii dhacayso, waxa soo xirmay xaflada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My friend, Abel, and I were walking home from school one day when we saw a blood drive being held at our local community center.
entries.translation: Aniga iyo saaxiibkay, Abel, waxaan ka soo baxaynay dugsiga oon u soconay guriga maalin markaan aragnay dhacdo dhiig shubis oo lagu hayo xarunta bulshada deegaankeena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We were both 17 years old, and we had never donated blood before.
entries.translation: Labadeenaba 17 jir ayaan ahayn, waligeenna horay dhiig uma shubin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We decided to stop in and see what it was all about.
entries.translation: Waxaan go'aansanay inaan joogsano oo aan aragno waxay ku saabsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The process of donating blood was actually pretty simple.
entries.translation: Habka dhiig shubista runtii wuxuu ahaa mid fudud.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We both filled out a questionnaire and answered some questions about our health history.
entries.translation: Labadeenaba waxaan buuxinay xogwaraysi waxaana ka jawaabnay su'aalo ku saabsan taariikhdeena caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)
