entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the conflict has continued, with sporadic violence breaking out in the country.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, colaadda ayaa sii socotay, iyadoo rabshado goos goos ah ay dalka ka soo baxeen.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, there were hopes that the country would finally be able to move on from the civil war.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 2017-kii, waxaa jiray rajo laga qabo in dalka ugu dambeyntii awood u yeelan doono inuu ka gudbo dagaallada sokeeye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, these hopes were dashed when Gbagbo was acquitted of charges of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, rajadaas ayaa burburtay markii Gbagbo lagu waayay dacwado dambiyo ka dhan ah aadanaha oo ay soo saartay Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee dambiyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gbagbo's acquittal was seen as a blow to the peace process, and it led to renewed violence in the country.
entries.translation: Siidaynta Gbagbo ayaa loo arkay inay dhabar jab ku tahay geeddi-socodka nabadda, waxayna keentay in rabshado dib uga soo cusboonaaday dalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2018, the United Nations Security Council imposed sanctions on Gbagbo and his supporters.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 2018-kii, Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay Gbagbo iyo taageerayaashiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions were aimed at pressuring Gbagbo to end his support for violence in the country.
entries.translation: Cunaqabateynta ayaa looga golleeyahay in lagu cadaadiyo Gbagbo inuu soo afjaro taageerada uu u hayo rabshadaha ka jira dalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The sanctions have had some success, and there has been a decrease in violence in Ivory Coast since they were imposed.
entries.translation: Cunaqabateyntan ayaa xoogaa guulo ah, waxaana hoos u dhac ku yimid rabshadihii ka dhacay Ivory Coast tan iyo markii lagu soo rogay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the country is still far from stable.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waddanka wali wuu ka fog yahay xasilloonida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many different ways to do laundry, from using a traditional washing machine and dryer to more eco-friendly methods like hand washing and line drying.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira siyaabo badan oo kala duwan oo loo sameeyo dharka, laga bilaabo isticmaalka mashiinka dhar dhaqameedka iyo qalajiyaha ilaa habab badan oo saaxiibtinimo leh sida gacmo dhaqashada iyo qalajinta khadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One way to do laundry without using a machine is to hand wash your clothes in a basin or sink.
entries.translation: Hal dariiqo oo lagu dhaqo dharka adigoon isticmaalin mashiin waa inaad dharkaaga ku dhaqdo beeshin ama saxanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To do this, fill the basin with warm water and add a small amount of laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Si arrintan loo sameeyo, ka buuxi weelka biyo diirran oo ku dar qadar yar oo ah saabuunta dharka lagu dhaqo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Soak your clothes for a few minutes, then scrub them with a washcloth or brush.
entries.translation: Dharkaaga ku qoyso dhowr daqiiqo, ka dibna ku xoq maro-dhaqa ama burush.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rinse your clothes thoroughly in clean water, then wring them out.
entries.translation: Dharkaaga si fiican ugu biyo raaci biyo nadiif ah, ka dibna majuuji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes to dry on a clothesline or drying rack.
entries.translation: Dharkaaga suro si aad u qalajiso xariga dharka ama weel qalajinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another option is to use a washing machine without a dryer.
entries.translation: Ikhtiyaar kale ayaa ah in la isticmaalo mashiinka dharka lagu dhaqo oo aan lahayn qalajiye.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can save energy and money, but it does require more time and effort.
entries.translation: Tani waxay badbaadin kartaa tamar iyo lacag, laakiin waxay u baahan tahay wakhti iyo dadaal badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: To wash clothes in a machine without a dryer, fill the machine with water and add laundry detergent.
entries.translation: Si aad dharka ugu dhaqdo mashiin aan lahayn qalajiye, mashiinka ku buuxi biyo kuna dar saabuunta dharka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Set the machine to the appropriate cycle, then start it.
entries.translation: U deji mashiinka wareegga ku habboon, ka dibna bilow.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the cycle is complete, remove your clothes from the machine and hang them to dry.
entries.translation: Marka wareegga la dhammeeyo, dharkaaga ka saar mashiinka oo suro si aad u qalajiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you live in an area with a lot of rain, you may be able to use the rain to help you dry your clothes.
entries.translation: Haddii aad ku nooshahay meel roob badan ka da'o, waxaa laga yaabaa inaad awood u yeelato inaad isticmaasho roobka si uu kaaga caawiyo inaad qalajiso dharkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hang your clothes on a clothesline outside in the rain.
entries.translation: Dharkaaga ku dheji xariga dharka dibadda roobka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the beginning, there was only darkness.
entries.translation: Bilowgii, waxaa jiray gudcur keliya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe was a vast, empty void.
entries.translation: Caalamku wuxuu ahaa mid aad u ballaaran, madhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Then, out of the darkness, came a spark.
entries.translation: Kadib, gudcurkii, ayaa dhimbiil ka soo baxay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This spark was the first sign of life in the universe.
entries.translation: Dhimbisha waxay ahayd calaamaddii ugu horreysay ee nolosha adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It grew and expanded, becoming a small ball of fire.
entries.translation: Way kortay oo ballaaratay, waxay noqotay kubbad yar oo dab ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This ball of fire was the sun.
entries.translation: Kubaddan dabka ah waxay ahayd qorraxda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Around the sun, the planets began to form.
entries.translation: Agagaarka qorraxda, meerayaasha ayaa bilaabay inay samaysmaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Earth was the third planet from the sun.
entries.translation: Dhulku wuxuu ahaa meeraha saddexaad ee qorraxda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a small, rocky planet with a thin atmosphere.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd meere yar oo dhagax leh jawi dhuuban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: On the Earth, the first living things began to appear.
entries.translation: Dhulka, waxyaalihii ugu horreeyay ee nool ayaa bilaabay inay muuqdaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These were simple organisms, such as bacteria and algae.
entries.translation: Kuwaan waxay ahaayeen noolaha fudud, sida bakteeriyada iyo algae.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Over time, these organisms evolved into more complex forms of life, such as plants and animals.
entries.translation: Wakhti ka dib, noolahaasi waxay isu beddeleen qaabab nololeed oo aad u adag, sida dhirta iyo xayawaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first humans appeared on Earth about 200,000 years ago.
entries.translation: Bini'aadamkii ugu horreeyay wuxuu ka soo muuqday Dunida qiyaastii 200,000 sanno ka hor.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Humans have evolved and developed to become the dominant species on Earth.
entries.translation: Bini'aadamka waxay u kobceen oo horumariyeen si ay u noqdaan noocyada ugu badan ee Dunida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The universe is still expanding and evolving.
entries.translation: Adduunka wali wuu sii fidayaa oo isbeddelayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scientists believe that it will continue to expand for billions of years.
entries.translation: Saynisyahannada waxay aaminsan yihiin inay sii ballaari doonaan balaayiin sano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will reach a point where it can no longer expand.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntiina, koonku wuxuu gaari doonaa heer uusan sii ballaarin karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At this point, the universe will begin to contract.
entries.translation: Wakhtigan xaadirka ah, caalamka wuxuu bilaabi doonaa inuu qandaraas galo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eventually, the universe will collapse in on itself and disappear.
entries.translation: Ugu dambayntii, caalamka wuu burburi doonaa laftiisa oo wuu baabi'i doonaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the universe may end, the story of life will continue.
entries.translation: Laakiin inkasta oo caalamku dhammaan karo, haddana sheekada noloshu way sii socon doontaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm concerned about the environment and the impact that climate change is having on our planet.
entries.translation: Waxaan ka walaacsanahay deegaanka iyo saameynta isbeddelka cimilada uu ku leeyahay dhulkeenna.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm also a big fan of technology and gadgets, so I'm always looking for ways to reduce my carbon footprint without sacrificing my lifestyle.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale taageere weyn u ahay tiknoolajiyadda iyo aaladaha, sidaa darteed waxaan had iyo jeer raadinayaa siyaabo aan ku yareeyo raadkayga kaarboonka anigoon u hurin qaab nololeedkayga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: That's why I'm so excited about renewable and alternative energy sources.
entries.translation: Taasi waa sababta aan ugu faraxsanahay ilaha tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo iyo kuwa kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Renewable energy is energy that comes from sources that are naturally replenished, such as solar, wind, and water power.
entries.translation: Tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo waa tamar ka timaadda ilaha si dabiici ah loo buuxiyo, sida qorraxda, dabaysha, iyo tamarta biyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alternative energy is energy that comes from sources that are not traditionally used for power generation, such as biomass and geothermal energy.
entries.translation: Tamarta kale waa tamar ka timaadda ilaha aan dhaqan ahaan loo isticmaalin dhalinta tamarta, sida biomass iyo tamarta dhul-dhuleedka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Both renewable and alternative energy sources are clean and sustainable, meaning they don't produce greenhouse gases or other pollutants.
entries.translation: Ilaha tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo iyo kuwa kale labaduba waa kuwo nadiif ah oo waara, taasoo la micno ah inaysan soo saarin gaasaska aqalka dhirta lagu koriyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the best ways to make a difference is to switch to renewable energy sources for your home.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah siyaabaha ugu wanaagsan ee wax looga beddeli karo ayaa ah inaad u beddesho ilaha tamarta dib loo cusboonaysiin karo ee gurigaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can do this by installing solar panels on your roof, buying a wind turbine, or signing up for a green power plan from your utility company.
entries.translation: Waxaad ku samayn kartaa tan adoo ku rakibaya baalayaasha cadceedda saqafkaaga, iibsashada marawaxadaha dabaysha, ama iska diiwaangeliya qorshaha tamarta cagaaran ee shirkaddaada korontada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You can also reduce your energy consumption by unplugging appliances when you're not using them, turning off the lights when you leave a room, and using energy-efficient appliances.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo aad yareyn kartaa isticmaalka tamartaada adoo daminaya qalabka marka aadan isticmaaleynin, dami nalalka markaad qolka ka baxdo, iyo adeegsiga qalabka tamarta ku shaqeeya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The old wooden boat sat on the shore, its sails furled and its hull weathered by the sun and the rain.
entries.translation: Doontii hore ee alwaaxda ah waxay ku fadhiisatay xeebta, shiraacyadeeda ayaa la jeexjeexay, qolofkeeduna way ka soo baxeen qorraxda iyo roobka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It had seen many years of service, carrying its owners on voyages to far-off lands.
entries.translation: Waxay aragtay sannado badan oo adeeg ah, oo mulkiilayaasheeda ku qaadaya safarro dhulal fog.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But now, it was retired, its days of sailing over.
entries.translation: Laakiin hadda, way hawlgabtay, maalmaheeda badmaaxa ayaa dhamaaday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, a young boy named Thomas came to the beach.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, wiil yar oo lagu magacaabo Thomas ayaa yimid xeebta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had heard stories about the old boat, and he was eager to see it for himself.
entries.translation: Wuxuu maqlay sheekooyin ku saabsan doontii hore, wuuna xiiseynayay inuu arko naftiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he saw the boat, he was amazed by its size and its beauty.
entries.translation: Markuu arkay doonnida, wuxuu la yaabay cabirkeeda iyo quruxdeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He could imagine himself sailing off on adventures in the vast ocean.
entries.translation: Waxa uu qiyaasi karaa in uu naftiisu ka dhoofayo tacaburrada badweynta ballaaran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas asked the owner of the boat if he could take a closer look.
entries.translation: Thomas wuxuu weydiiyay milkiilaha doonta haddii uu si dhow u eegi karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner smiled and said, "Of course you can. Come aboard!"
entries.translation: Milkiilaha ayaa dhoola cadeeyay oo yiri, "Dabcan waad awoodaa. Kaalay soo fuul!"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas climbed into the boat and sat down in the captain's chair.
entries.translation: Thomas wuxuu fuulay doonnida wuxuuna fadhiistay kursiga kabtanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked out over the water and imagined himself sailing away to a faraway land.
entries.translation: Wuxuu eegay biyaha korkiisa wuxuuna qiyaasay inuu u sii jeedo dhul fog.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat watched Thomas for a moment, then said, "Do you want to learn how to sail?"
entries.translation: Milkiilaha doonta ayaa daawaday Thomas daqiiqad, ka dibna wuxuu yiri, “Ma rabtaa inaad barato sida loo badmaaxo?”
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thomas' eyes widened "Yes" he said.
entries.translation: Indhaha Thomas ayaa ballaartay “Haa” ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The owner of the boat smiled again.
entries.translation: Milkiilaha doonta ayaa mar kale dhoola cadeeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Then I'll teach you," he said.
entries.translation: “Markaa waan ku bari doonaa,” ayuu yiri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Scene: Two friends, Jasmine and Joseph, are sitting at a coffee shop.
entries.translation: Muuqaal: Laba saaxiibo, Jasmine iyo Joseph, waxay fadhiyaan dukaan kafee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm so glad you could meet me today, Joseph.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Aad ayaan ugu faraxsanahay inaad maanta ila kulmi karto, Joseph.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I really need your help.
entries.translation: Runtii waxaan u baahanahay caawimaaddaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Anything for you, Jasmine.
entries.translation: Joseph: Wax kasta oo adiga kuu ah, Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What's going on?
entries.translation: Maxaa jira?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I'm having a really tough time at work.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Runtii wakhti adag ayaan ku qaadanayaa shaqada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm not sure if I'm going to be able to keep my job.
entries.translation: Ma hubo haddii aan awoodi doono inaan sii wado shaqadayda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Oh no, Jasmine.
entries.translation: Joseph: Allaa maya, Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so sorry to hear that.
entries.translation: Aad ayaan uga xumahay inaan maqlo taas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: It's a long story.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Waa sheeko dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But basically, my boss is really unfair to me.
entries.translation: Laakiin asal ahaan, maamulahayga runtii cadaalad darro ayuu igu hayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She's always picking on me and making me do all the worst jobs.
entries.translation: Had iyo jeer way isoo qaadataa waxayna ii dirtaa inaan sameeyo dhammaan shaqooyinka ugu xun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And she's not even giving me a fair chance.
entries.translation: Oo iyada xitaa ima siinayso fursad cadaalad ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: That's terrible, Jasmine.
entries.translation: Joseph: Taasi waa wax xun, Jasmine.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can't believe she's treating you like that.
entries.translation: Ma rumaysan karo inay sidan oo kale kula dhaqmayso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Jasmine: I know.
entries.translation: Jasmine: Waan ogahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm so stressed out about it.
entries.translation: Aad ayaan uga walaacsanahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I don't know what to do.
entries.translation: Anigu garan maayo waxa la sameeyn karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Joseph: Well, first of all, you need to take a deep breath and calm down.
entries.translation: Joseph: Waa hagaag, ugu horayntii, waxaad u baahan tahay inaad neef qoto dheer qaadato oo aad is dejiso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The smell of fresh-baked bread wafted through the air as the baker pulled a tray of golden brown loaves from the oven.
entries.translation: Carafta rootiga cusub ee la dubay ayaa hawada is qabsaday markii rootilaha uu foornada ka soo saaray saxaarad kibis bunni ah oo dahab ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He carefully set them on a cooling rack and smiled, pleased with his work.
entries.translation: Wuxuu si taxadar leh u dhigay hayaayadahii qaboojinta wuuna dhoola cadeeyay, isagoo ku faraxsan shaqadiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The loaves were perfectly browned and had a delicious aroma that made his mouth water.
entries.translation: Kibistii ayaa si fiican u noqday bunni waxayna lahaayeen caraf udgoon oo afkiisa biyo ka dhigay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He couldn't wait to try one!
entries.translation: Ma sugi karin inuu isku dayo mid!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baker cut a slice of bread and took a bite.
entries.translation: Rootilaha ayaa gooyay jeex rooti ah wuuna qaniinay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was even better than he had imagined, with a soft, chewy texture and a rich, flavorful taste.
entries.translation: Xitaa way ka fiicnayd sidii uu malayn lahaa, oo leh jilicsanaan jilicsan, calalin iyo dhadhan hodan ah, dhadhan fiican leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He closed his eyes and savored the moment, enjoying the feeling of contentment that came from eating something so delicious.
entries.translation: Wuxuu xiray indhihiisa oo dhadhamiyay wakhtigaas, isagoo ku raaxeysanaya dareenka qanacsanaanta ee ka yimid cunista wax aad u macaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The baker knew that he was lucky to have the ability to bake such delicious bread.
entries.translation: Foorniistaha wuxuu ogaa inuu nasiib u leeyahay inuu awood u leeyahay inuu dubo rootiga macaan leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took pride in his work and was always happy to share his creations with others.
entries.translation: Wuxuu ku faanay shaqadiisa wuxuuna had iyo jeer ku faraxsanaa inuu la wadaago hal-abuurkiisa dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The type of fish you choose will depend on your personal preferences and the intended use for the fish.
entries.translation: Nooca kalluunka aad doorato wuxuu ku xirnaan doonaa doorbidkaaga gaarka ah iyo isticmaalka loogu talagalay kalluunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is high in omega-3 fatty acids, then you may want to choose a wild river fish.
entries.translation: Haddii aad raadineyso kalluun ay ku badan tahay omega-3 acids fatty acids, markaa waxaad u baahan kartaa inaad doorato kalluunka webiga duurjoogta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically lower in contaminants than farm-raised fish.
entries.translation: Kalluunkani caadi ahaan wuu ka hooseeyaa wasakhda marka loo eego kalluunka beerta lagu kobciyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, wild river fish can be more expensive and difficult to find.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha noqotee, kalluunka webiga duurjoogta ah wuxuu noqon karaa mid qaali ah oo ay adag tahay in la helo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is mild in flavor and easy to cook, then you may want to choose a calm lake fish.
entries.translation: Haddii aad raadinayso kalluun dhadhan fudud oo si sahlan loo kariyo, markaa waxaad u baahan kartaa inaad doorato kalluun haro deggan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Kalluunkani caadi ahaan kuma badna aashitada omega-3 ee dufanka leh sida kalluunka webiga duurjoogta ah, laakiin wali waa il wanaagsan oo laga helo borotiinka iyo nafaqooyinka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Calm lake fish are also typically more affordable and easier to find than wild river fish.
entries.translation: Kalluunka harada deggan ayaa sidoo kale caadi ahaan ka jaban oo sahlan in la helo marka loo eego kalluunka webiga duurjoogta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are looking for a fish that is low in cost and easy to care for, then you may want to choose a stock pond farm raised variety.
entries.translation: Haddii aad raadinayso kalluun qiimo jaban oo sahlan in la daryeelo, markaa waxaa laga yaabaa inaad rabto inaad doorato beer balli kayd ah oo kala duwan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These fish are typically raised in controlled environments and are fed a diet that is designed to promote growth.
entries.translation: Kalluunkan waxaa caadi ahaan lagu sara kiciyey deegaanno la kontoroolo waxaana lagu quudiyaa cunto loogu talagalay in lagu hormariyo koritaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Stock pond farm raised fish are typically not as high in omega-3 fatty acids as wild river or calm lake fish, but they are still a good source of protein and other nutrients.
entries.translation: Kalluunka lagu kobciyo beerta balli Stock caadi ahaan ma aha sida sare ee omega-3 acids dufan sida webiga duurjoogta ah ama kalluunka haraha deggan, laakiin waxay weli yihiin il wanaagsan oo borotiin iyo nafaqooyin kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ultimately, the best type of fish for you will depend on your individual needs and preferences.
entries.translation: Ugu dambeyntii, nooca ugu fiican ee kalluunka kuu ah waxay ku xirnaan doontaa baahiyahaaga gaarka ah iyo dookhyadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Do some research to learn more about the different types of fish available and choose the one that is right for you.
entries.translation: Samee cilmi baaris si aad wax badan uga ogaato noocyada kala duwan ee kalluunka la heli karo oo dooro midka adiga kugu habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Unsolved mysteries have captured the public's imagination for centuries.
entries.translation: Waxyaabaha qarsoon ee aan la xallin ayaa qabsaday mala-awaalka dadweynaha qarniyo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: From the disappearance of Amelia Earhart to the identity of Jack the Ripper, these cases have left us wondering what really happened.
entries.translation: Laga soo bilaabo la'aanta Amelia Earhart illaa aqoonsiga Jack the Ripper, arimahaan waxay nooga tageen la yaab ah waxa dhab ahaantii dhacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While some of these mysteries may never be solved, they continue to fascinate us because they offer a glimpse into the unknown.
entries.translation: In kasta oo qaar ka mid ah daahsanaantaan weligeed aan la xallin karin, waxay sii wadaan inay na soo jiidanayaan sababtoo ah waxay bixiyaan aragti wax aan la garanayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most famous unsolved mysteries is the disappearance of Amelia Earhart.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah daahsanaanta ugu caansan ee aan la xalin waa luminta Amelia Earhart.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Earhart was an American aviator who became the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean.
entries.translation: Earhart waxay ahayd duuliye Mareykanka ah oo noqtay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee kaligeed u duusha badweynta Atlantic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1937, she set out on an around-the-world flight with navigator Fred Noonan.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1937-kii, waxay u kacday duullimaad caalami ah oo ay weheliso navigate Fred Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The pair disappeared over the Pacific Ocean on July 2, 1937, and their fate remains unknown.
entries.translation: Labada lamaane waxay ku lumeen Badweynta Baasifigga 2-dii bishii Luulyo, 1937-kii, masiirkooduna wali aan la garanayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are many theories about what happened to Earhart and Noonan.
entries.translation: Waxaa jira aragtiyo badan oo ku saabsan waxa ku dhacay Earhart iyo Noonan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some believe that they crashed into the ocean, while others believe that they were captured by the Japanese.
entries.translation: Qaarkood waxay rumeysan yihiin inay ku burbureen badda, halka kuwa kale ay aaminsan yihiin in ay qabteen Jabbaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Still others believe that they deliberately disappeared in order to escape the public eye.
entries.translation: Weli kuwa kale waxay aaminsan yihiin inay si ula kac ah u dhumeen si ay uga baxsadaan isha dadweynaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The mystery of Earhart's disappearance has been the subject of books, articles, and documentaries.
entries.translation: Daahsanaanta maqnaashaha Earhart waxay ahayd mawduuca lagu qoray buugaagta, maqaallada, iyo filimaanta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2017, a team of researchers announced that they had found evidence that Earhart's plane crashed on a remote island in the Pacific Ocean.
entries.translation: Sanadkii 2017-kii, koox cilmi baarayaal ah ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay heleen caddeyn in diyaaradda Earhart ay ku burburtay jasiirad fog oo ku taal Badweynta Baasifigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are the largest species of arachnid in the world, with some individuals reaching lengths of over 12 inches.
entries.translation: Caaradaha yeyda ee waaweyn waa noocyada ugu weyn ee arachnid adduunka, iyadoo shakhsiyaadka qaarkood ay gaaraan dhererka ka badan 12 inji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are found in tropical rainforests around the world, and are known for their aggressive behavior and venomous bite.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga helaa kaymaha roobka kulaylaha adduunka oo dhan, waxaana lagu yaqaan dabeecadooda gardarrada ah iyo qaniinyada sunta leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Despite their fearsome reputation, giant wolf spiders are actually quite docile creatures.
entries.translation: In kasta oo sumcaddooda cabsi leedahay, caarada yeyda ee waaweyn runtii waa xayawaan aad u weyn ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are not aggressive towards humans unless they are provoked, and their venom is not typically fatal to humans.
entries.translation: Iyaga maku caroodaan dhinaca aadanaha ilaa la kiciyo maahee, suntoodana sida caadiga ah halis kuma aha aadanaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, their bite can be quite painful, and can cause swelling, redness, and itching.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha noqotee, qaniinyadooda waxay noqon kartaa mid xanuun badan, waxayna sababi kartaa barar, casaan, iyo cuncun.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Giant wolf spiders are excellent climbers, and can use their silk to create webs that can reach up to 30 feet in length.
entries.translation: Caaradaha yeyda ee waaweyn waa fuulayaal aad u fiican, waxayna u isticmaali karaan xariirkooda si ay u abuuraan shabakadaha gaari kara ilaa 30 cagood dherer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also very fast runners, and can move at speeds of up to 10 miles per hour.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale yihiin orodyahano aad u dhakhso badan, waxayna ku dhaqaaqi karaan xawaare ilaa 10 mayl saacaddiiba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Due to their size, speed, and climbing ability, giant wolf spiders are a popular choice for people who want to experience the thrill of riding a giant arachnid.
entries.translation: Sababtoo ah cabbirkooda, xawaaraha, iyo awooddooda fuulitaanka, caarada waaweyn ayaa ah xulasho caan ah dadka doonaya inay la kulmaan farxadda fuulitaanka arachnid weyn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, it is important to remember that these creatures are wild animals, and should be treated with respect.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa muhiim ah in la xasuusto in xayawaanadaan ay yihiin xayawaan duurjoogta ah, waana in loola dhaqmaa si ixtiraam leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are thinking about riding a giant wolf spider, it is important to do your research and make sure that you are properly prepared.
entries.translation: Haddii aad ka fekereyso fuulitaanka caaro weyn oo yeyda ah, waxaa muhiim ah inaad sameyso cilmi-baaristaada oo aad hubiso inaad si habboon u diyaargarowyd.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also make sure that you have the proper equipment, such as a harness and a leash.
entries.translation: Waa inaad sidoo kale hubisaa inaad haysato qalabka saxda ah, sida suunka iyo xariga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are properly prepared, you can begin your journey by finding a suitable giant wolf spider.
entries.translation: Markaad si habboon u diyaargarowdo, waxaad bilaabi kartaa safarkaaga adoo helaya caaro weyn oo ku habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you have found a spider, you can approach it slowly and gently.
entries.translation: Markaad hesho caaro, si tartiib tartiib ah oo dabacsan ayaad ugu soo dhowaan kartaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once the spider is comfortable with you, you can slowly climb onto its back.
entries.translation: Marka caarada kugu qanacdo, waxaad si tartiib tartiib ah ugu fuuli kartaa dhabarkeeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once you are on the spider's back, you can hold on tightly and enjoy the ride.
entries.translation: Markaad ku jirto dhabarka caarada, waxaad si adag u qaban kartaa oo aad ku raaxeysan kartaa wadida.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The spider will use its silk to create a web that will support you as you ride.
entries.translation: Caarada ayaa u adeegsan doona xariirkiisa si uu u abuuro shabakad kaa taageeri doona markaad raacdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Riding a giant wolf spider is an unforgettable experience.
entries.translation: Wadida caarada weyn ee yeyda waa waayo-aragnimo aan la ilaawi karin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a great way to experience the thrill of the wild, and to get up close and personal with one of the world's most fascinating creatures.
entries.translation: Waa hab wanaagsan oo lagula kulamo farxadda duurjoogta, iyo in la soo dhowaan oo shaqsiyeed la helo mid ka mid ah xayawaanka ugu xiisaha badan adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I'm an actor and a furniture designer. I'm also passionate about flowers, especially those that bloom in the winter.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Waxaan ahay jilaa iyo naqshadeeye alaabta guriga. Waxaan sidoo kale xiiseynaa ubaxyada, gaar ahaan kuwa ubaxa xilliga qaboobaha.

entries.english: Interviewer: What drew you to acting and furniture design?
entries.translation: Waraystaha: Maxaa kugu soo jiitay jilitaanka iyo naqshadeynta alaabta guriga?

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've always loved performing and creating things.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Waxaan had iyo jeer jeclaa bandhiga iyo abuurista waxyaabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Acting allows me to express myself creatively, and furniture design allows me to use my creativity to make something beautiful and functional.
entries.translation: Jiliinka waxay ii oggolaaneysaa inaan soo bandhigo hal-abuurka naftayda, naqshadeynta alaabta gurigana waxay ii oggolaanayaa inaan isticmaalo hal-abuurkayga si aan u sameeyo wax qurux badan oo shaqeynaya.

entries.english: Interviewer: What are some of the challenges you've faced as an actor and a furniture designer?
entries.translation: Waraystaha: Maxay yihiin qaar ka mid ah caqabadaha aad la kulantay ilaa markii aad jilaa iyo naqshadeeye alaabta guriga noqotay?

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: One of the challenges I've faced as an actor is the lack of diversity in the industry.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Mid ka mid ah caqabadaha aan la kulmay jilaa ahaan waa la'aanta kala duwanaanshaha warshadaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've often been told that I'm not the right type for a role because of my race or ethnicity.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a furniture designer, I've faced the challenge of breaking into a male-dominated industry.
entries.translation: Naqshadeeye alaab guri ahaan, waxaan la kulmay caqabada ah inaan u jabo warshadaha raggu u badan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Interviewer: How have you overcome these challenges?

entries.english: Fatima Messaoudi: I've overcome these challenges by working hard and never giving up.
entries.translation: Fatima Messaoudi: Waxaan caqabadahan uga soo gudbay inaan si adag u shaqeeyo oo aan weligay quusan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Translation has many benefits, including increasing the relative value of content, improving accessibility, and opening up new markets.
entries.translation: Tarjumaadda waxay leedahay faa'iidooyin badan, oo ay ku jiraan kordhinta qiimaha isku-xirnaanta nuxurka, hagaajinta helitaanka, iyo furitaanka suuqyo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When content is translated, it becomes accessible to a wider audience, which can lead to increased sales and profits.
entries.translation: Marka nuxurka la tarjumo, waxay noqonaysaa mid ay heli karaan dhagaystayaal ballaaran, taas oo horseedi karta iibka iyo faa'iidada kororka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition, translation can help to build relationships with customers in other countries and cultures.
entries.translation: Intaa waxaa dheer, turjumaadda ayaa kaa caawin kara dhisida xiriir la yeelashada macaamiisha dalalka kale iyo dhaqamada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: By displaying content in multiple languages, businesses can show that they are committed to reaching a global audience.
entries.translation: Adoo ku soo bandhigaya waxyaabaha ku jira luqado badan, ganacsiyada waxay muujin karaan inay ka go'an yihiin inay gaaraan dhagaystayaasha adduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can help to build trust and credibility with potential customers.
entries.translation: Tani waxay kaa caawin kartaa in la dhiso kalsoonida iyo macaamiisha suurtagalka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some specific examples of how translation has benefited businesses: * A small business that sells handmade jewelry translated its website into Spanish, French, and German.
entries.translation: Waa kuwan tusaalooyin gaar ah oo ku saabsan sida tarjumaadda uga faa'iideysatay ganacsiyada: * Ganacsi yar oo iibiya dahabka gacanta lagu sameeyay ayaa u turjumtay mareegteeda Isbaanish, Faransiis, iyo Jarmal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As a result, it saw a significant increase in sales from international customers * A large corporation that manufactures medical devices translated its product manuals into multiple languages.
entries.translation: Natiijo ahaan, waxay aragtay kor u kaca iibka ee macaamiisha caalamiga ah * Shirkad weyn oo soo saarta aaladaha caafimaadka ayaa buugaagteeda wax soo saar u turjumay luqado badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This helped to reach people in need who would not have otherwise been able to access the organization's resources.
entries.translation: Tani waxay gacan ka geysatay in la gaaro dadka u baahan kuwaas oo aan haddii kale awoodin inay helaan ilaha ururka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Translation is a powerful tool that can help businesses to grow and succeed.
entries.translation: Tarjumaadda waa aalad awood leh oo ka caawin kara ganacsiyada inay koraan oo ay ku guuleysato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is because we are all created in God's image, and God is the essence of rationality and order.
entries.translation: Sababtu waxay tahay, dhammaanteen waxaynu ka abuurnay araggii Eebbe, Ilaahayna waa nuxurka caqli-galnimada iyo nidaamka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we live in accordance with our true nature, we are able to experience peace and harmony.
entries.translation: Markaan ku noolaano si waafaqsan dabeecadeenna runta ah, waxaan awoodnaa inaan la kulanno nabad iyo iswaafajin.

entries.english: However, when we allow our thoughts and actions to become chaotic and inconsistent, we experience inner conflict and turmoil.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, markaan u oggolaanno fikradheena iyo ficiladeena inay noqdaan fowdo iyo iswaafajin, waxaan la kulannaa khilaaf gudaha iyo jahwareer.

entries.english: There are many ways to achieve internal consistency.

entries.english: One way is to live according to our values.

entries.english: When we know what is important to us and we make choices that are consistent with those values, we feel a sense of purpose and direction.
entries.translation: Markaan ognahay waxa muhiim noo ah oo aan sameyno xulashooyin waafaqsan qiimahaas, waxaan dareemeynaa dareen ujeeddo iyo jiho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Another way to achieve internal consistency is to be honest with ourselves about our strengths and weaknesses.
entries.translation: Hab kale oo lagu gaaro iswaafajinta gudaha waa inaan daacad ahno nafteena ku saabsan awooddeena iyo daciifnimada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When we are aware of our true selves, we can make choices that are in alignment with our authentic nature.
entries.translation: Markaan ka warqabno nafteena runta ah, waxaan sameyn karnaa xulashooyin ku habboon dabeecadeenna dhabta ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Of course, achieving internal consistency is not always easy.

entries.english: There will be times when we make mistakes or when we are faced with difficult choices.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, if we are willing to strive for consistency, we will eventually find our way back to peace and harmony.

entries.english: It is true that there exist in this world situations that defy all explanation, events so strange and wondrous that they seem to be the stuff of dreams or nightmares.
