entries.english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
entries.translation: Gawaarida kirada ah waa hab ku habboon oo lagu wareego marka la booqanayo magaalo ama waddan cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.
entries.translation: Waxay bixiyaan dabacsanaan si ay u sahamiyaan xawaarahaaga waxayna noqon karaan ikhtiyaar ka jaban gaadiidka dadweynaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
entries.translation: Markaad kireysaneyso gaari, waxaa muhiim ah in la isbarbar dhigo qiimaha shirkadaha kala duwan iyo inaad si taxaddar leh u akhrido daabacaadda ganaaxa heshiiska kirada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
entries.translation: Hubso inaad weydiiso wixii khidmad dheeri ah, sida khidmadaha shidaalka, caymiska, ama khidmadaha jidka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
entries.translation: Sidoo kale waa fikrad wanaagsan inaad sawirro ka qaadatid gaariga ka hor intaadan kaxayn, si aad u hesho caddeyn xaaladdiisa haddii ay waxyeello soo gaarto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
entries.translation: Haddii aad qorsheyneyso inaad kireysato baabuur muddo dheer, waxaad awoodi kartaa inaad hesho heshiis wanaagsan adoo iibsanaya xirmo baabuur kiro ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
entries.translation: Xirmooyinkaan sida caadiga ah waxaa ka mid ah tiro go'an oo maalmo kiro ah, iyo sidoo kale masaafada aan xadidnayn iyo waxyaabo kale oo dheeri ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.
entries.translation: Waxa kale oo laga yaabaa inaad hesho qiimo dhimis haddii aad horay u sii ballansato gaarigaaga kirada ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.
entries.translation: Markaad soo qaadanayso gaarigaaga kirada ah, hubi inaad si taxaddar leh u baarto wixii dhaawac ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.
entries.translation: Haddii aad aragto waxyeello, hubi inaad ku qorto heshiiska kirada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.
entries.translation: Sidoo kale waa inaad sawirro ka qaadataa gaariga ka hor intaadan kaxayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
entries.translation: Shuhadadii Uganda waxay aheyeen koox 23 Anglican 22 Roman ee krishtaan masiixi ah kuwaas oo la dilay inta u dheexysay 1885-kii ila 1887-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.
entries.translation: Waxa dilay boqorka Buganda, Mwanga II, diidmadooda ka tanasulka diintooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.
entries.translation: Waxaa lagu dhaariyay Pope Paul VI sanadkii 1964.-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.
entries.translation: Waxaa lagu tiriyaa inay ka mid yihiin shaqsiyaadkii ugu muhiimsanaa taariikhda diinta Masiixiga ee Uganda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Uganda Martyrs' Day is celebrated on June 3rd every year.
entries.translation: Maalinta shuhadada Uganda ayaa la xusaa 3-da bisha Juun sanad walba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is a national holiday in Uganda and is observed by Christians all over the world.
entries.translation: Waa maalin fasax qaran ah oo dalka Uganda ka dhaca, waxaana si weyn u xusa Masiixiyiinta caalamka oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The martyrs are remembered for their courage and their willingness to die for their faith.
entries.translation: Shuhadada waxaa lagu xusuustaa geesinimadoodii iyo rabitaankooda inay u dhintaan iimaankooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are an inspiration to Christians everywhere.
entries.translation: Waxay dhiirigelin u yihiin Masiixiyiinta meel kasta oo ay joogaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the upcoming months, I will be honored to receive an award for my work in the field of French language studies.
entries.translation: Bilaha soo socda, waxa la igu sharfi doonaa in aan abaalmarin ku helo shaqadayda dhinaca barashada luuqadda Faransiiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The award will be presented by the Société Française de Linguistique, a prestigious organization dedicated to the advancement of French language and linguistics.
entries.translation: Abaalmarinta waxaa bixin doona Société Française de Linguistique, oo ah hay'ad sharaf leh oo u heellan horumarinta luqadda Faransiiska iyo luqadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am humbled and grateful to be recognized by such a distinguished organization, and I look forward to continuing my work in French language studies.
entries.translation: Waan is-hoosaysiiyey oo aan uga mahadcelinayaa inay i aqoonsato hay'addan oo kale, waxaanan rajaynayaa in aan sii wato shaqadayda barashada luqadda Faransiiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research interests lie in the area of historical linguistics, and I have focused my work on the development of French from its origins in the Gallo-Romance dialects of the early Middle Ages.
entries.translation: Xiisahayga cilmi-baarista wuxuu ku jiraa aagga luqadaha taariikhiga ah, waxaana diiradda saaray shaqadayda horumarinta Faransiiska oo asal ahaan ka soo jeeda lahjadaha Gallo-Romance ee hore ee qarniyadii dhexe.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am particularly interested in the ways in which French has been influenced by other languages, such as Latin, Germanic languages, and Arabic.
entries.translation: Waxaan si gaar ah u xiiseeyaa siyaabaha Faransiisku ay u saameeyaan luqadaha kale, sida luqadaha Laatiinka, luqadaha Jarmalka, iyo Carabiga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has been published in leading journals in the field of linguistics, and I have presented my work at conferences around the world.
entries.translation: Cilmi baaristayda waxa lagu daabacay joornaalada hormuudka u ah cilmiga afafka, waxaanan shaqadeyda ku soo bandhigay shirarka aduunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I am based at a university located near the French border, and I have had the opportunity to collaborate with scholars from France and other Francophone countries.
entries.translation: Waxa aan joogaa jaamacad ku taal meel u dhow xuduudka Faransiiska, waxaanan fursad u helay inaan iskaashi la yeesho aqoonyahanno ka socda Faransiiska iyo dalalka kale ee ku hadla afka Faransiiska.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My research has made a significant contribution to the field of French language studies, and I am proud to have been recognized for my work.
entries.translation: Cilmi-baaristaydu waxay wax weyn ka tartay dhinaca daraasaadka luqadda Faransiiska, waanan ku faanayaa in la ii aqoonsaday shaqadayda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: Hello, children. What can I do for you?
entries.translation: Akosua Aunty: Haye, caruur. Maxaan idiin qabtaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 1: We need your help with a decision.
entries.translation: Ina adeer 1aad: Waxaan u baahanahay caawinaada go'aanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We're all trying to decide whether or not to cheat on a test tomorrow.
entries.translation: Dhammaanteen waxaan isku dayeynaa inaan go'aan ka gaarno inaan khiyaaneyno imtixaanka berrito iyo in kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 2: Yeah, we know it's wrong, but we're all really scared of failing.
entries.translation: Ina adeer 2aad: Haa, waan ognahay inay khalad tahay, laakiin dhammaanteen runtii aad ayaan uga baqaynaa inaan guuldarraysano.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: I understand that you're scared, but cheating is never the answer.
entries.translation: Akosua Aunty: Waan fahamsanahay inaad cabsanaysaan, laakiin khiyaanada weligeed ma aha jawaabta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's important to remember that integrity is one of the most important things in life.
entries.translation: Waa muhiim in la xasuusto in daacadnimadu ay tahay mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan nolosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When you cheat, you're not just cheating yourself, you're also cheating everyone else who has worked hard to learn the material.
entries.translation: Markaad khiyaamayso, maaha inaad naftaada khiyaamayso, waxaad sidoo kale khiyaamaysaa qof kasta oo kale oo ku dadaalay inuu barto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 1: But what if we really do fail?
entries.translation: Ina adeerka 1aad: Laakiin ka waran haddii aan dhab ahaantii ku guuldareysano?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Akosua Aunty: If you fail, then you fail. That's life.
entries.translation: Akosua Aunty: Haddii aad guul dareysato, markaas waad guuldarraysatay. Taasi waa nolosha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But at least you'll know that you did your best and you didn't cheat.
entries.translation: Laakiin ugu yaraan waxaad ogaan doontaa inaad samaysay intii karaankaaga ah oo aadan khiyaanayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And that's what matters most.
entries.translation: Taasina waa waxa ugu muhiimsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cousin 2: You're right, Aunty.
entries.translation: Ina adeer 2aad: Waad saxan tahay Eedo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We need to do the right thing, even if it's hard.
entries.translation: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan samayno waxa saxda ah, xitaa haddii ay adag tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Dance, Henry, dance" the old woman cried "Dance and let the colors of life flow through you.
entries.translation: "Qoob-ka-ciyaar, Henry, qoob-ka-ciyaar" haweenaydii da'da ahayd ayaa ku qaylisay " Qoob-ka-ciyaar oo u ogolow midabada nolosha inay kugu dhex socdaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Let the music fill your soul and your body will move of its own accord.
entries.translation: Muusigu ha buuxiyo naftaada, jirkaaguna iskii buu u dhaqaaqi doonaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dance and be free" Henry looked at the old woman with confusion.
entries.translation: Qoob-ka-ciyaar oo xorow" Henry wuxuu eegay islaantii da'da ahayd isagoo wareersan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had never been a dancer, and he didn't understand why she was so insistent that he should start now.
entries.translation: Waligii qoob-ka-cayaare ma noqon, mana uu fahmin sababta ay ugu adkaysanayso inuu hadda bilaabo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But the old woman's eyes were bright and her face was filled with joy, and Henry couldn't help but be drawn in.
entries.translation: Laakin islaantii da'da ahayd indhaheedu aad bay u dhalaalayeen, wajigeedana farxad baa ka buuxsamay, Henry-na wuu is celin kari waayay inuu soo dhex galo maahee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He took a deep breath and began to move.
entries.translation: Intuu neefsaday oo dhaqaaq bilaabay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: At first, his movements were awkward and hesitant, but as he continued to dance, he began to relax and let the music take over.
entries.translation: Markii hore, dhaqdhaqaaqiisu waxay ahaayeen kuwo qallafsan oo ka labalabaynaya, laakiin inta uu sii waday qoob ka ciyaarka, wuxuu bilaabay inuu nasto oo u oggolaado muusigga inuu la wareego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The colors of the world swirled around him, and he felt a sense of freedom and joy that he had never experienced before.
entries.translation: Midabada dunidu waxa ay ku dul wareegayeen, waxa uu dareemay xoriyad iyo farxad aanu hore u arag.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When the music stopped, Henry was breathless and exhilarated.
entries.translation: Markii ay muusikadu istaagtay, Henry wuu neefsaday oo wuu farxay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He looked at the old woman and smiled "Thank you," he said "I don't know why I didn't dance before.
entries.translation: Waxa uu eegay islaantii da'da ahayd oo dhoola caddeeyey "Mahadsanid" ayuu yiri "ma garanayo sababta aanan hore u dheelin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “So, what are you looking for in a life partner?”
entries.translation: "Marka, maxaad ka raadineysaa lammaane nolosha?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The question hung in the air, heavy with expectation.
entries.translation: Su'aashu waxay ka laa laaday hawada, iyadoo filasha weyn leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took a sip of my drink and glanced across the table at the woman I’d been on a few dates with.
entries.translation: Cabitaankaygii ayaan kabbaday oo aan miiskii ka jalleecay naagtii aan dhawr mar is shukaansanaynay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She was beautiful, with long dark hair, piercing blue eyes, and a smile that could light up a room.
entries.translation: Way qurux badnayd, timo madow oo dhaadheer, indho buluug ah oo daloola, iyo dhoola cadeyn qol iftiimin karta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But was she the one for me?
entries.translation: Laakin ma iyada ayay ii ahayd?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I thought about it for a moment.
entries.translation: Cabbaar baan ka fikiray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “I’m looking for someone who is kind, intelligent, and funny,” I said.
entries.translation: "Waxaan raadinayaa qof naxariis badan, caqli badan, oo kaftan leh," ayaan iri.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: “Someone who I can connect with on a deep level.”
entries.translation: "Qof aan si qoto dheer ula xiriiri karo."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She nodded “That sounds like a good start,” she said “What about physical attraction? Is that important to you?”
entries.translation: Way luxday "Taasi waxay u egtahay bilow wanaagsan," ayay tiri "Ka waran soo jiidashada jirka? Taasi muhim ma kuu tahay?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I shrugged “It’s not the most important thing,” I said “But it’s definitely a factor.”
entries.translation: Waan ruxay "Ma ahan waxa ugu muhiimsan," ayaan iri "Laakin hubaal waa arrin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She smiled “I know what you mean,” she said “I’m the same way.”
entries.translation: Way dhoola cadaysay "Waan garanayaa waxaad ula jeedo," ayay tiri "Sidoo kale ayaan ahay."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We talked for a while longer, about our hopes and dreams, our goals and aspirations.
entries.translation: Muddo dheer ayaan ka wada hadalnay, rajadayada iyo riyooyinkayada, hadafyadeena iyo himilooyinkayada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The more we talked, the more I felt like I was getting to know the real her.
entries.translation: Inta aan wada hadalnay, waxa aan dareemayay in aan iyada dhabta ah baranayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And the more I liked her.
entries.translation: Iyo in badan oo aan ka helay iyada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The recent rise of social media has given rise to a new breed of celebrities: the social media influencer.
entries.translation: Baraha bulshada ee dhawaan soo shaac baxay ayaa keentay in ay soo baxaan dad caan ah oo cusub: saamaynta baraha bulshada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These individuals have amassed large followings on platforms like Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube, and they use their influence to promote products, services, and ideas.
entries.translation: Shakhsiyaadkani waxay ku urursadeen taageerayaal badan aaladaha sida Twitter, Instagram, iyo YouTube, waxayna adeegsadaan saameyntooda si ay u horumariyaan badeecadaha, adeegyada, iyo fikradaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most popular social media influencers in the world is Kim Kardashian.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah kuwa ugu caansan baraha bulshada ee adduunka waa Kim Kardashian.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: With over 200 million followers on Instagram, Kardashian is a powerful force in the fashion, beauty, and lifestyle industries.
entries.translation: In ka badan 200 milyan oo taageerayaal ah Instagram-ka, Kardashian waa xoog leh xagga moodada, quruxda, iyo warshadaha qaab nololeedka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She has also used her platform to speak out about social issues, such as criminal justice reform and women's rights.
entries.translation: Waxay sidoo kale adeegsatay barnaamijkeeda si ay uga hadasho arrimaha bulshada, sida dib u habeynta cadaaladda dembiyada iyo xuquuqda haweenka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, there is a dark side to the world of social media influencers.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira dhinac madow oo adduunka saameynaya warbaahinta bulshada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some influencers are paid by foreign governments to spread propaganda and disinformation.
entries.translation: Qaar ka mid ah dadka saamaynta ku leh waxa lacag siiya dawlado shisheeye si ay u faafiyaan dacaayad iyo war-xumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This is a serious problem, as it can greatly influence public opinion and undermine democracy.
entries.translation: Tani waa dhibaato halis ah, maadaama ay si weyn u saameyn karto ra'yiga dadweynaha waxayna wiiqi kartaa dimuqraadiyadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 2016, it was revealed that Russian trolls used social media to spread propaganda and disinformation during the US presidential election.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 2016-kii, waxaa la ogaaday in trolls-ka Ruushka ay isticmaaleen baraha bulshada si ay u faafiyaan dacaayad iyo warar been abuur ah intii lagu jiray doorashadii madaxtinimo ee Mareykanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The trolls created fake accounts and used them to post pro-Trump messages and anti-Hillary Clinton messages.
entries.translation: Trolls-ka ayaa abuuray koontooyin been abuur ah oo loo adeegsaday in la dhigo farriimaha taageersan Trump iyo farriimaha ka dhanka ah Hillary Clinton.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This had a significant impact on the election, as it helped to sway public opinion in favor of Trump.
entries.translation: Tani waxay saameyn weyn ku yeelatay doorashada, maadaama ay gacan ka geysatey in ra'yiga dadweynaha ay u hiiliyo Trump.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Cairo, the capital of Egypt, is the largest city in the Middle East and the third largest city in Africa.
entries.translation: Qaahira, caasimadda Masar, waa magaalada ugu weyn bariga dhexe iyo magaalada saddexaad ee ugu weyn Afrika.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is home to some of the world's most famous landmarks, including the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum.
entries.translation: Waxay hoy u tahay qaar ka mid ah calaamadaha caanka ah ee adduunka, oo ay ku jiraan Ahraamta Giza, Sphinx, iyo Matxafka Masar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other important places in Egypt include Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, and the Sinai Peninsula.
entries.translation: Meelaha kale ee muhiimka ah ee Masar waxaa ka mid ah Alexandria, Luxor, Aswan, iyo Peninsula Sinai.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alexandria is Egypt's second largest city and was once the capital of the Ptolemaic Kingdom.
entries.translation: Alexandria waa magaalada labaad ee ugu weyn Masar waxayna mar ahayd caasimadda Boqortooyada Ptolemaic.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Luxor is home to the Valley of the Kings, where many of the pharaohs of ancient Egypt were buried.
entries.translation: Luxor waxay hoy u tahay Dooxada Boqorrada, halkaas oo lagu aasay qaar badan oo ka mid ah fircoonnadii Masar hore.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aswan is located on the Nile River and is known for its beautiful scenery and its many ancient temples.
entries.translation: Aswan waxa ay ku taal wabiga Niil waxana ay caan ku tahay muuqaalkeeda quruxda badan iyo macbadyo qadiimi ah oo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Sinai Peninsula is located in the eastern part of Egypt and is home to the famous Mount Sinai, where Moses is said to have received the Ten Commandments.
entries.translation: Jasiiradda Siinaay waxa ay ku taallaa dhinaca bari ee dalka Masar, waxana ay ku taallaa buurta caanka ah ee Siinaay, halkaas oo la sheegay in Muuse uu ku helay Tobanka Amar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The gardener's journey began with a simple drive to the local nursery.
entries.translation: Safarka beeralayda waxa uu ku bilaabmay wadis fudud oo uu ku tagayo xanaanada deegaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He had been planning this trip for weeks, ever since he had seen the advertisement in the paper.
entries.translation: Waxa uu qorshaynayey safarkan muddo toddobaadyo ah, tan iyo markii uu arkay xayaysiinta warqadda ku qoran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The nursery was offering a 20% discount on all plants, and he was determined to take advantage of the sale.
entries.translation: Xannaanada ayaa 20% ku bixinaysay qiimo dhimis dhammaan dhirta, wuxuuna go'aansaday inuu ka faa'iidaysto iibka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he arrived at the nursery, he was immediately overwhelmed by the selection of plants.
entries.translation: Markii uu soo gaaray goobtii lagu xanaanayn jiray, waxa uu isla markiiba la soo booday xulkii dhirta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There were flowers of every color and shape, vegetables of all sizes, and trees that reached for the sky.
entries.translation: Waxaa jiray ubaxyo midab kasta iyo qaab kasta leh, khudaar nooc walba leh, iyo geedo cirka gaadhay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He wandered around for hours, admiring the plants and dreaming of the beautiful garden he would create.
entries.translation: Muddo saacado ah ayuu wareegay, isagoo dhirtii la dhacsanayay, kuna hammiyi jiray beerta quruxda badan ee uu abuuri doono.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Finally, he made his selections and headed to the checkout counter.
entries.translation: Ugu dambayntii, waxa uu sameeyay xullashadiisii oo waxa uu aaday goobtii lacag bixinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As he was paying for his plants, he noticed a sign that said "Free delivery for orders over $50" He smiled and added a few more plants to his cart.
entries.translation: Markii uu bixinayay kharashka dhirtiisa, waxa uu arkay calaamad ay ku qoran tahay "Qaadis bilaash ah dalabyada ka badan $50" Wuu dhoola caddeeyey oo ku daray dhawr dhir kale saladiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A few days later, the gardener received a delivery of his new plants.
entries.translation: Dhowr maalmood ka dib, ninkii beerta ka shaqaynayay wuxuu helay dalabkii dhirta cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He eagerly unpacked them and began to plant them in his garden.
entries.translation: Si xiiso leh ayuu uga furay oo bilaabay inuu beertiisa ku beero.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He worked for hours, carefully placing each plant in the perfect spot.
entries.translation: Waxa uu shaqeeyay saacado, isaga oo si taxadar leh u dhigaya geed kasta meesha ugu habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When he was finished, he stood back and admired his work.
entries.translation: Markii uu dhameeyay ayuu dib u istaagay oo eegay shaqadiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The garden was beautiful, and he knew that he would enjoy spending many hours tending to it.
entries.translation: Beertu waxay ahayd mid qurux badan, wuuna ogaa inuu ku raaxaysan doono inuu saacado badan daryeelo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These are just a few of the issues that can plague a car that has been in a minor accident.
entries.translation: Waa kuwan dhowr arrimood oo dhib ku keeni kara baabuur shil yar galay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While the damage may not seem significant, it can still be dangerous and expensive to fix.
entries.translation: In kasta oo waxyeelada aysan u muuqan mid muhiim ah, haddana waxay noqon kartaa khatar iyo qaali in la hagaajiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the case of worn or falling apart rubber pieces, this can be a safety hazard.
entries.translation: Haddii ay dhacdo in qaybo caag ah jeexmaan ama kala go'aan, tani waxay noqon kartaa khatar badbaado leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber is used in a variety of places on a car, including the tires, brake pads, and seals.
entries.translation: Cinjirka waxaa loo isticmaalaa meelo kala duwan oo baabuurka dushiisa ah, oo ay ku jiraan taayarada, bareega, iyo cinjirada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: When rubber becomes worn, it can crack, split, or otherwise deteriorate.
entries.translation: Marka cinjirka dhamaado, wuu dillaaci karaa, wuu kala dhici karaa, ama haddii kale wuu xumaan karaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This can lead to a number of problems, such as reduced traction, decreased braking performance, and leaks.
entries.translation: Tani waxay u horseedi kartaa tiro dhibaatooyin ah, sida jiidashada oo yaraada, waxqabadka biriiga oo yaraada, iyo daadinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Missing roof rail pieces can also be a safety hazard.
entries.translation: Qaybaha birta saqafka ah ee maqan waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa khatar badbaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Roof rails are designed to help protect passengers in the event of a rollover accident.
entries.translation: Biraha saqafka ayaa loogu talagalay inay ka caawiyaan ilaalinta rakaabka haddii ay dhacdo shil rogrogis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the roof rails are missing, the roof of the car is more likely to collapse in a rollover, which can cause serious injuries or death.
entries.translation: Haddii biraha saqafku ay maqan yihiin, saqafka sare ee baabuurka waxay u badan tahay inuu ku soo dumo rogrogadka, taas oo keeni karta dhaawac halis ah ama dhimasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A broken fuel tank door lock can also be dangerous.
entries.translation: Qufulka albaabka haanta shidaalka ee jaban sidoo kale wuxuu noqon karaa khatar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If the fuel tank door cannot be locked, it could come open while the car is moving.
entries.translation: Haddii albaabka haanta shidaalka aan la xiri karin, wuxuu furnaan karaa inta uu baabuurka socdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This could spill fuel onto the road, which could cause a fire or explosion.
entries.translation: Tani waxay ku daadan kartaa shidaal wadada, taasoo keeni karta dab ama qarax.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In addition to the safety risks, these types of damage can also be expensive to fix.
entries.translation: Marka lagu daro khataraha nabdoonaanta, waxyeelada noocaan ah waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa qaali in la hagaajiyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rubber pieces can be difficult to replace, and roof rails and fuel tank door locks can be expensive to repair or replace.
entries.translation: Qaybaha caagga ah way adkaan kartaa in la beddelo, biraha saqafka ah iyo qufullada albaabka haanta shidaalka ayaa qaali ah in la dayactiro ama la beddelo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In some cases, it may be more cost-effective to total the car and buy a new one.
entries.translation: Xaaladaha qaarkood, waxay noqon kartaa mid kharash badan oo waxtar leh in la wada geeyo baabuurka oo la iibsado mid cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you are considering buying a used car that has been in a minor accident, be sure to have it inspected by a qualified mechanic.
entries.translation: Haddii aad ka fekereyso inaad iibsato baabuur la isticmaalay oo shil yar galay, iska hubi inuu ku eego makaanik aqoon u leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They will be able to identify any damage that may not be visible to the naked eye, and they can advise you on whether or not the car is safe to buy.
entries.translation: Waxay awood u yeelan doonaan inay ogaadaan wixii dhaawac ah ee laga yaabo inayan arki karin isha, waxayna kugula talin karaan haddii baabuurka uu yahay mid badbaado leh oo la iibsan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: A bicycle is a thing of beauty, sleek and streamlined, its wheels a blur of motion as it glides along the road.
entries.translation: Baaskiilka waa shay qurux badan, xarrago leh oo toosan, taayirkiisu waa guduudan dhaqdhaqaaqa marka uu ku dul wareegayo waddada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what happens when you bring a bike into a small room?
entries.translation: Laakiin maxaa dhacaya marka aad soo qaadato baaskiil qol yar?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Suddenly, all that grace and efficiency is lost, and the bike becomes a clumsy, awkward intruder.
entries.translation: Isla markiiba, dhammaan nimcadaas iyo hufnaantaas ayaa lumay, oo baaskiilku wuxuu noqdaa mid qallafsan, oo si xun u soo galay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I once had a bike in a small room.
entries.translation: Waxaan bari baaskiil ku haystay qol yar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a cramped, dingy apartment in a rundown neighborhood, and the bike took up most of the space.
entries.translation: Waxa ay ahayd guri ciriiri ah, guri nasasho leh oo ku yaalla xaafad ciriiri ah, baaskiilkuna waxa uu qabsaday inta badan nafaaskii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I could barely get through the door without knocking it over, and I had to be careful not to trip over it when I was in the middle of the night.
entries.translation: Waxa aan si dirqi ah uga soo bixi kari waayay albaabka aniga oo aan garaacin, waxana ay ahayd in aan ka taxadaro in aan ka dul wareego marka aan habeen saq-dhexe joogo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But even though the bike was a nuisance, I couldn't bring myself to get rid of it.
entries.translation: Laakiin inkasta oo baaskiilku uu ahaa mid dhib badan, naftayda kama dhaadhicin karin inaad ka takhaluso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It was a reminder of a better time, when I was young and free and full of hope.
entries.translation: Waxay ahayd xasuusin wakhti ka wanaagsan, markii aan yaraa oo xor ahaa oo rajo buuxda lahaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I would sit on the bike and dream of all the places I could go, all the adventures I could have.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku fadhiisan ljiray baaskiilka oo waxaan ku riyoon jiray dhammaan meelaha aan tagi karo, dhammaan tacaburrada aan heli karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One day, I finally decided to get rid of the bike.
entries.translation: Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, waxaan ugu dambeyntii go'aansaday inaan ka takhaluso baaskiilka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I took it to the curb and put it out for the trash.
entries.translation: Waxa aan geeyey geeskii oo aan ku tuuray qashinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: As I watched it being hauled away, I felt a pang of regret.
entries.translation: Markaan daawanayay iyadoo la fogeynayo, waxaan dareemay calool xumo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the early 1900s, Americans were introduced to the drug “morphine” through the use of over-the-counter cough syrups.
entries.translation: Horraantii 1900-meeyadii, dadka Maraykanka ah waxaa la geeyay dawada "morphine" iyadoo la isticmaalayo sharoobada qufaca oo aan farmashiyaha laga qorin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: While this drug was initially used to treat pain, it soon became addictive and led to a rise in the number of drug addicts in the United States.
entries.translation: Iyadoo dawadan markii hore loo isticmaalay in lagu daweeyo xanuunka, isla markiiba waxay noqotay mid lagu qabatimay oo keentay in ay kor u kacdo tirada daroogada ee Maraykanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One of the most tragic stories of this era is that of the “Kitten Lady”.
entries.translation: Mid ka mid ah sheekooyinka ugu naxdinta badan ee xilligan waa tii "Marwada Kitten".
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This woman was a morphine addict who had a litter of kittens.
entries.translation: Haweenaydaan waxay ahayd qof ku qabatimay morphine oo lahayd mukulaal yaryar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She loved her kittens very much and would often play with them for hours on end.
entries.translation: Aad bay u jeceshay mukulaasheeda oo inta badan way la ciyaari jirtay saacado ka dib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, her addiction soon took over and she began to neglect her kittens.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, balwaddeedii ayaa markiiba la wareegtay oo waxay bilowday inay dayacdo mukulaasheeda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She would leave them for days at a time, only coming back to feed them and give them water.
entries.translation: Waxay ka maqnaan jirtay maalmo, kaliya waxay u soo noqon jirtay inay quudiso oo ay siiso biyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The kittens eventually began to suffer from the neglect.
entries.translation: Bisadihii ayaa ugu dambeyntii bilaabay inay la ildarnaadaan dayaca.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became thin and sickly, and their fur began to fall out.
entries.translation: Way caatoobeen oo bukoodeen, dhogortoodana waa daadatay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: One by one, they started to die.
entries.translation: Mid mid ayay u dhintaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Kitten Lady was devastated by the loss of her kittens, but she was unable to stop her addiction.
entries.translation: Marwada Bisada waxa aad ayay uga xumaatay luminta bisadaheeda, laakiin way awoodi wayday inay joojiso balwadda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: She eventually died of a morphine overdose, leaving her kittens behind.
entries.translation: Aakhirkii waxay u dhimatay qiyaas xad dhaaf ah oo morphine ah, iyadoo ka tagtay bisadaheedii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This story is a reminder of the dangers of drug addiction.
entries.translation: Sheekadaan waxay xasuusinaysaa khatarta balwada darogada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is also a reminder of the love and devotion that animals can have for their humans.
entries.translation: Waxay kaloo xusuusinaysaa jacaylka iyo daacadnimada ay xooluhu u yeelan karaan dadkooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) people are people who identify with a sexual orientation or gender identity that is different from the majority population.
entries.translation: Dumarka isku jinsiga ah, khaniis, lab iyo dhedig, iyo dadka jinsiyada bedeshay dadka (LGBT) waa dad lagu garto jihada galmoodka ama aqoonsiga lab iyo dhedig ka duwan inta badan dadka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sexual orientation refers to a person's romantic and sexual attraction to others, while gender identity refers to a person's internal sense of being male or female.
entries.translation: Jiheynta galamad waa qofka oo jeclado inu la galmood o dadka kale halka jinsiga ay tahay darenka gudaha ee qof inu rag ama dumar yahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people face discrimination in many areas of life, including employment, housing, and healthcare.
entries.translation: Dadka isku galmoodo oo isku jinsiga ah waxay wajahan faquuq meelo badan oo nolashooda haday tahay shaqada guryaha iyo gobaha cafimad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They are also more likely to experience violence and abuse.
entries.translation: Waxyan u badan tahay inay la kulmaan gacan ka hadal ama cay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There is no one single cause of LGBT identity.
entries.translation: Ma jiro hal wax oo sababay shakhsiyada LGBT.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Some people are born with an innate sense of their sexual orientation or gender identity, while others develop these feelings over time.
entries.translation: Dadka qaar waxay ku dhashaan dhalanteed daren oo jihayn galmo ama aqoonsi jinsiyadeed halka dadka ay dareemaan marki wakhti kaso wareegto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people are just as diverse as the rest of the population.
entries.translation: Dadka LGBT waa kuwo u badan sida tiradad dadka kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They come from all walks of life and have a wide range of interests and experiences.
entries.translation: Waxay ka imaadan nolasha socdaalkeda waxayn leeyihiin xiiseyn wayn iyo khibrad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The medical community recognizes that sexual orientation and gender identity are not mental illnesses.
entries.translation: Qoomiyada cafimaadka waxay ogadeen inay jihaynta galmada ama aqoonsiga jinsiga aysan aheyn xanuun maskaxeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In fact, the American Psychiatric Association removed homosexuality from its list of mental disorders in 1973.
entries.translation: Dhab ahaantii, Ururka Cilmi-nafsiga ee Maraykanka ayaa ka saaray khaniisnimada liiska cudurrada dhimirka 1973-kii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: LGBT people should be able to live their lives openly and authentically.
entries.translation: Dadka LGBT ah waxay awoodaan inay ku nooladaan nolashooda iyo si la hubo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.
entries.translation: Waxay mudan yihiin in si xushmad iyo qaddarin leh loola dhaqmo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In many countries, there are laws that protect LGBT people from discrimination.
entries.translation: Wadamo badan, waxaa jira sharciyo dadka LGBT ka ilaaliya takoorka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hello, and welcome to your annual checkup.
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Haye, ku soo dhawoow baaritaankaaga sanadlaha ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: How are you feeling today?
entries.translation: Sidee dareemaysaa maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I'm feeling pretty good, all things considered.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxaan dareemayaa wanaag, markii wax walba la qiimeeyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I've been getting a little more sleep lately, and my diet has been pretty healthy.
entries.translation: Baryahaan waxaan yara dareemayay hurdo badan, cuntadaydana waxay ahayd mid caafimaad qabta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great to hear.
entries.translation: Dakhtarka: Taasi waa wax wanaagsan inaan maqlo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm going to start by taking your vital signs.
entries.translation: Waxaan ku bilaabayaa qaadashada calaamadahaaga muhiimka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: [The doctor takes the patient's blood pressure, pulse, and temperature.]
entries.translation: [Dhakhtarka wuxuu qaadaa cadaadiska dhiigga ee bukaanka, garaaca wadnaha, iyo qandhada.]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Everything looks good here.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Wax walba waxay u muuqdaan inay fiican yihiin halkan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Now, let's talk about your diet.
entries.translation: Hadda, aan ka hadalno cuntadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: What are you eating on a typical day?
entries.translation: Maxaad cuntaa maalinta caadiga ah?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I usually have a bowl of cereal for breakfast, a sandwich for lunch, and a salad for dinner.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Badanaa waxaan cunaa baaquli xabuub ah quraacda, sandwich qadada, iyo khudaar casho ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I also try to eat fruits and vegetables throughout the day.
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale isku dayaa inaan cuno miraha iyo khudaarta maalintii oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That sounds like a healthy diet.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taasi waxay u egtahay cunto caafimaad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Are you getting enough exercise?
entries.translation: Ma qaadataa jimicsi kugu filan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I try to get at least 30 minutes of exercise most days of the week.
entries.translation: Bukaanka: Waxaan isku dayaa inaan sameeyo jimicsi ugu yaraan 30 daqiiqo maalmaha isbuuca badankiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I walk to work, and I play basketball once or twice a week.
entries.translation: Waxaan u lugeeyaa shaqada, waxaana ciyaara kubbadda koleyga hal ama laba jeer toddobaadkii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That's great. Exercise is an important part of a healthy lifestyle.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Taasi waa wax fiican. Jimicsiga waa qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qaab nololeed caafimaad leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: I know. I'm trying to be more active.
entries.translation: Bukaan: waan ogahay. Waxaan isku dayayaa inaan firfircoonaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is a country in Central Africa with a population of over 80 million people.
entries.translation: Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Kongo (DRC) waa waddan ku yaal badhtamaha Afrika oo ay ku nool yihiin in ka badan 80 milyan oo qof.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is the second-largest country in Africa by area, and is endowed with vast natural resources, including copper, cobalt, diamonds, and gold.
entries.translation: Waa dalka labaad ee ugu weyn qaarada Afrika marka loo eego deegaan ahaan, waxaana lagu manaystay kheyraad aad u badan oo ay ka mid yihiin naxaasta, Cobalt, dheeman iyo dahab.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, the DRC has been plagued by conflict for decades, which has had a devastating impact on its people and economy.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, DRC ayaa tobanaan sano waxaa ragaadiyay colaado, kuwaas oo saameyn xun ku yeeshay dadkeeda iyo dhaqaalahooda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The first major conflict in the DRC was the First Congo War, which lasted from 1996 to 1997.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii ugu weynaa ee DRC ka dhacay wuxuu ahaa kii ugu horreeyay ee Kongo, kaasoo socday 1996 ilaa 1997.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This war was fought between the government of Mobutu Sese Seko and a rebel group led by Laurent Kabila.
entries.translation: Dagaalkan ayaa waxa uu u dhexeeyay dawladda Mobutu Sese Seko iyo jabhad uu hoggaaminayo Laurent Kabila.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kabila eventually succeeded in overthrowing Mobutu and taking power.
entries.translation: Kabila ayaa aakhirkii ku guulaystay in uu xukunka ka tuuro Mobutu oona xukunka la wareego.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, Kabila's rule was short-lived.
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xukunka Kabila wuxuu ahaa mid gaaban.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In 1998, he was overthrown by a new rebel group led by Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.translation: Sannadkii 1998-kii, waxaa afgambiyay jabhad cusub oo uu hoggaaminayay Jean-Pierre Bemba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This led to the Second Congo War, which lasted until 2003.
entries.translation: Tani waxay keentay dagaalkii labaad ee Kongo, kaas oo socday ilaa 2003.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The Second Congo War was the deadliest conflict in modern African history, and resulted in the deaths of over 5 million people.
entries.translation: Dagaalkii labaad ee Kongo wuxuu ahaa iskahorimaadkii ugu dhimashada badnaa taariikhda casriga ah ee Afrika, wuxuuna sababay dhimashada in ka badan 5 milyan oo qof.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The DRC has also been plagued by political instability.
entries.translation: DRC ayaa sidoo kale waxaa ragaadiyay xasillooni darro siyaasadeed.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Last week, my uncle was out in the field harvesting corn when he spotted a snake slithering across the ground.
entries.translation: Isbuucii hore, adeerkay isagoo beerta ku maqan oo sabuul goosanayay ayaa wuxuu arkay mas dhulka ku sii qulqulaya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He decided to take a closer look, and as he got closer, he realized that it was a huge rattlesnake!
entries.translation: Wuxuu go'aansaday inuu si dhaw u fiiriyo, markuu u soo dhawaaday, wuxuu gartay inay tahay mas weyn!
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He quickly backed away, but the snake was already on the move.
entries.translation: Si degdeg ah ayuu uga laabtay, laakiin maskii hore ayuu u socday.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It headed straight for my uncle, who started to run.
entries.translation: Waxay si toos ah u soo aaday adeerkay oo orod bilaabay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He ran as fast as he could, but the snake was gaining on him.
entries.translation: Si degdeg ah ayuu u orday intuu awooday, laakiin maskii ayaa ka orod badiyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Just when it seemed like the snake was going to catch him, my uncle tripped and fell.
entries.translation: Isla markii aad mooddo in masku soo qaban doono, ayaa adeerkay turunturooday oo dhacay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He landed in a big pile of manure, and the snake slid right past him.
entries.translation: Waxa uu ku soo degay digo aad u tiro badan, maskiina si toos ah ayuu u soo dhaafay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: My uncle was so relieved that he had escaped, but he was also covered in manure.
entries.translation: Adeerkey aad ayuu u nafisay oo wuu baxsaday, laakiin digada ayaa qarisay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The plastic bag is a ubiquitous object in our modern world.
entries.translation: Boorsada bacda waa shay meel walbo yalo aduunka casriga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It is used for everything from carrying groceries to picking up dog poop.
entries.translation: Waxa loo isticmaalaa wax kasta laga soo bilaabo qaadidda raashinka ilaa soo qaadista eeyaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: But what is the true cost of this seemingly innocuous item?
entries.translation: Laakiin waa maxay qiimaha dhabta ah ee shaygan u muuqda mid aan dhib lahayn?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are made from a type of plastic called polyethylene, which is derived from fossil fuels.
entries.translation: Bacaha caagga ah waxaa laga sameeyaa nooc caag ah oo loo yaqaan polyetylen, kaas oo ka soo ka imaada shidaalka fosil.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: The production of plastic bags requires a great deal of energy, and it also releases harmful pollutants into the environment.
entries.translation: Wax soo saarka bacda waxay uu u baahan yahay tamar badan waxayna soo sii daysaa wax yaalo wax tar an lahayn oo ay kus dayso degaanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Once plastic bags are discarded, they can take hundreds of years to decompose.
entries.translation: Marka bacaha la tuuro, waxay qaadan kartaa boqolaal sano inay baa'bado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This means that they can accumulate in landfills and oceans, where they can harm wildlife and pollute our water supply.
entries.translation: Taas macneheedu waxa weeye in ay ku urursan karaan meelaha qashin-qubka ah iyo badaha, halkaas oo ay waxyeello u geysan karaan duur-joogta oo ay wasakhayn karaan biyahayaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Plastic bags are also a major source of litter.
entries.translation: Bacaha balaastikada ah ayaa sidoo kale ah isha ugu weyn ee qashinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They can be found on beaches, in parks, and even in our own neighborhoods.
entries.translation: Waxaa laga heli karaa xeebaha, jardiinooyinka, iyo xitaa xaafadaheena.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Litter is unsightly and can be a hazard to wildlife.
entries.translation: Qashinka waa mid aan qurux badnayn waxayna khatar ku noqon kartaa duurjoogta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We use them for a few minutes and then discard them, never giving a thought to the environmental consequences.

entries.english: We need to find ways to reduce our use of plastic bags.

entries.english: We can bring our own reusable bags when we go shopping, and we can recycle plastic bags whenever possible.

entries.english: We can also lobby our elected officials to pass laws that restrict the use of plastic bags.

entries.english: Kofi and Sameer met in college at a bar that Kofi's father owned.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: They became fast friends, even though they were very different people.
entries.translation: Waxay isku noqdeen saxiibo isku daacda ah in kasto ay kala duwan yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kofi was outgoing and adventurous, while Sameer was more introverted and studious.
