entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Tell her to go to a doctor or clinic as soon as possible to get tested and receive the appropriate care.
entries.translation: U sheeg in ay aragto dhakhtar ama tagto xarun caafimaad oo bukaan-socod sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan si loo baaro, ayna u hesho daryeel sax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: Tell your neighbor that he absolutely should not attempt to self-treat suspected onchocerciasis with over-the-counter supplements.
entries.translation: Jawaab: U sheeg deriskaaga waa in uu sinnaba isku dayin daawooyinka bannaanka ee aan dhaktar soo qorin haddii uu isaga shakisan yahay onchocerciasis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: There are no over-the-counter supplements that prevent or treat river blindness.
entries.translation: Ma jiraan daawoyin banaankaa oo la qaato oo ka hortaga ama daaweyn kara jirrada tikhsiga webiga laga qaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: His symptoms (severe itching, blindness) are serious and warrant immediate medical attention from a qualified doctor.
entries.translation: Astaamahiisa (cuncun aadka ah, arag la'aan) waa halis, waxayna u baahan yihiin in loo tago dhakhtar rasmi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He needs to be properly diagnosed and, if he does have onchocerciasis, receive the appropriate prescription medication.
entries.translation: Wuxuu u baahan yahay in si sax ah loo ogaado jirrada, haddii uu onchocerciasis qaba na si uu u helo daawo sax ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Delaying proper medical care can lead to permanent vision loss and other serious complications.
entries.translation: Dib u dhigista daryeel caafimaad ayaa horseed karta aragga oo si joogto ah loo waayo iyo dhibaatooyin kale oo daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should see a doctor as soon as possible.
entries.translation: Waa in uu dhakhtar arkaa sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan..
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Answer: No, schistosomiasis is not a genetic disease and cannot be passed directly from parents to their children through genes.
entries.translation: Jawaab: Maya, schistosomiasis ma aha jirro la iska dhaxlo, waalidkana si toos ma ugu wareejin karo carruurta iyadoo loo marayo hidde-sideyaal
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: It's a parasitic infection caused by flatworms called schistosomes.
entries.translation: Waa caabuq dulin ka dasha oo gooryaan fidksan oo lagu magacaabo schistosomes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: You get it by coming into contact with contaminated freshwater where the parasite larvae live.
entries.translation: Waxaad qaadeysaa markaad la falgasho biyo webi oo ay ku nool yihiin dulin tixiri (larvae).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: These larvae penetrate the skin and develop inside the body.
entries.translation: Tixiriyadan ayaa ka gudba maqaarka kuna tarma jirka gudihiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: So, while family members might be at higher risk if they share the same contaminated water source, it's due to shared environmental exposure, not inheritance.
entries.translation: Sidaa daraadeed, inkastoo xubnaha qoyska ay halis dheeri ah ugu jiraan haddii isla isticmaalaan hal biyo oo wasakheysan, haddana waxaa lagu kala qaadaa in hal bi'o lagu wada nool yahay, ma aha wax la kala dhaxlo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: He should definitely see a doctor to get diagnosed and treated properly, as untreated schistosomiasis can lead to serious long-term health issues.
entries.translation: Waa khasab in uu dhakhtar arko si loo ogaado oo si sax ahna loo daaweeyo maaddaama schistosomiasis aan la daaweynin ay horseedi karto arrin caafimaad oo daran oo muddo dheer qaatada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Hi there, Moe! It's good to see you again, even if it's under these circumstances. I hear you've been having some trouble with your memory lately?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Haye, Moe! Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan mar kale ku arko, xitaa hadday tahay iyadoo lagu jiro duruufahan oo kale. Waxaan maqlay in aad dhibaato kala kulmeysay xusuustaada dhawaanahaan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Moe: Yeah, it's been really weird. I've been forgetting things like where I put my keys or what I was supposed to do for homework. It's getting kind of scary.
entries.translation: Moe: Haa, runtii waxaay ahayd wax la yaab leh. Waxaan illaabayey waxyaabo qaar meesha aan dhigo sida furayaasheyda ama waxa aan ku sameyn lahaa shaqada guriga. Waxaay sii noqoneysaa nooc cabsi leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I understand. It can be unsettling when our memory isn't working the way we expect it to. How long has this been going on?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: waan fahmay. Waxaay noqon kartaa mid walwalkeeda leh markay xusuusteenu u shaqeynin sidii aan fileynay. Intee in le'eg ayay tani socotay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Moe: Maybe a few weeks now? It started out small, but it seems to be getting worse.
entries.translation: Moe: Malaha dhawr toddobaad hadda? Waxaay ku billaabatay si yar, laakiin waxaay u muuqataa inay sii xumaaneyso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay. And have you noticed any other changes recently? Maybe changes in your sleep, appetite, or mood?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Hagaag. Oo ma dareentay wax isbeddel ah oo kale dhawaan? Waxaa laga yaabaa in isbeddello ku yimaadaan hurdadaada, rabitaankaada cuntada, ama niyadda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Moe: Not really. I've been feeling a bit stressed with school, but otherwise everything seems normal.
entries.translation: Moe: Maya runtii. Waxaan dareemayey xoogaa walbahaar dhanka iskoolka ah, laakiin intaa waxaan ka ahayn wax walba waxaay u muuqdaan kuwo caadi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Moe: Okay, that sounds good. Thanks, Dr. Musa.
entries.translation: Moe: Hagaag, waa arrin fiican. Mahadsanid, Dikt. Musa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: You're welcome, Moe. We'll figure this out together.
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: Soo dhawow, Moe. Tani waan wada xalin doonnaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chief Complaint: Patient presented for mandatory DOT physical with concerns regarding gallbladder issues. Notable limp observed upon arrival.

entries.english: 2. Right knee strain: Likely contributing to the limp.
entries.translation: 2. Murqaha Jilibka Midig: Waxaay u badan tahay inuu ka qayb qaadanayo dhutinta.

entries.english: 3. Medical anxiety/mistrust: Patient's apprehension may impact adherence to treatment recommendations.

entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3. Suggest over-the-counter analgesics for knee pain as needed.
entries.translation: 3. Soo jeedi dawooyinka xanuun baabi'iyaha ee aan u baahnayn warqad dhakhtar (OTC) ee loo qaato xanuunka jilibka haddii loo baahdo.

entries.english: 4. Discuss the importance of follow-up care and address patient's concerns regarding medical treatment to build trust.
entries.translation: 4. Kala hadal muhiimadda daryeelka dabagalka ah iyo wax ka qabashada walaaca bukaanka ee ku saabsan daaweynta caafimaadka si loo dhiso kalsooni.

entries.english: 5. DOT certification pending results of gallbladder evaluation. Patient advised that untreated gallbladder issues could potentially impact driving safety.
entries.translation: 5. Shahaadada DOT waxaay sugeysaa natiijooyinka qiimeynta xameetida. Bukaanka waxaa lagula taliyey in arrimaha xameetida ee aan la daweyn ay saammeyn ku yeelan karaan badbaadada gaari wadista.

entries.english: Musculoskeletal: Right leg shows a slight limp upon ambulation. No visible deformities, swelling, or tenderness to palpation. Range of motion within normal limits.
entries.translation: Murqaha: Lugta midig waxaay muujisaa dhutin yar marka la socdo. Ma jiro cillad jireed oo muuqata, barar, ama jilicsanaan taabashada. Dhaqdhaqaaq kala duwan ee xadka caadiga ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: All other systems: Unremarkable.
entries.translation: Dhammaan nidaamyada kale: Ma la aqoonsan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: Qiimaynta:

entries.english: Provide patient with information on prenatal testing options available at the hospital or through referrals.
entries.translation: Sii bukaanka macluumaad ku saabsan ikhtiyaarrada baaritaanka dhalmada kahor ee laga heli karo isbitaalka ama iyada oo loo marayo gudbinta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Advise patient to follow up with his primary care physician regarding the limp if it persists or worsens.
entries.translation: Kula tali bukaanka in uu u tago dhakhtarkiisa daryeelka aasaasiga ah ee ku saabsan dhutinta haddii ay sii socoto ama ka sii darto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Discharge home with instructions to return if any new symptoms develop.
entries.translation: Isbitaalka ka saar adigoo siinaya tilmaamo uu ku soo laabanayo haddii ay jiraan astaamo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Instructions for your Traumatic Brain Injury Recovery
entries.translation: Tilmaamaha Soo kabashadaada Dhaawaca Maskaxda ee Jaha-wareerka leh
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4. Physical Activity: Engage in light physical activity, such as walking or gentle stretching, for 15-20 minutes daily. Avoid any activities that could result in another head injury, such as contact sports.
entries.translation: 4. Dhaqdhaqaaqa Jirka: Samee dhaqdhaqaaq jireed oo fudud, sida socod ama iskala bixin qiyaasan 15-20 daqiiqo maalin kasta. Iska ilaali hawlaha keeni kara dhaawac kale oo madaxa ah, sida ciyaaraha la isla ciyaaro.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 5. Hydration and Nutrition: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to stay hydrated. Eat regular, balanced meals to support your recovery. Avoid alcohol and limit caffeine intake.
entries.translation: 5. Biyo-siinta Jirka iyo Nafaqada: Cab biyo badan maalintii oo dhan si aad u jirka u waraabiso. Cun cunto joogto ah oo si ay gacan uga geystaan soo kabashadaada. Iska ilaali khamriga yaree n qaadashada kafeynta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Good afternoon, Byung-ho. I see you're here for a follow-up on your OCD. How have you been managing lately?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Galab wanaagsan, Byung-ho. Waxaan arkaa inaad halkan u joogto daba-gal ku saabsan OCD-gaaga. Sideed u maaraynaysay dhawaanahan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Byung-ho: Honestly, doctor, not great. The intrusive thoughts have been really intense, and the compulsions are taking up so much of my time. It's getting harder to leave the house.
entries.translation: Byung-ho: Runtii, dhakhtar, ma fiicna. Fikradaha faragelinta leh aad bay u xoog badnaayeen, qasbiduna waxay qaadanaysaa wax badan oo waqtigeyga ah. Way sii adkaanaysaa in guriga laga baxo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a bit more about the specific thoughts and compulsions you've been experiencing?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Waan ka xumahay inaan maqlo taas. Ma ii sheegi kartaa wax yar oo dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan fikradaha khaaska ah iyo qasbitaannada aad la kulantay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: That sounds incredibly difficult. Have there been any changes in your life or stressors that might have triggered this increase in symptoms?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Taasi waxaay u egtahay mid aad u adag. Ma jireen wax isbedel ah oo noloshaada ah ama walbahaar kiciyay kordhinta astaamahan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Byung-ho: School has been stressful lately, with exams coming up. And my grandma fell ill recently, which has been worrying me. Maybe that's contributing.
entries.translation: Byung-ho: Dugsigu wuxuu ahaa mid walbahaar leh dhawaanahan, iyadoo imtixaanadu soo socdaan. Ayeeydayna dhawaan ayay xanuunsatay, taasoo i werwerisay. Taasi ayaa laga yaabaa in ay gacan ka geysaneyso.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: It's very likely that stress is playing a role. How have you been coping with these feelings? Have you been using any of the techniques we discussed previously?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Waxaay aad ugu dhowdahay in walbahaarku kaalin ku leeyahay. Sideed ula tacaalaysay dareennadan? Miyaad isticmaashay mid ka mid ah farsamooyinkii aan hore uga hadalnay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Byung-ho: I try to resist the compulsions sometimes, but the anxiety just builds up until I can't take it anymore. I feel like I'm failing.
entries.translation: Byung-ho: Waxaan isku dayaa inaan iska caabbiyo qasbitaanka mararka qaarkood, laakiin walwalka ayaa kor u kacaya ilaa aanan xamili karin in dheeri ah. Waxaan dareemayaa inaan fashilmayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Byung-ho: That sounds like a good idea. I'm willing to try anything to get some relief.
entries.translation: Byung-ho: Taasi waxaay u egtahay fikrad fiican. Waxaan diyaar u ahay inaan isku dayo wax kasta si aan u helo nafis.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: We can also explore some additional coping strategies for managing stress and anxiety. Would you be open to discussing those?
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Waxaan sidoo kale sahamin karnaa xeelado dheeraad ah oo lagula tacaalayo walbahaarka iyo walwalka.Diyaar ma u tahay inaad ka hadasho kuwaas?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Byung-ho: Yes, please. Anything that can help me feel more in control would be great.
entries.translation: Byung-ho: Haa, fadlan. Wax kasta oo iga caawin kara inaan dareemo koontarool dheeraad ah ayaa noqon doona mid aad u wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: Okay, let's start by...
entries.translation: Dhakhtar: Hagaag, aan ku bilowno...
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: Hey there, Mr. Diallo. What brings you in today?
entries.translation: Dikt. Anya: Sidee tahay, Mr. Diallo. Maxaa ku keenay maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: Hi, Dr. Anya. I've been having some trouble breathing lately, especially when I'm at work. It's getting to the point where I can't really do my job properly.
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Sidee tahay, Dikt. Anya. Waxa dhib igu ahaa neefsashada beryahan dambe, gaar ahaan marka aan joogo shaqada. Waxa ay gaadhay heer aanan si fiican u gudan karin shaqadayda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: I see. Can you tell me a little more about what's been going on?
entries.translation: Dikt. Anya: Waan arkaa. Wax yar ma iiga sheegi kartaa xaaladdaada sida ay ahayd?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: Okay. Have you noticed anything else? Any chest pain, coughing, or wheezing?
entries.translation: Dr. Anya: Hagaag. Ma isku aragtay wax kale? Waxlaab xanuun, qufac, ama hiin-raag?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: No, nothing like that. Just the shortness of breath.
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Maya, wax sidaa oo kale ma jiraan. Neefta oo igu yar kaliya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: Alright. Let's take a listen to your lungs.
entries.translation: Dikt. Anya: Hagaag. Aan dhagaysano sambabadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: (Dr. Anya listens to Mr. Diallo' lungs with a stethoscope.)
entries.translation: (Dikt. Anya ayaa dhageysaneysa sambabada Mr. Diallo iyada oo isticmaalaysa qalabka lagu dhageysto.)
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: Your lungs sound clear, but I do hear some wheezing. Have you been smoking?
entries.translation: Dikt. Anya: Sambabadaadu way fiican yihiin, laakiin waxaan maqlayaa hiin-raag. Ma sigaar ayaad cabtaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: No, I don't smoke.
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Maya, sigaar ma cabbo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: Okay. Well, based on what you're telling me and what I'm hearing, it sounds like you might have asthma.
entries.translation: Dikt. Anya: Hagaag. Iyada oo lagu salaynayo waxa aad ii sheegayso iyo waxa aan maqlayo, waxay u muuqataa in aad qabto neef.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: Asthma? Really? I've never had asthma before.
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Neef? Oo run ahaa? Waligey hore uma qabin neef.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Anya: It's possible to develop asthma later in life, especially if you're overweight. Carrying extra weight can put pressure on your lungs and make it harder to breathe.
entries.translation: Dikt. Anya: Waa suurtogal in uu qofku yeesho neef markuu weynaado, gaar ahaan haddii uu miisaankaagu kordho. Miisaanka dheeraadka ah wuxuu culays saari karaa sambabadaada wuxuuna adkeyn karaa neefsashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: Oh, I see. So what can we do about it?
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Haa, waan arkaa. Haddaba maxaan ka qaban karnaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: That would be great. I really appreciate it, Dr. Anya.
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Taasi waa wax aad u fiican. Runtii waan kaaga mahadcelinayaa, Dikt. Anya.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Diallo: Will do. Thanks again.
entries.translation: Mr. Diallo: Waad igu ogtahay. Mar labaad waad mahadsan tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 1.  **Rest and Activity:**
entries.translation: 1.  **Nasashada iyo Hawl-qabadka:**
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Limit strenuous activity for the next [number] days/weeks.
entries.translation: *   Xaddid dhaqdhaqaaqa culus [tirada] maalmaha/ toddobaadyada soo socda.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Avoid putting excessive weight or strain on the treated area.
entries.translation: *   Iska ilaali inaad miisaan xad-dhaaf ah ama culays saarto meesha la daweeyay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Gradually resume normal activities as tolerated.
entries.translation: *   Si tartiib tartiib ah dib ugu billoow hawlaha caadiga ah qaab loogu dulqaadan karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 2.  **Medication:**
entries.translation: 2.  **Daawada:**
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Take prescribed pain medication as directed.
entries.translation: *   U qaado daawada xanuunka ee laguu qoray sida lagu faray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Avoid anti-inflammatory medications (NSAIDs) unless specifically instructed otherwise.
entries.translation: *   Iska ilaali dawooyinka ka hortagga bararka (NSAIDs) ilaa in  si gaar ah laguu faray mooyaane.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 3.  **Wound Care:**
entries.translation: 3.  **Daryeelka Dhaawaca:**
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Keep the injection site clean and dry.
entries.translation: *   Goobta duritaanka nadiifi oo qallaji.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Change dressings as needed.
entries.translation: *   Beddel marada ku xiran hadba sida loogu baahdo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Monitor for signs of infection (redness, swelling, drainage).
entries.translation: *   La soco calaamadaha caabuqa (casaan, barar, dheecaan).
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 4.  **Diet and Hydration:**
entries.translation: 4.  **Cuntada iyo Waraabinta jirka:**
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Maintain a healthy diet rich in nutrients to support healing.
entries.translation: *   Joogtee cunto caafimaad leh oo ka buuxaan nafaqooyin si ay u taageerto bogsashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Stay well-hydrated by drinking plenty of water.
entries.translation: *   Si fiican u waraabi jirkaaga adigoo cabbaya biyo badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.translation: 5.  **Ballamaha Dabagalka:**
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Attend all scheduled follow-up appointments to monitor progress.
entries.translation: *   Ka qaybgal dhammaan ballamaha dabagalka ee loo qorsheeyay si loola socdo horumarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: 6.  **Contact Information:**
entries.translation: 6.  **Macluumaadka Nagala soo Xiriirayo:**
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   Contact Dr. Kofi Mensah immediately if you experience any concerning symptoms, such as severe pain, fever, or signs of infection.
entries.translation: *   La xiriir Dikt. Kofi Mensah isla markaaba haddii aad isku aragto wax astaamo ah oo khuseeya, sida xanuun daran, qandho, ama calaamadaha caabuqa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Additional Instructions:**
entries.translation: **Tilmaamo Dheeri ah:**

entries.translation: *   [Tilmaamaha gaarka ah ee la xiriira nooca daaweynta dib u soo celinta]
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: *   [Any other personalized instructions for the patient]
entries.translation: *   [Tilmaamo kasta oo kale oo shakhsiyeed oo loogu talagalay bukaanka]
