entries.english: **Please note:** These instructions are general guidelines. Your doctor may provide specific instructions tailored to your individual needs.
entries.translation: **Fadlan ogoow:** Tilmaamahani waa tilmaamo guud. Dhakhtarkaaga ayaa laga yaabaa inuu ku siiyo tilmaamo gaar ah oo ku habboon baahiyahaaga gaarka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: **Remember:** Healing takes time. Be patient with your body and follow these instructions carefully for optimal results.
entries.translation: **Xusuusnoow:** Bogsashadu waxaay qaadataa waqti. U dulqaado jirkaaga oo si taxadar leh u raac tilmaamahan si aad u hesho natiijooyin wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hello there, Mr. B. How are you doing today?
entries.translation: Haloow, Mr. B. Sidee tahay maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I'm doing alright, doctor. But my daughter insisted I come in for this checkup. Says I've been forgetting things lately.
entries.translation: Waan fiicanahay, dhakhtar. Laakin gabadhayda ayaa ku adkaysatay inaan imaado baaritaankan. Waxaay tiri waxaad ahayd ilawsho badan dhowaanahanba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Well, it's always good to be cautious. Tell me a bit more about what's been happening.
entries.translation: Hagaag, mar walba way wanaagsan tahay inaad taxaddarto. Wax dheeri ah iiga sheeg waxa ku heysta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Oh, just silly things, you know. Losing my keys, forgetting appointments... my daughter says I repeat myself sometimes too.
entries.translation: Oh, kaliya waxyaabo aan micno lahayn, ma ogtahay. Furayaashayda ayaa iga lummaya, ballamaha ayaan illaabaa... gabadhaydu waxaay leedahay mararka qaar waad ku celcelisaa hadalka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Okay, I see. And how long has this been going on?
entries.translation: Haye, waan gartay. Muddo intee le'eg ayay tani socotay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hmm, maybe a few months now. Hard to say exactly.
entries.translation: Hmm, malaha dhowr bilood hadda. Way adag tahay in si sax ah loo sheego muddada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Have you noticed any changes in your mood or sleep patterns?
entries.translation: Miyaad dareentay wax isbeddel ah niyaddaada ama qaabka hurdadaada?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Well, I have been feeling a bit down lately. And sleeping hasn't been easy either.
entries.translation: Hagaag, waxaan dareemayay niyad-jab yar maalmahan. Hurdaduna ma fududayn sidoo kale.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I understand. Now, looking at your medical history, I see you have quite a few conditions you're managing. High blood pressure, diabetes, arthritis... that's a lot to handle.
entries.translation: Waan fahmayaa. Hadda, markaan eego taariikhdaada caafimaad, waxaan arkaa inaad qabto xaalado dhawr ah oo aad maareyneyso. Dhiig-karka, sonkorowga, bararka kala-goysyada jirka... waa wax badan in lala tacaalo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yes, it is. Taking all these pills can be confusing sometimes.
entries.translation: Haa, waa runtaa. Qaadashada kiniiniyadan oo dhan mararka qaarkood ayaa jahawareer keeni kara.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I can imagine. We'll definitely review your medications today. Sometimes certain medications can affect memory and thinking.
entries.translation: Waan qiyaasi karaa. Maanta waxaan dib u eegi doonnaa daawooyinkaaga. Mararka qaarkood daawooyinka qaar waxaay saameyn karaan xusuusta iyo fekerka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Really? I didn't know that.
entries.translation: Runtii? Maan ogayn taas.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Yes, it's possible. We'll also do some simple tests to check your memory and cognitive function. Nothing to worry about, just standard procedure.
entries.translation: Haa, waa suurtagal. Waxaan sidoo kale samayn doonnaa baaritaanno fudud si aan u hubinno xusuustaada iyo shaqada garashadaada. Ma jiraan wax laga walwalo, kaliya waa nidaam caadi ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Alright, doctor. Whatever you think is best.
entries.translation: Hagaag, dhakhtar. Wax kasta oo aad u malaynayso inay ugu fiican tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: And don't worry, Mr. B. We're here to help you figure this out. We'll work together to find the best way to manage your health and keep your mind sharp.
entries.translation: Ha na walwalin, Mr. B. Halkan waxaan u joognaa inaan kaa caawinno inaad tan xalliso. Waan wada shaqeyn doonnaa si aan u helno habka ugu fiican ee lagu maareeyo caafimaadkaaga looga na dhigo maskaxdaada mid fiican.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Thank you, doctor. I appreciate that.
entries.translation: Mahadsanid, dhakhtar. Waan mahadnaqayaa taas .
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sure, here's a dialogue discussing the lab results:
entries.translation: Hagaag, waa kan wadahadalka lagaga hadlayo natiijada shaybaarka:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Aris Thorne: So, Mr. Musa, we've got the data from your continuous glucose monitor. Let's take a look.
entries.translation: Dikt. Aris Thorne: Marka, Mr. Musa, waxaan heynaa xogta kormeerahaaga gulukooska ee joogtada ah. aan eegno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ibrahim Musa: Lay it on me, Doc. How'd I do?
entries.translation: Ibrahim Musa: ii sheeg Dhakhtar. Sideen wax u qabtay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juliana: That's great to hear! I've been trying to be more mindful of what I eat.
entries.translation: Juliana: Waa wax fiican in taas aan maqlo! Waxaan isku dayayey inaan aad uga fiirsado waxa aan cuno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Thorne: It shows. However, we did notice a few spikes after dinner, especially on weekends. Those late-night snacks might be the culprit.
entries.translation: Dr. Thorne: Way u muuqataa. Hase yeeshee, waxaan dareennay in yar oo sare u kac ah cashada kaddib, gaar ahaan maalmaha fasaxa ah. Cuntooyinka fudud ee habeenkii dambe ayaa laga yaabaa inay sabab u yihiin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juliana: Yeah, I have a weakness for late-night pizza...
entries.translation: Juliana: Haa, waxaan u nulahay cunidda biisa xilliga dambe habeenkii...
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juliana: Sounds like a plan. Anything else?
entries.translation: Juliana: Waxaay u egtahay qorshe fiican. Wax kale ma jiraan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Thorne: Your average glucose levels are slightly higher in the mornings. We might need to tweak your basal insulin rate a bit to keep things steady overnight.
entries.translation: Dr. Thorne: Celceliska heerarka gulukoostaada waxyar bay ka sarreeyaan subaxdii. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan u baahannahay inaan yara hagaajinno heerkaaga insulin-ta si aan wax walba u ilaalinno habeenkii oo dhan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juliana: Okay, got it. So, overall, good progress, but room for improvement?
entries.translation: Juliana: Hagaag, waan gartay. Markaa, guud ahaan, horumar wanaagsan, laakiin ma jiraa wax gaabsi ah oo aan wax ka qabbto?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Thorne: Exactly. You're on the right track, Juliana. Just a few minor adjustments and we'll have those numbers looking even better next time.
entries.translation: Dr. Thorne: Dhab ahaantii. Wadadii saxda ahayd ayaad ku taagan tahay Juliana. Kaliya dhowr wax ka beddel oo yaryar oo waxaan heli doonnaa tirooyinkaas oo u muuqda kuwo ka sii fiican marka xigta.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Juliana: Thanks, Dr. Thorne. I appreciate the guidance.
entries.translation: Juliana: Mahadsanid, Dikt. Thorne. Waan kaaga mahadnaqanaa hagidaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Thorne: No problem. Keep up the good work, and we'll chat again soon.
entries.translation: Dr. Thorne: Dhib malahan. Sii wad shaqada wanaagsan, mar dhow ayaan markale wada sheekeysan doonnaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Telehealth Nurse: I understand completely, Kaelen. It's not uncommon for people to feel apprehensive about medical settings. Can you tell me a little more about Ms. Vance's concerns?
entries.translation: Kalkaalisada Telehealth: Si buuxda ayaan kuu fahmay, Kaelen. Ma aha wax aan caadi ahayn in dadku ay dareemaan cabsi ku saabsan goobaha caafimaadka. Ma ii sheegi kartaa in yar oo ku saabsan walaaca heysta Ms. Vance?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Librarian: That's reassuring to hear. Is there anything else we can do to help her feel more comfortable?
entries.translation: Shaqaale Maktabad: Taasi waa mid dhiirigelin leh in la maqlo. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan sameyn karno si aan u caawinno inay dareento in ay aad u qanacdo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Primary Care Physician (PCP): Good morning, Mr. Adair. I see we have a paternity test scheduled for you today. Is that correct?
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka Daryeelka Aasaasiga ah (PCP): Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Adair. Waxaan arkaa in aan maanta kuu qabannay baaritaanka aabbannimada. Ma saxbaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adair: Yes, that's right. It's a bit of a whirlwind, to be honest.
entries.translation: Mr. Adair: Haa, waa sax. Waa arrin yara wareer ah, run ahaantii.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCP: I understand. These situations can be stressful. Can you tell me a little about what brings you in for testing?
entries.translation: PCP: Waan fahmay. Xaaladahaan waxaay noqon karaan walaac. Ma ii sheegi kartaa wax yar oo ku saabsan waxa kuu keenaya baaritaan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adair: Well, my ex-girlfriend, Maria, just had a baby, a little girl named Lucia. Maria says I'm the father, but we weren't together when she got pregnant, so I'm not sure.
entries.translation: Mr. Adair: Hagaag, saaxiibadaydii hore, Maria, ayaa canug dhashay, gabar yar oo loogu magac daray Lucia. Maria waxaay leedahay anigaa aabaha ah, laakiin ma wada joogin markay uurka yeelatay, marka ma hubo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCP: It's important to have clarity in these situations, for everyone involved. Have you discussed this with Maria?
entries.translation: PCP: Waa muhiim in xaaladahan la xaqiijiyo, loo xaqiijiyo qof walba oo ku lug leh. Ma kala hadashay arrintan Maria?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adair: Maria agreed to bring Lucia in later today for her swab.
entries.translation: Mr. Adair: Maria waxaay ogolaatay inay Lucia keento maanta gelinka dambe si looga qaado dheecaanka dhabanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCP: Excellent. Once we have both samples, we'll send them to the lab for analysis. Results usually take about a week.
entries.translation: PCP: Waa mid aad u fiican. Markaan helno labada sambal, waxaan u diri doonnaa shaybaarka si loo falanqeeyo. Natiijooyinka badanaa waxaay qaataan qiyaastii toddobaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adair: A week seems like a lifetime right now.
entries.translation: Mr. Adair: Toddobaad wuxuu hadda u muuqdaa sida cimri dheer.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCP: I know it's tough waiting. In the meantime, try to focus on taking care of yourself. Do you have any questions about the procedure or the results?
entries.translation: PCP: Waan ogahay inay adag tahay in la sugo. Dhanka kale, isku day inaad diiradda saarto daryeelka naftaada. Wax su'aallo ah ma ka qabtaa habraaca ama natiijooyinka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adair: Not really. Just hoping for a clear answer, whatever it may be.
entries.translation: Mr. Adair: Maya runtii. Kaliya waxaan rajeynayaa jawaab cad, wax kasta oo ay noqon kartaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: PCP: We'll do our best to get you those answers as soon as possible. Now, if you're ready, we can proceed with the cheek swab.
entries.translation: PCP: Waxaan ku dedaali doonnaa inaan jawaabahaas kuu helno sida ugu dhakhsaha badan. Hadda se, haddii aad diyaar tahay, waxaan sii wadi karnaa qaadista dheecaanka dhabanka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Adair: Okay, let's do this.
entries.translation: Mr. Adair: Hagaag, aan sameyno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here is a draft focusing on general adherence principles for gastrointestinal issues, using a fictional patient name:
entries.translation: Halkan waxaa ku qoran qoraal diiradda saaraya mabaadi'da guud ee u hoggaansanaanta arrimaha caloosha, iyadoo la adeegsanayo magac bukaan oo mala-awaal ah:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Adherence Plan for Mateo Hernandez
entries.translation: Qorshaha u Hogaansanaanta ee Loogu Talogalay Mateo Hernandez
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: This plan outlines the steps we discussed to help Mateo feel better. Following these instructions carefully is important for managing his symptoms.
entries.translation: Qorshahani waxa uu qeexayaa tallaabooyinka aan ka wada hadalnay si aanu u caawino Mateo inuu soo roonaado. Raacitaanka tilmaamahan si taxaddar leh ayaa muhiim u ah maareynta astaamahiisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Medication:
entries.translation: Daawada:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Give the prescribed medication exactly as directed on the bottle. Do not skip doses or stop giving the medication even if Mateo starts feeling better, unless instructed by the doctor.
entries.translation: Bixi dawada laguu qoray sida saxda ah ee lagu faray qoraalka dhalada. Ha ka boodin qiyaasta daawada ama ha joojin siinta dawada xitaa haddii uu Mateo billaabo inuu dareemo fiicnaan, ilaa uu dhakhtarku ku faro mooyee.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Diet:
entries.translation: Cuntada:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If Mateo is breastfeeding or formula-feeding, continue as usual unless otherwise directed.
entries.translation: Haddii Mateo uu naas nuujinayo ama caano uu wax ku quudinayo, sii wad sidii caadiga ahayd haddii aan si kale la farin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Hygiene:
entries.translation: Nadaafadda:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Wash hands thoroughly with soap and water after using the bathroom or changing diapers, and before preparing or eating food.
entries.translation: Si fiican ugu dhaq gacmaha saabbuun iyo biyo kaddib markaad isticmaasho musqusha ama beddesho xafaayadda, iyo ka hor inta aanad diyaarin ama cunin cuntada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Encourage Mateo to wash his hands frequently as well.
entries.translation: Ku dhiiri geli Mateo inuu sidoo kale gacmihiisa dhaqo marar badan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Monitoring:
entries.translation: Kormeerka:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Keep a record of Mateo's symptoms, including frequency of bowel movements, consistency of stool, vomiting episodes, and fever.
entries.translation: Hayso diiwaanka astaamaha Mateo, oo ay ku jiraan inta jeer ee la diiwaangeliyey saxarada, joogteynta saxarada, dhacdooyinka matagga, iyo qandhada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Contact the doctor if Mateo experiences severe abdominal pain, blood in stool, persistent vomiting, signs of dehydration (dry mouth, no tears when crying, sunken eyes), or high fever.
entries.translation: La xiriir dhakhtarka haddii Mateo la kulmo calool xanuun daran, dhiig saxarada ku jira, matag joogto ah, calaamadaha fuuqbaxa (af qallayl, ilmo la'aan markuu ooyo, indho godan), ama qandho sare.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Follow-up:
entries.translation: Dabagalka:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Schedule a follow-up appointment as recommended by the doctor to monitor Mateo's progress.
entries.translation: Jadwal u samee ballan dabagal ah sida uu ku taliyey dhakhtarku si loola socdo horumarka Mateo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Remember:
entries.translation: Xusuusnoow:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Consistency is key. Sticking to the medication schedule and dietary recommendations will help Mateo recover faster.
entries.translation: Joogteynta ayaa muhiim ah. Ku dheggidda jadwalka daaweynta iyo talooyinka cuntada waxaay ka caawin doontaa Mateo inuu si dhakhso ah u bogsado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to call the doctor's office.
entries.translation: Haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah, ha ka gabanin inaad wacdo xafiiska dhakhtarka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Reason for Visit: Red, inflamed right eye
entries.translation: Sababta Booqashada: Isha midig oo cas, bararsan
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: However, a young woman presenting to an urgent care clinic *regarding* TOS is a plausible scenario.  Here is a description of that:
entries.translation: Si kastaba ha ahaatee, haweenay da'yar oo rugta daryeelka degdegga ah ugu tagta wax *ku saabsan* TOS waa xaalad macquul ah. Waa kan sharraxaadda taas:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I take a deep breath, trying to steady my voice. "Better," I say, the word catching in my throat. "The panic attacks aren't as frequent, and I'm sleeping a bit more."
entries.translation: Neef dheer ayaan qaadanayaa, anigoo isku dayaya inaan codkayga dejiyo. "Si wanaagsan," ayaan leeyahay, ereyga oo dhuuntayda ku qabtay. "Weerarada argagaxa ma aha kuwa soo noqnoqda, waxaanan seexdaa xoogaa wax badan."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "That's good to hear," Dr. Adewale nods, jotting something down. "And your weight? Any changes there?"
entries.translation: "Waa wax lagu farxo in sidaa tahay," Dr. Adewale oo madaxa ruxaya, isagoo wax wax qoraya. "Miisaankaagu ka warran? Ma jiraan wax isbeddel ah?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I hesitate, my gaze dropping to my lap. "Not really," I mumble. "I try to eat healthy, but sometimes... it's hard."
entries.translation: Waan ka labalabeynayaa, anigoo indhaha hoos aadinaya. "Maya runtii," ayaa ku guuxayaa. "Waxaan isku dayaa inaan cuno cunno caafimaad qabta, laakiin mararka qaarkood... way adag tahay."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "I know," I say quietly. "I'll try harder."
entries.translation: "Waan ogahay," ayaan si aamusan u iri. "Si ka adag ayaan isugu dayi doonaa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I take the pamphlet, feeling a flicker of hope ignite within me. Maybe I can do this. Maybe I can take control of my health, one small step at a time.
entries.translation: Buug-yaraha ayaan qaadanayaa, anigoo dareemaya rajo bidhaamaysa oo igu dhex shidmeysa. Hashaan waan sammeyn karaa. Laga yaabaa inaan xakameyn karo caafimaadkayga, hal tallaabo oo yar markiiba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: "Thank you, Dr. Adewale," I say, a genuine smile touching my lips for the first time since I walked into his office. "I appreciate it."
entries.translation: "Waad ku mahadsan tahay, Dikt. Adewale," ayaan leeyahay, iyadoo dhoola caddeyn dhab ah oo taabanaya bushimahayga markii ugu horeysay tan iyo markii aan soo galay xafiiskiisa. "waan ka mahadnaqayaa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ferreira: Hello there, I'm Dr. Ferreira. I understand you're concerned about your family history of severe combined immunodeficiency, is that right?
entries.translation: Dikt. Ferreira: Halloow, waxaan ahay Dikt. Ferreira. Waxaan dareemaya inaad ka walaacsan tahay taariikhda qoyskaaga ee cillad difaaca jirka oo daran, sax ma tahay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ferreira: I see. Well, let's take a look at your history and do a physical exam. Tell me more about this sweating. Is it all the time, or just when you exert yourself?
entries.translation: Dikt. Ferreira: Waan arkaa. Hagaag, bal aan eegno taariikhdaada caafimaad oo aan sameyno baaritaan jireed. Wax dheeri ah iiga sheeg dhididkan. Ma mar kastaa, mise waa marka aad dhaq-dhaqaaq sameyso oo keliya?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kai Tanaka: It's mostly when I'm active, but even just walking around makes me break out in a sweat. And it's not just a little bit of sweat, I'm talking about soaking through my clothes.
entries.translation: Kai Tanaka: Inta badan waa marka aan firfircoonahay, laakiin xitaa socodka oo keliya ayaa dhidid iga keenaya. Oo ma aha waxyar oo dhidid ah, waxaan ka hadlayaa in dharkayga uu qoyo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ferreira: Hmm, that is unusual. And you mentioned getting sick a lot. What kind of illnesses have you had recently?
entries.translation: Dikt. Ferreira: Hmm, taasi waa wax aan caadi ahayn. Oo waxaad sheegtay inaad aad u xanuunsato. Waa maxay nooca jirrada kugu dhacay dhowaan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kai Tanaka: Just colds and stuff, mostly. But they seem to drag on forever, and I feel wiped out all the time.
entries.translation: Kai Tanaka: Kaliya hergab iyo wax la mid ah, inta badan. Laakiin waxaay u muuqdaan inay sii jiitamayaan weligood, waxaana dareemayaa in aan dhammaaday mar walba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ferreira: Okay. Let's check your vitals. Your temperature is a bit high, 100.4 degrees. And your heart rate is elevated too.
entries.translation: Dikt. Ferreira: Hagaag. Aynu eegno waxyaabaha muhiimka ah. Heerkulkaagu wuu yara sarreeyaa, 100.4 darajo. Heerka  wadno garaacaaga sidoo kale wuu sarreeyaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kai Tanaka: Yeah, I've been feeling a bit feverish lately.
entries.translation: Kai Tanaka: Haa, waxaan dareemayey xoogaa qandho dhowaanahan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kai Tanaka: So what do you think it could be then?
entries.translation: Kai Tanaka: Markaa maxaad u malaynaysaa inay noqon karto?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kai Tanaka: Okay, whatever you think is best. I just want to figure out what's going on and get better.
entries.translation: Kai Tanaka: Hagaag, wax alla wixii aad u malaynayso inay ugu fiican yihiin. Kaliya waxaan rabaa inaan ogaado waxa socda oo aan roonaado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Kai Tanaka: Thanks, Dr. Ferreira. I appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Kai Tanaka: Mahadsanid, Dikt. Ferreira. Waan kaaga mahadcelinayaa caawintaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Ferreira: You're welcome, Kai. We'll get you feeling better soon.
entries.translation: Dikt. Ferreira: Soo dhowoow, Kai. Waan ku dedaaleynaa in aad mardhaw roonaato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dear Ms. Marisol Hernandez,
entries.translation: Marwo qaali, Marisol Hernandez,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Here are some things we discussed that can help:
entries.translation: Waa kuwan waxyaabihi aan ka wada hadalnay oo ku caawin kara:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Continue taking your hyperthyroidism medication as prescribed: This will help bring your thyroid levels back into balance, which should improve your breathing over time.
entries.translation: Sii wad qaadashada daaweynta tayroodhkaaga sida laguugu qoray: Tani waxaay kaa caawin doontaa inaad dib u soo celiso heerarka tayroodhkaaga, taasoo hagaajinaysa neefsashadaada muddo ka dib.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Use your inhaler as needed: If you have been prescribed an inhaler for wheezing, use it as directed by your doctor. This can help open up your airways and make breathing easier.
entries.translation: Isticmaal daawada neefta sida loogu baahdo: Haddii laguu qoray daawada neefta ee xiiqda, u isticmaal sida uu dhakhtarkaagu ku farayo. Tani waxaay kaa caawin kartaa furitaanka marin-haweedkaaga oo sahleysa neefsashada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest and relax: Try to get plenty of rest and avoid strenuous activities that might make your wheezing worse.
entries.translation: Nasasho iyo deganaan: Isku day inaad hesho nasasho badan oo iska ilaali hawlaha culus ee ka sii dari kara xiiqdaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Keep your environment clean: Dust and other allergens can trigger wheezing, so try to keep your home as clean and dust-free as possible.
entries.translation: Deegaankaaga nadiifi: Boorka iyo xasaasiyadaha kale waxay kicin karaan xiiq, markaa isku day inaad gurigaaga nadiifiso oo aad boor la'aan ka dhigto inta suurtogal ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Monitor your symptoms: Pay attention to your breathing and any other symptoms you may be experiencing. If your wheezing gets worse or you have trouble breathing, please contact your doctor immediately.
entries.translation: La soco astaamahaaga: U fiirso neefsashadaada iyo calaamadaha kale ee laga yaabo inaad la kulanto. Haddii xiiqdaadu ka sii darto ama ay dhibaato kaa haysato neefsashada, fadlan isla markiiba la xidhiidh dhakhtarkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: We also talked about some lifestyle changes that can help manage your hyperthyroidism and improve your overall health:
entries.translation: Waxaan sidoo kale ka hadalnay isbeddellada qaab nololeedka qaarkood oo kaa caawin kara maareynta tayroodhkaaga sare iyo hagaajinta caafimaadkaaga guud:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Eat a healthy diet: Focus on eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Avoid processed foods, sugary drinks, and excessive caffeine.
entries.translation: Cun cunto caafimaad leh: Diiradda saar cunista miro badan, khudaarta, iyo haruurka. Iska ilaali cuntooyinka warshadaysan, cabitaannada sonkorta leh, iyo kafeega xad-dhaafka ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Manage stress: Stress can worsen hyperthyroidism symptoms, so find healthy ways to manage stress, such as yoga, meditation, or spending time in nature.
entries.translation: Maaree walbahaarka: Walbahaarka ayaa ka sii dari kara astaamaha tayroodhka sare, marka raadi habab caafimaad qaba oo lagu maareeyo walbahaarka, sida yoga, ka niyad-dejinta, ama waqti ku qaadashada goobaha dabiiciga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Get regular exercise: moderate exercise can help improve your energy levels and overall health. Talk to your doctor before starting any new exercise program.
entries.translation: Samee jimicsi joogto ah: jimicsi dhexdhexaad ah ayaa kaa caawin kara hagaajinta heerarka tamartaada iyo caafimaadka guud. Kala hadal dhakhtarkaaga ka hor inta aanad billaabin barnaamij jimicsi oo cusub.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: I know managing a health condition can be challenging, but please know that I am here to support you. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out.
entries.translation: Waan ogahay maareynta xaalad caafimaad in ay adkaan karto, laakiin fadlan ogow inaan halkan u joogo inaan ku taageero. Haddii aad qabto wax su'aallo ah ama walaac ah, fadlan ha ka gabanin inaad nala soo xiriirto.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sincerely,
entries.translation: Si daacadnimo,
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Nurse Alejandro
entries.translation: Kalkaaliye Alejandro
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Well hello there, Wanjiku! It's been a minute, hasn't it? Come on in, make yourself comfortable. How have you been holding up since we last saw each other?"
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: "Hagaag haye, Wanjiku! Daqiiqad ayaan ka soo dhaahay, miyaanay ahayn? Kaalay gudaha, soo na dhawoow. Sideed ahayd tan iyo markii aan is aragnay?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Hey, Doc. Honestly, things haven't been great. The stump is still really bothering me, and the pain hasn't let up much."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Sidee tahay, Dhakhtar. Daacadnimo markaan u hadlo, arrimuhu ma fiicnayn. jirridda wali aad bay i dhibaysaa, xanuunkuna wax badan iskama dhimin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "It's pretty constant, Doc. Like a dull ache that sometimes shoots up my leg. And the swelling hasn't gone down much either."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Waa wax joogto ah, Dhakhtar. Sida xanuun caajis ah oo mararka qaarkood lugta kor ugu qaada. Bararkuna sidoo kale wax badan hoos uma dhicin."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Hmm, okay. That's definitely concerning. Let me examine the area gently. Just let me know if anything hurts too much, alright?"
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: "Hmm, waayahay. Taasi xaqiiqdii waa wax walaac leh. Aan si tartiib ah u baarno aagga. Ii sheeg haddii aad wax xanuun ah dareento, sax?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Okay."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Haye."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Alright, I see what you mean about the swelling. It does look a bit inflamed. Have you been able to keep it elevated and rest it as much as possible?"
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: "Hagaag, waan arkaa waxa aad kala jeedo bararka. Waxay u egtahay in yar oo bararsan. Ma awooday in aad kor u qaaddo oo aad yar jilciso inta suurtogalka ah?"
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "I've tried, Doc, but with the baby coming and everything else going on, it's been hard to stay off my feet completely."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Waan isku dayay, Dhakhtar, laakiin maaddaama ilmaha soo socdaan iyo waxyaabo kale oo nolosheyda ka socda, way adkeyd in aan gebi ahaanba ku istaago cagahayga."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "No fever, but it does feel warm to the touch sometimes. And maybe a little redder than usual."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Qandho ma jirto, laakiin waxaan dareemaa diirimaad markaan taabto mararka qaarkood. Sidoo kale wax yar oo casaan ayaa isku arkaa oo ka badan sidii caadiga ahayd."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Yeah, that sounds good, Doc. Anything to make this stop hurting so much."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Haa, taasi waxaayila tahay mid fiican, Dhakhtar. Aan sameyno wax kasta oo ka dhigi kara in tani ay aad ii sii xanuunjinin ."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient: "Thanks, Doc. I appreciate it."
entries.translation: Bukaanka: "Mahadsanid, Dhakhtar. Waan ka mahadcelinayaa."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Doctor: "Of course, Wanjiku. Take care of yourself and that little one, okay? We'll see you back here soon for a check-up."
entries.translation: Dhakhtarka: "Dabcan, Wanjiku. Iska ilaali naftaada iyo kan yar, okey? Halkan ayaan kugu arki doonnaa dhowaan si laguu baaro."
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Priya Kapoor: Good morning, Mr. Aris Thorne. How have you been since your surgery?
entries.translation: Dr. Priya Kapoor: Subax wanaagsan, Mudane Aris Thorne. Sidee ayaad ahayd tan iyo qalliinkaagii?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aris Thorne: Not the best, Doctor. I've been feeling quite dizzy and lightheaded lately, especially when I stand up. Sometimes I even feel like I'm going to faint.
entries.translation: Aris Thorne: Ma fiicni, Dhakhtar. Waxaan dareemayay dawakhaad iyo wareer waayadan dambe, gaar ahaan markaan istaago. Mararka qaar waxaan dareemaa xitaa inaan suuxayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aris Thorne: I try to, but maybe not as much as I should. My appetite hasn't been great either.
entries.translation: Aris Thorne: Waan isku dayaa, laakiin laga yaabaa inaysan ahayn intii la rabay. Rabitaankayga cuntada sidoo kale ma fiicnayn.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Kapoor: Dehydration can certainly contribute to these symptoms. It's crucial to stay hydrated, especially during recovery. Are you taking any medications currently?
entries.translation: Dikt. Kapoor: Fuuq-baxa ayaa hubaal wuxuu ka mid noqon karaa astaamahan. Waa muhiim in jirkaaga biyo badan qaato, gaar ahaan inta lagu jiro bogsashada. Wax daawooyin ah ma qaadataa hadda?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aris Thorne: Just the pain medication you prescribed and some antibiotics.
entries.translation: Aris Thorne: Kaliya daawada xanuunka aad ii qortay iyo qaar antibiyootik ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aris Thorne: Okay, that makes sense. Is there anything else I should be doing?
entries.translation: Aris Thorne: Waayahay, taasi waa macquul. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan sameeyo?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Aris Thorne: Thank you, Doctor. I'll try to drink more water and be more careful when getting up.
entries.translation: Aris Thorne: Waad mahadsan tahay, Dhakhtar. Waxaan isku dayi doonaa inaan cabbo biyo badan oo aan taxaddar dheeraad ah yeesho markaan kacayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Hello there. You look a little uncomfortable, can I help you find something?
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyaha: Iska warran, sidee tahay. Waxaad u egtahay qof yara dhibban, ma kaa ma wax caawimaad ah ayay u raadineysaa??
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elderly Person: Yes, hello. I'm here for my granddaughter, she has neonatal pneumonia. I'm... I'm not sure if this is the right place.
entries.translation: Qof Waayeel ah: Haa, iska warran. Waxaan u imid gabadhayda aan ayeeyada u ahay, waxay qabtaa oof wareenka ilmaha dhasha. Anigu... Ma hubo haddii ay tani meeshii saxda ahayd tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elderly Person: Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried. She's so small, and she's having such a hard time breathing.
entries.translation: Qof Waayeel ah: Waa Alle mahaddii. Aad baan u walaacsanaa. Aad ayay u yar tahay, aad bay na ugu dhibtooneysaa in ay neefsato.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elderly Person: That's very reassuring. Thank you. Do you think... do you think she'll be okay?
entries.translation: Qof Waayeel ah: Taasi waa mid dhiirigelin leh. Mahadsanid. Ma kula tahay... ma kula tahay inay fiicnaan doonto?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elderly Person: Thank you. Thank you so much. I feel a little better now.
entries.translation: Qof Waayeel ah: Mahadsanid. Aad baad u mahadsan tahay. Hadda xoogaa deganaan ayaan dareemayaa..
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: You're welcome. Please have a seat, and someone will be with you shortly to get your granddaughter checked in.
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyaha: Adigaa mudan. Fadlan fariiso. Qof ayaa dhowaan kuu imaan doona si loo diiwaangeliyo gabadha ayeyda u tahay.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Elderly Person: Thank you.
entries.translation: Qof Waayeel ah: Mahadsanid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paulo Gomes: Good morning, welcome to the free clinic. I'm Dr. Gomes. How can we help you today?
entries.translation: Paulo Gomes: Subax wanaagsan, ku soo dhawaada rugta caafimaad oo bilaashka ah. Waa Dikt. Gomes. Maxaan maanta kaa caawin karaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia Martins: Hi, Dr. Gomes. I'm Sofia Martins. I've been having some chest pain and shortness of breath lately.
entries.translation: Sofia Martins: Sidee tahay, Dikt. Gomes. Anigu waxaan ahay Sofia Martins. Waayadan waxaa i haayey laab xanuun iyo neef yari.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia Martins: Nice to meet you both.
entries.translation: Sofia Martins: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kulanno labadiinnaba.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: San: Hi, Sofia. I'll be taking your vitals and asking you some questions about your medical history.
entries.translation: San: Haa, Sofia. Baaritaanno jirka ayaan kugu sameyn doonaa, waxaana ku weydiin doonaa su'aallo ku saabsan taariikhdaada caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pratama: And I'm here to help with any social or financial concerns you might have that could affect your health.
entries.translation: Mr. Pratama: Waxaan halkan u joogaa inaan kaa caawiyo wixii walaac bulsho ama dhaqaale ee aad qabtid oo saameyn ku yeelan kara caafimaadkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paulo Gomes: Great. So, Sofia, can you tell us a little more about your chest pain? When did it start? Does anything make it better or worse?
entries.translation: Paulo Gomes: Hagaag. Marka, Sofia, waxyar oo dheeri ah  ma nooga sheegi kartaa xanuunkaaga laabta? Goorma ayuu lbilaabmay? Ma jiraa wax u roon ama sii kordhinaya xanuunka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia Martins: It started a few weeks ago. It usually happens when I'm active, like walking up stairs or carrying groceries. Resting seems to help a bit.
entries.translation: Sofia Martins: Waxa uu bilaabmay dhowr toddobaad ka hor. Badanaa waxaan dareemaa marka uu jirkeyga shaqeynayo, sida marka aan jaranjarada fuulayo ama qaado raashinka. Nasashada ayaa xoogaa i yar caawisa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paulo Gomes: Okay, that's helpful information. San, can you please take Sofia's blood pressure and listen to his heart and lungs?
entries.translation: Paulo Gomes: Hagaag, taasi waa xog muhiim ah. San, fadlan ma cabbiri kartaa heerka dhiig karka Sofia oo ma dhegaysan kartaa wadnihiisa iyo sambabada?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: San: Sure thing, Dr. Gomes.
entries.translation: San: Haa, aad iyo aad, Dikt.. Gomes.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pratama: While San is doing that, Sofia, do you have any concerns about paying for medication or follow-up appointments?
entries.translation: Mr. Pratama: Inta uu San taas samaynayo, Sofia, ma qabtaa wax walaac ah oo ku saabsan bixinta daawada ama ballamaha dabagalka?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia Martins: To be honest, money is tight right now. I don't have insurance.
entries.translation: Sofia Martins: Si daacad ah hadaan u hadlo, kharashka ayaa hadda nagu yar. Caymis ma lihi.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Pratama: Don't worry, Sofia. We can help you apply for financial assistance programs and connect you with resources for affordable medication.
entries.translation: Mr. Pratama: Ha werwerin, Sofia. Waanu kaa caawin karnaa inaad codsato barnaamijyada kaalmada maaliyadeed, waxaanan kugu xidhi karnaa ilaha daawaynta ee la awoodi karo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia Martins: Okay, that sounds good.
entries.translation: Sofia Martins: Hagaag, taasi waxaay u egtahay mid wanaagsan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paulo Gomes: Once we have the results, we can discuss a treatment plan. It might involve medication, lifestyle changes, or a referral to a specialist.
entries.translation: Paulo Gomes: Marka aan helno natiijooyinka, waxaan ka wada hadli karnaa qorshaha daaweynta. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku lug yeelato dawo, isbeddel qaab nololeed, ama u gudbinta khibradle caafimaad.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Sofia Martins: Thank you, everyone. I really appreciate your help.
entries.translation: Sofia Martins: Waad mahadsan tihiin dhammaantiin. Runtii waan idiin kaga mahadcelinayaa kaalmadiina.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Paulo Gomes: You're welcome, Sofia. We're here to work together as a team to improve your health.
entries.translation: Paulo Gomes: Soo dhowoow, Sofia. Waxaan halkaan u joognaa inaan u wada shaqeyno koox ahaan si aan u horumarinno caafimaadkaaga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Bone pain like you're experiencing can be caused by a number of things, including:
entries.translation: Xanuunka lafaha sida kan aad la kulmayso waxaa sababi kara dhowr waxyaabood, oo ay ku jiraan:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Osteoporosis: This is a condition where your bones become weak and brittle. It's common in older adults, especially women.
entries.translation: Osteoporosis: Tani waa xaalad ay lafahaagu noqdaan kuwo daciif ah oo jilicsan. Waxay ku badan tahay dadka waaweyn, gaar ahaan haweenka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Arthritis: This is inflammation of the joints. It can cause pain, stiffness, and swelling.
entries.translation: Arthritis: Tani waa caabuq ku dhaca kala-goysyada. Waxay keeni kartaa xanuun, qallafsanaan, iyo barar.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fractures: Broken bones can cause severe pain.
entries.translation: Jab: Lafaha jabay waxay keeni karaan xanuun daran.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Other medical conditions: Some medical conditions can also cause bone pain.
entries.translation: Xaalado caafimaad oo kale: Xaaladaha caafimaad qaarkood ayaa sidoo kale keeni kara xanuun lafaha.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: In the meantime, there are some things you can do to help manage your pain:
entries.translation: Hadda se, waxaa jira waxyaabo aad sameyn kartid si aad u maareyso xanuunkaaga:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: Get plenty of rest, especially when you're in pain.
entries.translation: Nasasho: Hel nasasho kugu filan, gaar ahaan markaad xanuun dareemaysid.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Ice or heat: Applying ice or heat to the painful area can help reduce inflammation and pain.
entries.translation: Baraf ama kulayl: Inaad baraf ama kulayl saartid aagga xanuunka leh waxaay kaa caawin kartaa yareynta bararka iyo xanuunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gentle exercise: Gentle exercise, such as walking or swimming, can help keep your joints moving and reduce pain.
entries.translation: Jimicsi fudud: Jimicsi fudud, sida socodka ama dabaasha, ayaa kaa caawin kara in kala-goysyadaadu dhaqaaqaan oo xanuunka yareeyaan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Please don't hesitate to ask us any questions you have. We're here to support you.
entries.translation: Fadlan ha ka gabanin inaad na weydiiso wixii su'aallo ah oo aad qabtid. Waxaan halkan u joognaa inaan ku taageerno.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Good morning, Mr. Tshibangu. Welcome to the community free clinic. How can I help you today?
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Subax wanaagsan, Mr. Tshibangu. Ku soo dhawoow rugta caafimaadka bilaashka ah ee bulshada. Sideen kuu caawin karaa maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: Hi, I'm here for my annual checkup. I also have some questions about my health records.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Waad salaaman tahay, waxaan u imid baaritaankeyga sannadlaha ah. Waxaan sidoo kale qabaa su'aallo ku saabsan diiwaannada caafimaadkeyga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Certainly. Let me get you checked in. Have you been here before?
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Hubaal. Aan ku diiwaan geliyo. Xaruntaan horay ma u timid?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: Yes, I came last year for a flu shot.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Haa, sannadkii hore ayaan u imid tallaalka hergabka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Okay, great. Let me pull up your file. I see here that you have a history of high blood pressure. How have you been managing that?
entries.translation: Qaabilaha: Hagaag, aadoo weyn. Aan soo saaro faylkaaga. Waxaan halkan ku arkayaa in aad leedahay taariikh dhiig karka. Sideed taas ula tacaaleysay?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: I've been taking my medication, but I'm not sure if it's working. I also wanted to ask about accessing my lab results online.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Waxaan qaadanayey daawadeyda, laakiin ma hubo inay shaqeyneyso. Waxaan sidoo kale rabay in aan wax kaa weydiiyo helitaanka natiijooyinka shaybaarkayga oo onlayn ah.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: Yes, please. That would be very helpful.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Haa, fadlan. Taasi waa mid aad waxtar iigu leh.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Okay, let's get started. First, I'll need you to verify your email address.
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Hagaag, aan billowno. Marka hore, waxaan u baahannahay inaad xaqiijiso cinwaankaaga iimaylka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: Sure.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Hubaal.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Perfect. I've sent you an activation link. Once you click on it, you'll be able to create a password and log in.
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Si wanaagsan. Waxaan kuu soo diray link-ga aad ku furan lahayd cinwaanka. Markaad gujiso, waxaad awoodi doontaa inaad sameysato furo sireed, kaddibna aad gasho.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: Thank you. Now, about my blood pressure...
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Mahadsanid. Hadda aan ka hadalno dhiig karkeyga...
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: I can schedule an appointment for you to see Dr. Tesfay. She specializes in hypertension management.
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Waxaan kuu qaban karaa ballan aad ku aragto Dikt. Tesfay. Waxaay ku takhasustay maareynta dhiig karka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: That would be great. When is she available?
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Taasi waa arrin aad u fiican. Goormay la helayaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: She has an opening tomorrow morning at 10:00 am. Does that work for you?
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Waxaay fursad leedahay berri subax saacadu markay tahay 10:00-ka subaxnimo. Taasi ma kuu shaqaynaysaa?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: Yes, that's perfect.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Haa, waa waqti aad iigu habboon.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: Okay, you're all set. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyaha bukaanka: Hagaag, wax walbo waa diyaar. Ma jiraan wax kale oo aan kaa caawin karo maanta?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Tshibangu: No, that's all. Thank you for your help.
entries.translation: Mr. Tshibangu: Maya, waa un intaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay caawinaadaada.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Receptionist: You're welcome, Mr. Tshibangu. Have a good day.
entries.translation: Soo dhaweeyahay bukaanka: Soo dhawoow, Mr. Tshibangu.  Maalin wanaagsan ayaan ku rajeynayaa.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Finch: (wheezing) Yes, doctor. It's been dreadful. Can't sleep, can't eat anything without feeling like fire's rising up my chest.
entries.translation: Mr. Finch: (xiiqsan) Haa, dhakhtar. Aad ayay u xumayd. Ma seexan karo, waxba ma cuni karo iyada oo aan dareemin in dab laabta iga soo kacayo.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Petrova: I see. And you've tried medications and lifestyle changes without much relief?
entries.translation: Dikt. Petrova: Waan arkaa. Oo waxaad isku dayday daawooyin iyo isbedel qaab nololeed weli na aadan helin nafis badan?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Finch: Tried 'em all, doc. Nothing works. Even losing a few pounds didn't seem to help much.
entries.translation: Mr. Finch: Dhammaantood waan isku dayay, dhakhtar. Wax shaqaynaya ma jiraan. Xitaa miisaankeyga aan dhimay wax weyn igama caawin.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Finch: Sounds complicated. Is it safe for an old fellow like me?
entries.translation: Mr. Finch: Waxaay u egtahay mid cakiran. Qallinka ma yahay mid aan dhib ka soo gaareyn dadka da'da weyn sideyda oo kale?
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Mr. Finch: Alright, doc. I trust you. Just get rid of this burning, please.
entries.translation: Mr. Finch: Hagaag, dhakhtar. Waxaan doonayaa in aad mar un iga saarto gubashadan, fadlan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Dr. Petrova: We'll do our best, Mr. Finch. Now, let's get you prepped for surgery.
entries.translation: Dr. Petrova: Waan dedaali doonnaa inta karaankeenna, Mr. Finch. Aan hadda kuu diyaarinno qalliinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Patient Education: Chest Tightness After Surgery
entries.translation: Waxbaridda Bukaanka: Laab Ciriiriga Qaliin Kadib
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Chest tightness is a common sensation after surgery. It can be caused by several factors, including:
entries.translation: Laab ciriiri ah waa dareen caadi ah qaliinka kaddib. Waxaa sababi kara dhowr arrimood, oo ay kamid yihiin:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Incision pain: The surgical incision itself can cause pain and discomfort in the chest area.
entries.translation: Xanuun jeexitaan: Jeexitaanka qalliinka laftiisa ayaa aagga xabadka. ku keeni kara xanuun iyo raaxo la'aan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Muscle soreness: The muscles in the chest may be sore from being stretched or manipulated during surgery.
entries.translation: Murqo xanuun: Murqaha xabadka ayaa laga yaabaa in ay xanuun ku dareemaan fidsanaanta ama marka lala falgalo inta lagu jiro qaliinka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Gas: Gas trapped in the abdomen or chest cavity can cause pressure and discomfort.
entries.translation: Gaas: Gaas ku xayiran caloosha ama godka xabadka ayaa sababi kara cadaadis iyo raaxo la'aan.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Anxiety: Stress and anxiety can contribute to chest tightness.
entries.translation: Murugo: Walbahaarka iyo Murugada ayaa gacan ka geysan kara laab ciriiriga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Managing Chest Tightness:
entries.translation: Maareynta Laab Ciriiriga:
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Pain medication: Take pain medication as prescribed by your doctor.
entries.translation: Daawada xanuun baab'iyaha: Qaado daawada xanuunka sida uu dakhtarkaagu kuugu qoray.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Deep breathing exercises: Practice deep breathing exercises to help expand your lungs and relieve tension.
entries.translation: Sammeynta neefsashada qoto dheer: Ku celcelinta jimicsiga neefsashada qoto dheer si ay kaaga caawiso ballaarinta sambabadaada iyo yaraynta xiisadda xanuunka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Movement: Gentle movement and walking can help prevent stiffness and promote circulation.
entries.translation: Dhaqdhaqaaqa: Dhaqdhaqaaq tartiib tartiib ah iyo socodka ayaa kaa caawin kara ka hortagga qallafsanaanta iyo kor u qaadidda wareegga dhiigga.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Rest: Get plenty of rest to allow your body to heal.
entries.translation: Nasasho: Hel nasasho badan si aad ugu ogolaato jirkaaga inuu bogsado.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Relaxation techniques: Try relaxation techniques such as meditation or guided imagery to reduce anxiety.
entries.translation: Farsamooyinka nasashada: Isku day farsamooyinka nasashada sida xalqeynta kalinnimada ama sawirka la hago si loo yareeyo welwelka.
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Severe chest pain that is not relieved by medication
entries.translation: Xabad xanuun daran oo aan daawada kaa yareyneyn
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Shortness of breath
entries.translation: Neefsashada oo ku dhibta
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Fever or chills
entries.translation: Qandho ama qarqaryo
entries.context: Google Research SMOLDoc Parallel Corpus (smoldoc__en_so, CC-BY-4.0, https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/smol)

entries.english: Redness, swelling, or drainage from your incision
entries.translation: Casaan, barar, ama dheecaan ku yimaada goobta la jeexay

entries.translation: Macluumaadka Nagala Soo Xiriirayo:
